verses.textZh: 大利乌王第二年八月，耶和华的话临到易多的孙子、比利家的儿子撒迦利亚先知，说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 大利乌王第二年八月，耶和华的话临到易多的孙子、比利家的儿子撒迦利亚先知，说：
verses.textZhCuv: 大流士王第二年八月，耶和华的话临到易多的孙子、比利家的儿子先知撒迦利亚，说：
verses.textEnNiv: In the eighth month of the second year of Darius, the word of the Lord came to the prophet Zechariah son of Berekiah, the son of Iddo:
verses.textEnEsv: In the eighth month, in the second year of Darius, the word of the Lord came to the prophet Zechariah, the son of Berechiah, son of Iddo, saying,
verses.textEnNkjv: In the eighth month of the second year of Darius, the word of the Lord came to Zechariah the son of Berechiah, the son of Iddo the prophet, saying,
verses.textEnNlt: In November of the second year of King Darius’s reign, the Lord gave this message to the prophet Zechariah son of Berekiah and grandson of Iddo:
verses.textEnNasb: In the eighth month of the second year of Darius, the word of the Lord came to Zechariah the prophet, the son of Berechiah, the son of Iddo saying,
verses.textEn: In the eighth month of the second year of Darius, the word of the Lord came to the prophet Zechariah son of Berekiah, the son of Iddo:

verses.textZh: "耶和华曾对你们的列祖大发烈怒，
verses.textZhCnvs: "耶和华曾对你们的列祖大发烈怒，
verses.textZhCuv: 「耶和华曾向你们列祖大大发怒。
verses.textEnNiv: "The Lord was very angry with your ancestors.
verses.textEnEsv: "The Lord was very angry with your fathers.
verses.textEnNkjv: "The Lord has been very angry with your fathers.
verses.textEnNlt: "I, the Lord , was very angry with your ancestors.
verses.textEnNasb: "The Lord was very angry with your fathers.
verses.textEn: "The Lord was very angry with your ancestors.

verses.textZh: 所以，你要对众民说：‘万军之耶和华这样说：你们要转向我 ，我就必转向你们 。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以，你要对众民说：‘万军之耶和华这样说：你们要转向我 ，我就必转向你们 。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以你要对以色列人说，万军之耶和华如此说：你们要转向我，我就转向你们。这是万军之耶和华说的。
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore tell the people: This is what the Lord Almighty says: ‘Return to me,’ declares the Lord Almighty, ‘and I will return to you,’ says the Lord Almighty.
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore say to them, Thus declares the Lord of hosts: Return to me, says the Lord of hosts, and I will return to you, says the Lord of hosts.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore say to them, ‘Thus says the Lord of hosts: "Return to Me," says the Lord of hosts, "and I will return to you," says the Lord of hosts.
verses.textEnNlt: Therefore, say to the people, ‘This is what the Lord of Heaven’s Armies says: Return to me, and I will return to you, says the Lord of Heaven’s Armies.’
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore say to them, ‘This is what the Lord of armies says: "Return to Me," declares the Lord of armies, " that I may return to you," says the Lord of armies.
verses.textEn: Therefore tell the people: This is what the Lord Almighty says: ‘Return to me,’ declares the Lord Almighty, ‘and I will return to you,’ says the Lord Almighty.

verses.textZh: 不要效法你们的列祖那样，从前的先知呼唤他们：万军之耶和华这样说，你们要回转，离开你们的恶道和恶行。他们却不听从，也不理会我 。
verses.textZhCnvs: 不要效法你们的列祖那样，从前的先知呼唤他们：万军之耶和华这样说，你们要回转，离开你们的恶道和恶行。他们却不听从，也不理会我 。
verses.textZhCuv: 不要效法你们列祖。从前的先知呼叫他们说，万军之耶和华如此说：『你们要回头离开你们的恶道恶行。』他们却不听，也不顺从我。这是耶和华说的。
verses.textEnNiv: Do not be like your ancestors, to whom the earlier prophets proclaimed: This is what the Lord Almighty says: ‘Turn from your evil ways and your evil practices.’ But they would not listen or pay attention to me, declares the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: Do not be like your fathers, to whom the former prophets cried out, ‘Thus says the Lord of hosts, Return from your evil ways and from your evil deeds.’ But they did not hear or pay attention to me, declares the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: "Do not be like your fathers, to whom the former prophets preached, saying, ‘Thus says the Lord of hosts: "Turn now from your evil ways and your evil deeds." ’ But they did not hear nor heed Me," says the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: Don’t be like your ancestors who would not listen or pay attention when the earlier prophets said to them, ‘This is what the Lord of Heaven’s Armies says: Turn from your evil ways, and stop all your evil practices.’
verses.textEnNasb: "Do not be like your fathers, to whom the former prophets proclaimed, saying, ‘This is what the Lord of armies says: "Return now from your evil ways and from your evil deeds." ’ But they did not listen or pay attention to Me," declares the Lord.
verses.textEn: Do not be like your ancestors, to whom the earlier prophets proclaimed: This is what the Lord Almighty says: ‘Turn from your evil ways and your evil practices.’ But they would not listen or pay attention to me, declares the Lord .

verses.textZh: 你们的列祖在哪里呢？那些先知能永远活着吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们的列祖在哪里呢？那些先知能永远活着吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 你们的列祖在哪里呢？那些先知能永远存活吗？
verses.textEnNiv: Where are your ancestors now? And the prophets, do they live forever?
verses.textEnEsv: Your fathers, where are they? And the prophets, do they live forever?
verses.textEnNkjv: "Your fathers, where are they? And the prophets, do they live forever?
verses.textEnNlt: "Where are your ancestors now? They and the prophets are long dead.
verses.textEnNasb: "Your fathers, where are they? And the prophets, do they live forever?
verses.textEn: Where are your ancestors now? And the prophets, do they live forever?

verses.textZh: 然而我吩咐我的仆人众先知的话与条例，不是已报应在你们的列祖身上吗？所以他们就回转，说：万军之耶和华定意按着我们所作所行的对付我们，他已经这样行了。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 然而我吩咐我的仆人众先知的话与条例，不是已报应在你们的列祖身上吗？所以他们就回转，说：万军之耶和华定意按着我们所作所行的对付我们，他已经这样行了。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 只是我的言语和律例，就是所吩咐我仆人众先知的，岂不临到你们列祖吗？他们就回头，说：『万军之耶和华定意按我们的行动作为向我们怎样行，他已照样行了。』」
verses.textEnNiv: But did not my words and my decrees, which I commanded my servants the prophets, overtake your ancestors? "Then they repented and said, ‘The Lord Almighty has done to us what our ways and practices deserve, just as he determined to do.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: But my words and my statutes, which I commanded my servants the prophets, did they not overtake your fathers? So they repented and said, ‘As the Lord of hosts purposed to deal with us for our ways and deeds, so has he dealt with us.’"
verses.textEnNkjv: Yet surely My words and My statutes, Which I commanded My servants the prophets, Did they not overtake your fathers? "So they returned and said: ‘Just as the Lord of hosts determined to do to us, According to our ways and according to our deeds, So He has dealt with us.’ " ’ "
verses.textEnNlt: But everything I said through my servants the prophets happened to your ancestors, just as I said. As a result, they repented and said, ‘We have received what we deserved from the Lord of Heaven’s Armies. He has done what he said he would do.’"
verses.textEnNasb: But did My words and My statutes, which I commanded My servants the prophets, not overtake your fathers? Then they repented and said, ‘Just as the Lord of armies planned to do to us in accordance with our ways and our deeds, so He has dealt with us.’ " ’ "
verses.textEn: But did not my words and my decrees, which I commanded my servants the prophets, overtake your ancestors? "Then they repented and said, ‘The Lord Almighty has done to us what our ways and practices deserve, just as he determined to do.’ "

verses.textZh: 大利乌王第二年十一月 二十四日，耶和华的话临到易多的孙子、比利家的儿子撒迦利亚先知，实情如下：
verses.textZhCnvs: 大利乌王第二年十一月 二十四日，耶和华的话临到易多的孙子、比利家的儿子撒迦利亚先知，实情如下：
verses.textZhCuv: 大流士第二年十一月，就是细罢特月二十四日，耶和华的话临到易多的孙子、比利家的儿子先知撒迦利亚，说：
verses.textEnNiv: On the twenty-fourth day of the eleventh month, the month of Shebat, in the second year of Darius, the word of the Lord came to the prophet Zechariah son of Berekiah, the son of Iddo.
verses.textEnEsv: On the twenty-fourth day of the eleventh month, which is the month of Shebat, in the second year of Darius, the word of the Lord came to the prophet Zechariah, the son of Berechiah, son of Iddo, saying,
verses.textEnNkjv: On the twenty-fourth day of the eleventh month, which is the month Shebat, in the second year of Darius, the word of the Lord came to Zechariah the son of Berechiah, the son of Iddo the prophet:
verses.textEnNlt: Three months later, on February 15, the Lord sent another message to the prophet Zechariah son of Berekiah and grandson of Iddo.
verses.textEnNasb: On the twenty-fourth day of the eleventh month, that is, the month Shebat, in the second year of Darius, the word of the Lord came to Zechariah the prophet, the son of Berechiah, the son of Iddo, as follows:
verses.textEn: On the twenty-fourth day of the eleventh month, the month of Shebat, in the second year of Darius, the word of the Lord came to the prophet Zechariah son of Berekiah, the son of Iddo.

verses.textZh: 我夜间观看，看见有一个人骑着红马，站在低洼地上的番石榴树中间；在他后面还有些红色、栗色和白色的马。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我夜间观看，看见有一个人骑着红马，站在低洼地上的番石榴树中间；在他后面还有些红色、栗色和白色的马。
verses.textZhCuv: 「我夜间观看，见一人骑着红马，站在洼地番石榴树中间。在他身后又有红马、黄马，和白马。」
verses.textEnNiv: During the night I had a vision, and there before me was a man mounted on a red horse. He was standing among the myrtle trees in a ravine. Behind him were red, brown and white horses.
verses.textEnEsv: "I saw in the night, and behold, a man riding on a red horse! He was standing among the myrtle trees in the glen, and behind him were red, sorrel, and white horses.
verses.textEnNkjv: I saw by night, and behold, a man riding on a red horse, and it stood among the myrtle trees in the hollow; and behind him were horses: red, sorrel, and white.
verses.textEnNlt: In a vision during the night, I saw a man sitting on a red horse that was standing among some myrtle trees in a small valley. Behind him were riders on red, brown, and white horses.
verses.textEnNasb: I saw at night, and behold, a man was riding on a red horse, and he was standing among the myrtle trees which were in the ravine, with red, sorrel, and white horses behind him.
verses.textEn: During the night I had a vision, and there before me was a man mounted on a red horse. He was standing among the myrtle trees in a ravine. Behind him were red, brown and white horses.

verses.textZh: 我就问："我主啊，这些是甚么？"那与我说话的天使对我说："我会指示你这些是甚么。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我就问："我主啊，这些是甚么？"那与我说话的天使对我说："我会指示你这些是甚么。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我对与我说话的天使说：「主啊，这是什么意思？」他说：「我要指示你这是什么意思。」
verses.textEnNiv: I asked, "What are these, my lord?" The angel who was talking with me answered, "I will show you what they are."
verses.textEnEsv: Then I said, ‘What are these, my lord?’ The angel who talked with me said to me, ‘I will show you what they are.’
verses.textEnNkjv: Then I said, "My lord, what are these?" So the angel who talked with me said to me, "I will show you what they are."
verses.textEnNlt: I asked the angel who was talking with me, "My lord, what do these horses mean?" "I will show you," the angel replied.
verses.textEnNasb: Then I said, "What are these, my lord?" And the angel who was speaking with me said to me, "I will show you what these are."
verses.textEn: I asked, "What are these, my lord?" The angel who was talking with me answered, "I will show you what they are."

verses.textZh: 那站在番石榴树中间的人回答："这些就是耶和华所差遣在遍地巡逻的。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 那站在番石榴树中间的人回答："这些就是耶和华所差遣在遍地巡逻的。"
verses.textZhCuv: 那站在番石榴树中间的人说：「这是奉耶和华差遣在遍地走来走去的。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then the man standing among the myrtle trees explained, "They are the ones the Lord has sent to go throughout the earth."
verses.textEnEsv: So the man who was standing among the myrtle trees answered, ‘These are they whom the Lord has sent to patrol the earth.’
verses.textEnNkjv: And the man who stood among the myrtle trees answered and said, "These aretheones whom the Lord has sent to walk to and fro throughout the earth."
verses.textEnNlt: The rider standing among the myrtle trees then explained, "They are the ones the Lord has sent out to patrol the earth."
verses.textEnNasb: And the man who was standing among the myrtle trees responded and said, "These are the ones whom the Lord has sent to patrol the earth."
verses.textEn: Then the man standing among the myrtle trees explained, "They are the ones the Lord has sent to go throughout the earth."

verses.textZh: 那些骑士回报那站在番石榴树中间的耶和华使者，说："我们已经在遍地巡逻；看见全地都安定，一片平静。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 那些骑士回报那站在番石榴树中间的耶和华使者，说："我们已经在遍地巡逻；看见全地都安定，一片平静。"
verses.textZhCuv: 那些骑马的对站在番石榴树中间耶和华的使者说：「我们已在遍地走来走去，见全地都安息平静。」
verses.textEnNiv: And they reported to the angel of the Lord who was standing among the myrtle trees, "We have gone throughout the earth and found the whole world at rest and in peace."
verses.textEnEsv: And they answered the angel of the Lord who was standing among the myrtle trees, and said, ‘We have patrolled the earth, and behold, all the earth remains at rest.’
verses.textEnNkjv: So they answered the Angel of the Lord, who stood among the myrtle trees, and said, "We have walked to and fro throughout the earth, and behold, all the earth is resting quietly."
verses.textEnNlt: Then the other riders reported to the angel of the Lord , who was standing among the myrtle trees, "We have been patrolling the earth, and the whole earth is at peace."
verses.textEnNasb: So they responded to the angel of the Lord who was standing among the myrtle trees and said, "We have patrolled the earth, and behold, all the earth is still and quiet."
verses.textEn: And they reported to the angel of the Lord who was standing among the myrtle trees, "We have gone throughout the earth and found the whole world at rest and in peace."

verses.textZh: 于是耶和华的使者说："万军之耶和华啊！你不怜悯耶路撒冷和犹大的城镇，要到几时呢？这七十年来，你一直恼怒它们。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是耶和华的使者说："万军之耶和华啊！你不怜悯耶路撒冷和犹大的城镇，要到几时呢？这七十年来，你一直恼怒它们。"
verses.textZhCuv: 于是，耶和华的使者说：「万军之耶和华啊，你恼恨耶路撒冷和犹大的城邑已经七十年，你不施怜悯要到几时呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: Then the angel of the Lord said, " Lord Almighty, how long will you withhold mercy from Jerusalem and from the towns of Judah, which you have been angry with these seventy years?"
verses.textEnEsv: Then the angel of the Lord said, ‘O Lord of hosts, how long will you have no mercy on Jerusalem and the cities of Judah, against which you have been angry these seventy years?’
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Angel of the Lord answered and said, "O Lord of hosts, how long will You not have mercy on Jerusalem and on the cities of Judah, against which You were angry these seventy years?"
verses.textEnNlt: Upon hearing this, the angel of the Lord prayed this prayer: "O Lord of Heaven’s Armies, for seventy years now you have been angry with Jerusalem and the towns of Judah. How long until you again show mercy to them?"
verses.textEnNasb: Then the angel of the Lord said, "Lord of armies, how long will You take no pity on Jerusalem and the cities of Judah, with which You have been indignant for these seventy years?"
verses.textEn: Then the angel of the Lord said, " Lord Almighty, how long will you withhold mercy from Jerusalem and from the towns of Judah, which you have been angry with these seventy years?"

verses.textZh: 耶和华就用满有恩慈和安慰的话回答那与我说话的天使。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华就用满有恩慈和安慰的话回答那与我说话的天使。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华就用美善的安慰话回答那与我说话的天使。
verses.textEnNiv: So the Lord spoke kind and comforting words to the angel who talked with me.
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord answered gracious and comforting words to the angel who talked with me.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the Lord answered the angel who talked to me, with good and comforting words.
verses.textEnNlt: And the Lord spoke kind and comforting words to the angel who talked with me.
verses.textEnNasb: And the Lord responded to the angel who was speaking with me with gracious words, comforting words.
verses.textEn: So the Lord spoke kind and comforting words to the angel who talked with me.

verses.textZh: 那与我说话的天使对我说："你要宣告：‘万军之耶和华这样说：我为耶路撒冷和锡安心里充满嫉恨。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那与我说话的天使对我说："你要宣告：‘万军之耶和华这样说：我为耶路撒冷和锡安心里充满嫉恨。
verses.textZhCuv: 与我说话的天使对我说：「你要宣告说，万军之耶和华如此说：我为耶路撒冷为锡安，心里极其火热。
verses.textEnNiv: Then the angel who was speaking to me said, "Proclaim this word: This is what the Lord Almighty says: ‘I am very jealous for Jerusalem and Zion,
verses.textEnEsv: So the angel who talked with me said to me, ‘Cry out, Thus says the Lord of hosts: I am exceedingly jealous for Jerusalem and for Zion.
verses.textEnNkjv: So the angel who spoke with me said to me, "Proclaim, saying, ‘Thus says the Lord of hosts: "I am zealous for Jerusalem And for Zion with great zeal.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the angel said to me, "Shout this message for all to hear: ‘This is what the Lord of Heaven’s Armies says: My love for Jerusalem and Mount Zion is passionate and strong.
verses.textEnNasb: So the angel who was speaking with me said to me, "Proclaim, saying, ‘This is what the Lord of armies says: "I am exceedingly jealous for Jerusalem and Zion.
verses.textEn: Then the angel who was speaking to me said, "Proclaim this word: This is what the Lord Almighty says: ‘I am very jealous for Jerusalem and Zion,

verses.textZh: 我向那些安逸的列国大大恼怒，因为我只是稍微恼怒我的子民，他们却加深他们的祸害。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我向那些安逸的列国大大恼怒，因为我只是稍微恼怒我的子民，他们却加深他们的祸害。
verses.textZhCuv: 我甚恼怒那安逸的列国，因我从前稍微恼怒我民，他们就加害过分。
verses.textEnNiv: and I am very angry with the nations that feel secure. I was only a little angry, but they went too far with the punishment.’
verses.textEnEsv: And I am exceedingly angry with the nations that are at ease; for while I was angry but a little, they furthered the disaster.
verses.textEnNkjv: I am exceedingly angry with the nations at ease; For I was a little angry, And they helped—but with evil intent."
verses.textEnNlt: But I am very angry with the other nations that are now enjoying peace and security. I was only a little angry with my people, but the nations inflicted harm on them far beyond my intentions.
verses.textEnNasb: But I am very angry with the nations who are carefree; for while I was only a little angry, they furthered the disaster."
verses.textEn: and I am very angry with the nations that feel secure. I was only a little angry, but they went too far with the punishment.’

verses.textZh: 因此，耶和华这样说：我要怀着怜悯的心回到耶路撒冷，我的殿必在城中重建 。绳子必拉在耶路撒冷之上。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，耶和华这样说：我要怀着怜悯的心回到耶路撒冷，我的殿必在城中重建 。绳子必拉在耶路撒冷之上。’
verses.textZhCuv: 所以耶和华如此说：现今我回到耶路撒冷，仍施怜悯，我的殿必重建在其中，准绳必拉在耶路撒冷之上。这是万军之耶和华说的。
verses.textEnNiv: "Therefore this is what the Lord says: ‘I will return to Jerusalem with mercy, and there my house will be rebuilt. And the measuring line will be stretched out over Jerusalem,’ declares the Lord Almighty.
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore, thus says the Lord , I have returned to Jerusalem with mercy; my house shall be built in it, declares the Lord of hosts, and the measuring line shall be stretched out over Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘Therefore thus says the Lord: "I am returning to Jerusalem with mercy; My house shall be built in it," says the Lord of hosts, "And a surveyor’s line shall be stretched out over Jerusalem." ’
verses.textEnNlt: "‘Therefore, this is what the Lord says: I have returned to show mercy to Jerusalem. My Temple will be rebuilt, says the Lord of Heaven’s Armies, and measurements will be taken for the reconstruction of Jerusalem. ’
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore the Lord says this: "I will return to Jerusalem with compassion; My house will be built in it," declares the Lord of armies, "and a measuring line will be stretched over Jerusalem." ’
verses.textEn: "Therefore this is what the Lord says: ‘I will return to Jerusalem with mercy, and there my house will be rebuilt. And the measuring line will be stretched out over Jerusalem,’ declares the Lord Almighty.

verses.textZh: 你要再宣告：‘万军之耶和华这样说：我的城镇必再昌盛繁荣，耶和华必再怜悯锡安，必再拣选耶路撒冷。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要再宣告：‘万军之耶和华这样说：我的城镇必再昌盛繁荣，耶和华必再怜悯锡安，必再拣选耶路撒冷。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 你要再宣告说，万军之耶和华如此说：我的城邑必再丰盛发达。耶和华必再安慰锡安，拣选耶路撒冷。」
verses.textEnNiv: "Proclaim further: This is what the Lord Almighty says: ‘My towns will again overflow with prosperity, and the Lord will again comfort Zion and choose Jerusalem.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: Cry out again, Thus says the Lord of hosts: My cities shall again overflow with prosperity, and the Lord will again comfort Zion and again choose Jerusalem.’"
verses.textEnNkjv: "Again proclaim, saying, ‘Thus says the Lord of hosts: "My cities shall again spread out through prosperity; The Lord will again comfort Zion, And will again choose Jerusalem." ’ "
verses.textEnNlt: "Say this also: ‘This is what the Lord of Heaven’s Armies says: The towns of Israel will again overflow with prosperity, and the Lord will again comfort Zion and choose Jerusalem as his own.’"
verses.textEnNasb: Again, proclaim, saying, ‘This is what the Lord of armies says: "My cities will again overflow with prosperity, and the Lord will again comfort Zion and again choose Jerusalem." ’ "
verses.textEn: "Proclaim further: This is what the Lord Almighty says: ‘My towns will again overflow with prosperity, and the Lord will again comfort Zion and choose Jerusalem.’ "

verses.textEnNasb: And I said, "What are these coming to do?" verses.textEn: The Lord said to Satan, "The Lord rebuke you, Satan! The Lord , who has chosen Jerusalem, rebuke you! Is not this man a burning stick snatched from the fire?"

verses.textZh: 那时，约书亚穿著污秽的衣服，站在使者的面前。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，约书亚穿著污秽的衣服，站在使者的面前。
verses.textZhCuv: 约书亚穿着污秽的衣服站在使者面前。
verses.textEnNiv: Now Joshua was dressed in filthy clothes as he stood before the angel.
verses.textEnEsv: Now Joshua was standing before the angel, clothed with filthy garments.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now Joshua was clothed with filthy garments, and was standing before the Angel.
verses.textEnNlt: Jeshua’s clothing was filthy as he stood there before the angel.
verses.textEnNasb: Now Joshua was clothed in filthy garments and was standing before the angel.
verses.textEn: Now Joshua was dressed in filthy clothes as he stood before the angel.

verses.textZh: 使者吩咐那些侍立在他面前的说："你们要脱去他污秽的衣服。"又对约书亚说："看哪！我已经除去了你的罪孽，要给你穿上华美的礼服。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 使者吩咐那些侍立在他面前的说："你们要脱去他污秽的衣服。"又对约书亚说："看哪！我已经除去了你的罪孽，要给你穿上华美的礼服。"
verses.textZhCuv: 使者吩咐站在面前的说：「你们要脱去他污秽的衣服」；又对约书亚说：「我使你脱离罪孽，要给你穿上华美的衣服。」
verses.textEnNiv: The angel said to those who were standing before him, "Take off his filthy clothes." Then he said to Joshua, "See, I have taken away your sin, and I will put fine garments on you."
verses.textEnEsv: And the angel said to those who were standing before him, "Remove the filthy garments from him." And to him he said, "Behold, I have taken your iniquity away from you, and I will clothe you with pure vestments."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then He answered and spoke to those who stood before Him, saying, "Take away the filthy garments from him." And to him He said, "See, I have removed your iniquity from you, and I will clothe you with rich robes."
verses.textEnNlt: So the angel said to the others standing there, "Take off his filthy clothes." And turning to Jeshua he said, "See, I have taken away your sins, and now I am giving you these fine new clothes."
verses.textEnNasb: And he responded and said to those who were standing before him, saying, "Remove the filthy garments from him." Again he said to him, "See, I have taken your guilt away from you and will clothe you with festive robes."
verses.textEn: The angel said to those who were standing before him, "Take off his filthy clothes." Then he said to Joshua, "See, I have taken away your sin, and I will put fine garments on you."

verses.textZh: 我说："你们要把洁净的冠冕戴在他的头上。"他们就把洁净的冠冕戴在他的头上，又给他穿上华美的衣服。那时，耶和华的使者正在旁边站着。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我说："你们要把洁净的冠冕戴在他的头上。"他们就把洁净的冠冕戴在他的头上，又给他穿上华美的衣服。那时，耶和华的使者正在旁边站着。
verses.textZhCuv: 我说：「要将洁净的冠冕戴在他头上。」他们就把洁净的冠冕戴在他头上，给他穿上华美的衣服，耶和华的使者在旁边站立。
verses.textEnNiv: Then I said, "Put a clean turban on his head." So they put a clean turban on his head and clothed him, while the angel of the Lord stood by.
verses.textEnEsv: And I said, "Let them put a clean turban on his head." So they put a clean turban on his head and clothed him with garments. And the angel of the Lord was standing by.
verses.textEnNkjv: And I said, "Let them put a clean turban on his head." So they put a clean turban on his head, and they put the clothes on him. And the Angel of the Lord stood by.
verses.textEnNlt: Then I said, "They should also place a clean turban on his head." So they put a clean priestly turban on his head and dressed him in new clothes while the angel of the Lord stood by.
verses.textEnNasb: Then I said, "Have them put a clean headband on his head." So they put the clean headband on his head and clothed him with garments, while the angel of the Lord was standing by.
verses.textEn: Then I said, "Put a clean turban on his head." So they put a clean turban on his head and clothed him, while the angel of the Lord stood by.

verses.textZh: 耶和华的使者劝戒约书亚说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华的使者劝戒约书亚说：
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华的使者告诫约书亚说：
verses.textEnNiv: The angel of the Lord gave this charge to Joshua:
verses.textEnEsv: And the angel of the Lord solemnly assured Joshua,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Angel of the Lord admonished Joshua, saying,
verses.textEnNlt: Then the angel of the Lord spoke very solemnly to Jeshua and said,
verses.textEnNasb: And the angel of the Lord admonished Joshua, saying,
verses.textEn: The angel of the Lord gave this charge to Joshua:

verses.textZh: "万军之耶和华这样说：‘你若遵行我的道，谨守我的吩咐，你就必治理我的家，看守我的院子，我必赐你特权，可以在这些侍立在我面前的使者中间自由出入。
verses.textZhCnvs: "万军之耶和华这样说：‘你若遵行我的道，谨守我的吩咐，你就必治理我的家，看守我的院子，我必赐你特权，可以在这些侍立在我面前的使者中间自由出入。
verses.textZhCuv: 「万军之耶和华如此说：你若遵行我的道，谨守我的命令，你就可以管理我的家，看守我的院宇；我也要使你在这些站立的人中间来往。
verses.textEnNiv: "This is what the Lord Almighty says: ‘If you will walk in obedience to me and keep my requirements, then you will govern my house and have charge of my courts, and I will give you a place among these standing here.
verses.textEnEsv: "Thus says the Lord of hosts: If you will walk in my ways and keep my charge, then you shall rule my house and have charge of my courts, and I will give you the right of access among those who are standing here.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Thus says the Lord of hosts: ‘If you will walk in My ways, And if you will keep My command, Then you shall also judge My house, And likewise have charge of My courts; I will give you places to walk Among these who stand here.
verses.textEnNlt: "This is what the Lord of Heaven’s Armies says: If you follow my ways and carefully serve me, then you will be given authority over my Temple and its courtyards. I will let you walk among these others standing here.
verses.textEnNasb: "The Lord of armies says this: ‘If you walk in My ways and perform My service, then you will both govern My house and be in charge of My courtyards, and I will grant you free access among these who are standing here.
verses.textEn: "This is what the Lord Almighty says: ‘If you will walk in obedience to me and keep my requirements, then you will govern my house and have charge of my courts, and I will give you a place among these standing here.

verses.textZh: 大祭司约书亚啊！你和坐在你面前的众同伴都要听， 我必使我的仆人，就是大卫的苗裔出生。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大祭司约书亚啊！你和坐在你面前的众同伴都要听， 我必使我的仆人，就是大卫的苗裔出生。
verses.textZhCuv: 大祭司约书亚啊，你和坐在你面前的同伴都当听。（他们是作预兆的。）我必使我仆人大卫的苗裔发出。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘Listen, High Priest Joshua, you and your associates seated before you, who are men symbolic of things to come: I am going to bring my servant, the Branch.
verses.textEnEsv: Hear now, O Joshua the high priest, you and your friends who sit before you, for they are men who are a sign: behold, I will bring my servant the Branch.
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘Hear, O Joshua, the high priest, You and your companions who sit before you, For they are a wondrous sign; For behold, I am bringing forth My Servant the BRANCH.
verses.textEnNlt: "Listen to me, O Jeshua the high priest, and all you other priests. You are symbols of things to come. Soon I am going to bring my servant, the Branch.
verses.textEnNasb: Now listen, Joshua, you high priest, you and your friends who are sitting in front of you—indeed they are men who are a sign: for behold, I am going to bring in My servant the Branch.
verses.textEn: " ‘Listen, High Priest Joshua, you and your associates seated before you, who are men symbolic of things to come: I am going to bring my servant, the Branch.

verses.textZh: 看我在约书亚面前所立的石头，在这一块石头上有七眼。看哪！我要亲自雕琢这石头 。在一日之内，我要除去这地的罪孽。
verses.textZhCnvs: 看我在约书亚面前所立的石头，在这一块石头上有七眼。看哪！我要亲自雕琢这石头 。在一日之内，我要除去这地的罪孽。
verses.textZhCuv: 看哪，我在约书亚面前所立的石头，在一块石头上有七眼。万军之耶和华说：我要亲自雕刻这石头，并要在一日之间除掉这地的罪孽。
verses.textEnNiv: See, the stone I have set in front of Joshua! There are seven eyes on that one stone, and I will engrave an inscription on it,’ says the Lord Almighty, ‘and I will remove the sin of this land in a single day.
verses.textEnEsv: For behold, on the stone that I have set before Joshua, on a single stone with seven eyes, I will engrave its inscription, declares the Lord of hosts, and I will remove the iniquity of this land in a single day.
verses.textEnNkjv: For behold, the stone That I have laid before Joshua: Upon the stone are seven eyes. Behold, I will engrave its inscription,’ Says the Lord of hosts, ‘And I will remove the iniquity of that land in one day.
verses.textEnNlt: Now look at the jewel I have set before Jeshua, a single stone with seven facets. I will engrave an inscription on it, says the Lord of Heaven’s Armies, and I will remove the sins of this land in a single day.
verses.textEnNasb: For behold, the stone that I have put before Joshua; on one stone are seven eyes. Behold, I am going to engrave an inscription on it,’ declares the Lord of armies, ‘and I will remove the guilt of that land in one day.
verses.textEn: See, the stone I have set in front of Joshua! There are seven eyes on that one stone, and I will engrave an inscription on it,’ says the Lord Almighty, ‘and I will remove the sin of this land in a single day.

verses.textZh: 到那日 ，你们各人要邀请自己的邻舍来，坐在葡萄树下和无花果树下。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 到那日 ，你们各人要邀请自己的邻舍来，坐在葡萄树下和无花果树下。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 当那日，你们各人要请邻舍坐在葡萄树和无花果树下。这是万军之耶和华说的。」
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘In that day each of you will invite your neighbor to sit under your vine and fig tree,’ declares the Lord Almighty."
verses.textEnEsv: In that day, declares the Lord of hosts, every one of you will invite his neighbor to come under his vine and under his fig tree."
verses.textEnNkjv: In that day,’ says the Lord of hosts, ‘Everyone will invite his neighbor Under his vine and under his fig tree.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: "And on that day, says the Lord of Heaven’s Armies, each of you will invite your neighbor to sit with you peacefully under your own grapevine and fig tree."
verses.textEnNasb: On that day,’ declares the Lord of armies, ‘every one of you will invite his neighbor to sit under his vine and under his fig tree.’ "
verses.textEn: " ‘In that day each of you will invite your neighbor to sit under your vine and fig tree,’ declares the Lord Almighty."

verses.textZh: 那与我说话的天使回来唤醒我，我好象人在睡眠中被人唤醒一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那与我说话的天使回来唤醒我，我好象人在睡眠中被人唤醒一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 那与我说话的天使又来叫醒我，好像人睡觉被唤醒一样。
verses.textEnNiv: Then the angel who talked with me returned and woke me up, like someone awakened from sleep.
verses.textEnEsv: And the angel who talked with me came again and woke me, like a man who is awakened out of his sleep.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the angel who talked with me came back and wakened me, as a man who is wakened out of his sleep.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the angel who had been talking with me returned and woke me, as though I had been asleep.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the angel who had been speaking with me returned and woke me, like a person who is awakened from his sleep.
verses.textEn: Then the angel who talked with me returned and woke me up, like someone awakened from sleep.

verses.textZh: 他对我说："你看见了甚么？"我回答："我看见一个金灯台，整个是金的，顶上有一个盆子，并有七盏灯；顶上的灯有七个灯嘴。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他对我说："你看见了甚么？"我回答："我看见一个金灯台，整个是金的，顶上有一个盆子，并有七盏灯；顶上的灯有七个灯嘴。
verses.textZhCuv: 他问我说：「你看见了什么？」我说：「我看见了一个纯金的灯台，顶上有灯盏，灯台上有七盏灯，每盏有七个管子。
verses.textEnNiv: He asked me, "What do you see?" I answered, "I see a solid gold lampstand with a bowl at the top and seven lamps on it, with seven channels to the lamps.
verses.textEnEsv: And he said to me, "What do you see?" I said, "I see, and behold, a lampstand all of gold, with a bowl on the top of it, and seven lamps on it, with seven lips on each of the lamps that are on the top of it.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he said to me, "What do you see?" So I said, "I am looking, and there is a lampstand of solid gold with a bowl on top of it, and on the stand seven lamps with seven pipes to the seven lamps.
verses.textEnNlt: "What do you see now?" he asked. I answered, "I see a solid gold lampstand with a bowl of oil on top of it. Around the bowl are seven lamps, each having seven spouts with wicks.
verses.textEnNasb: And he said to me, "What do you see?" And I said, "I see, and behold, a lampstand all of gold with its bowl on the top of it, and its seven lamps on it with seven spouts belonging to each of the lamps which are on the top of it;
verses.textEn: He asked me, "What do you see?" I answered, "I see a solid gold lampstand with a bowl at the top and seven lamps on it, with seven channels to the lamps.

verses.textZh: 盆子旁边有两棵橄榄树，一棵在右边，一棵在左边。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 盆子旁边有两棵橄榄树，一棵在右边，一棵在左边。"
verses.textZhCuv: 旁边有两棵橄榄树，一棵在灯盏的右边，一棵在灯盏的左边。」
verses.textEnNiv: Also there are two olive trees by it, one on the right of the bowl and the other on its left."
verses.textEnEsv: And there are two olive trees by it, one on the right of the bowl and the other on its left."
verses.textEnNkjv: Two olive trees are by it, one at the right of the bowl and the other at its left."
verses.textEnNlt: And I see two olive trees, one on each side of the bowl."
verses.textEnNasb: also two olive trees by it, one on the right side of the bowl and the other on its left side."
verses.textEn: Also there are two olive trees by it, one on the right of the bowl and the other on its left."

verses.textZh: 我问那与我说话的天使，说："我主啊，这些是甚么？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我问那与我说话的天使，说："我主啊，这些是甚么？"
verses.textZhCuv: 我问与我说话的天使说：「主啊，这是什么意思？」
verses.textEnNiv: I asked the angel who talked with me, "What are these, my lord?"
verses.textEnEsv: And I said to the angel who talked with me, "What are these, my lord?"
verses.textEnNkjv: So I answered and spoke to the angel who talked with me, saying, "What are these, my lord?"
verses.textEnNlt: Then I asked the angel, "What are these, my lord? What do they mean?"
verses.textEnNasb: Then I said to the angel who was speaking with me, saying, "What are these, my lord?"
verses.textEn: I asked the angel who talked with me, "What are these, my lord?"

verses.textZh: 那与我说话的天使回答我说："你不知道这些是甚么意思吗？"我说："我主啊，我不知道。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 那与我说话的天使回答我说："你不知道这些是甚么意思吗？"我说："我主啊，我不知道。"
verses.textZhCuv: 与我说话的天使回答我说：「你不知道这是什么意思吗？」我说：「主啊，我不知道。」
verses.textEnNiv: He answered, "Do you not know what these are?" "No, my lord," I replied.
verses.textEnEsv: Then the angel who talked with me answered and said to me, "Do you not know what these are?" I said, "No, my lord."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the angel who talked with me answered and said to me, "Do you not know what these are?" And I said, "No, my lord."
verses.textEnNlt: "Don’t you know?" the angel asked. "No, my lord," I replied.
verses.textEnNasb: So the angel who was speaking with me answered and said to me, "Do you not know what these are?" And I said, "No, my lord."
verses.textEn: He answered, "Do you not know what these are?" "No, my lord," I replied.

verses.textZh: 他对我说："这是耶和华对所罗巴伯所说的话：‘不是倚靠权势，不是倚靠能力，而是倚靠我的灵。’这是万军之耶和华说的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他对我说："这是耶和华对所罗巴伯所说的话：‘不是倚靠权势，不是倚靠能力，而是倚靠我的灵。’这是万军之耶和华说的。
verses.textZhCuv: 他对我说：「这是耶和华指示所罗巴伯的。万军之耶和华说：不是倚靠势力，不是倚靠才能，乃是倚靠我的灵方能成事。
verses.textEnNiv: So he said to me, "This is the word of the Lord to Zerubbabel: ‘Not by might nor by power, but by my Spirit,’ says the Lord Almighty.
verses.textEnEsv: Then he said to me, "This is the word of the Lord to Zerubbabel: Not by might, nor by power, but by my Spirit, says the Lord of hosts.
verses.textEnNkjv: So he answered and said to me: "This is the word of the Lord to Zerubbabel: ‘Not by might nor by power, but by My Spirit,’ Says the Lord of hosts.
verses.textEnNlt: Then he said to me, "This is what the Lord says to Zerubbabel: It is not by force nor by strength, but by my Spirit, says the Lord of Heaven’s Armies.
verses.textEnNasb: Then he said to me, "This is the word of the Lord to Zerubbabel, saying, ‘Not by might nor by power, but by My Spirit,’ says the Lord of armies.
verses.textEn: So he said to me, "This is the word of the Lord to Zerubbabel: ‘Not by might nor by power, but by my Spirit,’ says the Lord Almighty.

verses.textZh: 大山啊！你算得甚么？你在所罗巴伯面前必夷为平地！他必安放那块平顶的石头，必有欢呼的声音说：‘愿恩惠、恩惠归与这殿 。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 大山啊！你算得甚么？你在所罗巴伯面前必夷为平地！他必安放那块平顶的石头，必有欢呼的声音说：‘愿恩惠、恩惠归与这殿 。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 大山哪，你算什么呢？在所罗巴伯面前，你必成为平地。他必搬出一块石头，安在殿顶上。人且大声欢呼说：『愿恩惠恩惠归与这殿 ！』」
verses.textEnNiv: "What are you, mighty mountain? Before Zerubbabel you will become level ground. Then he will bring out the capstone to shouts of ‘God bless it! God bless it!’ "
verses.textEnEsv: Who are you, O great mountain? Before Zerubbabel you shall become a plain. And he shall bring forward the top stone amid shouts of ‘Grace, grace to it!’"
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘Who are you, O great mountain? Before Zerubbabel youshallbecome a plain! And he shall bring forth the capstone With shouts of "Grace, grace to it!" ’ "
verses.textEnNlt: Nothing, not even a mighty mountain, will stand in Zerubbabel’s way; it will become a level plain before him! And when Zerubbabel sets the final stone of the Temple in place, the people will shout: ‘May God bless it! May God bless it!’ "
verses.textEnNasb: ‘What are you, you great mountain? Before Zerubbabel you will become a plain; and he will bring out the top stone with shouts of "Grace, grace to it!" ’ "
verses.textEn: "What are you, mighty mountain? Before Zerubbabel you will become level ground. Then he will bring out the capstone to shouts of ‘God bless it! God bless it!’ "

verses.textZh: 耶和华的话又临到我说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华的话又临到我说：
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华的话又临到我说：
verses.textEnNiv: Then the word of the Lord came to me:
verses.textEnEsv: Then the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.textEnNkjv: Moreover the word of the Lord came to me, saying:
verses.textEnNlt: Then another message came to me from the Lord :
verses.textEnNasb: Also the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.textEn: Then the word of the Lord came to me:

verses.textZh: "所罗巴伯的手奠立了这殿的根基，他的手也必完成这工；这样，你就知道万军之耶和华差遣了我到你们这里来。
verses.textZhCnvs: "所罗巴伯的手奠立了这殿的根基，他的手也必完成这工；这样，你就知道万军之耶和华差遣了我到你们这里来。
verses.textZhCuv: 「所罗巴伯的手立了这殿的根基，他的手也必完成这工，你就知道万军之耶和华差遣我到你们这里来了。
verses.textEnNiv: "The hands of Zerubbabel have laid the foundation of this temple; his hands will also complete it. Then you will know that the Lord Almighty has sent me to you.
verses.textEnEsv: "The hands of Zerubbabel have laid the foundation of this house; his hands shall also complete it. Then you will know that the Lord of hosts has sent me to you.
verses.textEnNkjv: "The hands of Zerubbabel Have laid the foundation of this temple; His hands shall also finish it. Then you will know That the Lord of hosts has sent Me to you.
verses.textEnNlt: "Zerubbabel is the one who laid the foundation of this Temple, and he will complete it. Then you will know that the Lord of Heaven’s Armies has sent me.
verses.textEnNasb: "The hands of Zerubbabel have laid the foundation of this house, and his hands will finish it. Then you will know that the Lord of armies has sent me to you.
verses.textEn: "The hands of Zerubbabel have laid the foundation of this temple; his hands will also complete it. Then you will know that the Lord Almighty has sent me to you.

verses.textZh: 谁藐视这日子，以为所作的是小事呢？他们看见所罗巴伯手里拿着测锤，就必欢喜。" 是耶和华的这七眼，遍察全地。
verses.textZhCnvs: 谁藐视这日子，以为所作的是小事呢？他们看见所罗巴伯手里拿着测锤，就必欢喜。" 是耶和华的这七眼，遍察全地。
verses.textZhCuv: 谁藐视这日的事为小呢？这七眼乃是耶和华的眼睛，遍察全地，见所罗巴伯手拿线铊就欢喜。」
verses.textEnNiv: "Who dares despise the day of small things, since the seven eyes of the Lord that range throughout the earth will rejoice when they see the chosen capstone in the hand of Zerubbabel?"
verses.textEnEsv: For whoever has despised the day of small things shall rejoice, and shall see the plumb line in the hand of Zerubbabel. "These seven are the eyes of the Lord , which range through the whole earth."
verses.textEnNkjv: For who has despised the day of small things? For these seven rejoice to see The plumb line in the hand of Zerubbabel. They are the eyes of the Lord, Which scan to and fro throughout the whole earth."
verses.textEnNlt: Do not despise these small beginnings, for the Lord rejoices to see the work begin, to see the plumb line in Zerubbabel’s hand." (The seven lamps represent the eyes of the Lord that search all around the world.)
verses.textEnNasb: For who has shown contempt for the day of small things? But these seven will rejoice when they see the plumb line in the hand of Zerubbabel—they are the eyes of the Lord roaming throughout the earth."
verses.textEn: "Who dares despise the day of small things, since the seven eyes of the Lord that range throughout the earth will rejoice when they see the chosen capstone in the hand of Zerubbabel?"

verses.textZh: 我又再问那天使："在这灯台左右的两棵橄榄树是甚么意思？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我又再问那天使："在这灯台左右的两棵橄榄树是甚么意思？"
verses.textZhCuv: 我又问天使说：「这灯台左右的两棵橄榄树是什么意思？」
verses.textEnNiv: Then I asked the angel, "What are these two olive trees on the right and the left of the lampstand?"
verses.textEnEsv: Then I said to him, "What are these two olive trees on the right and the left of the lampstand?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Then I answered and said to him, "What are these two olive trees—at the right of the lampstand and at its left?"
verses.textEnNlt: Then I asked the angel, "What are these two olive trees on each side of the lampstand,
verses.textEnNasb: Then I said to him, "What are these two olive trees on the right of the lampstand and on its left?"
verses.textEn: Then I asked the angel, "What are these two olive trees on the right and the left of the lampstand?"

verses.textZh: 我又问他："在两根流出金色油的金管子旁边的两根橄榄树枝，究竟是甚么意思？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我又问他："在两根流出金色油的金管子旁边的两根橄榄树枝，究竟是甚么意思？"
verses.textZhCuv: 我二次问他说：「这两根橄榄枝在两个流出金色油的金嘴旁边是什么意思？」
verses.textEnNiv: Again I asked him, "What are these two olive branches beside the two gold pipes that pour out golden oil?"
verses.textEnEsv: And a second time I answered and said to him, "What are these two branches of the olive trees, which are beside the two golden pipes from which the golden oil is poured out?"
verses.textEnNkjv: And I further answered and said to him, "What arethese two olive branches that drip into the receptacles of the two gold pipes from which the golden oil drains?"
verses.textEnNlt: and what are the two olive branches that pour out golden oil through two gold tubes?"
verses.textEnNasb: And I responded the second time and said to him, "What are the two olive branches which are beside the two golden pipes, which empty the golden oil from themselves?"
verses.textEn: Again I asked him, "What are these two olive branches beside the two gold pipes that pour out golden oil?"

verses.textZh: 他回答我："你不知道这些是甚么意思吗？"我说："我主啊，我不知道。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他回答我："你不知道这些是甚么意思吗？"我说："我主啊，我不知道。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他对我说：「你不知道这是什么意思吗？」我说：「主啊，我不知道。」
verses.textEnNiv: He replied, "Do you not know what these are?" "No, my lord," I said.
verses.textEnEsv: He said to me, "Do you not know what these are?" I said, "No, my lord."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he answered me and said, "Do you not know what these are?" And I said, "No, my lord."
verses.textEnNlt: "Don’t you know?" he asked. "No, my lord," I replied.
verses.textEnNasb: So he answered me, saying, "Do you not know what these are?" And I said, "No, my lord."
verses.textEn: He replied, "Do you not know what these are?" "No, my lord," I said.

verses.textZh: 他说："这是两位受膏者 ，是服事全地之主的。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他说："这是两位受膏者 ，是服事全地之主的。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他说：「这是两个受膏者站在普天下主的旁边。」
verses.textEnNiv: So he said, "These are the two who are anointed to serve the Lord of all the earth."
verses.textEnEsv: Then he said, "These are the two anointed ones who stand by the Lord of the whole earth."
verses.textEnNkjv: So he said, "These are the two anointed ones, who stand beside the Lord of the whole earth."
verses.textEnNlt: Then he said to me, "They represent the two anointed ones who stand in the court of the Lord of all the earth."
verses.textEnNasb: Then he said, "These are the two anointed ones, who are standing by the Lord of the whole earth."
verses.textEn: So he said, "These are the two who are anointed to serve the Lord of all the earth."

verses.textZh: 我又举目观看，看见有一卷飞行的书卷。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我又举目观看，看见有一卷飞行的书卷。
verses.textZhCuv: 我又举目观看，见有一飞行的书卷。
verses.textEnNiv: I looked again, and there before me was a flying scroll.
verses.textEnEsv: Again I lifted my eyes and saw, and behold, a flying scroll!
verses.textEnNkjv: Then I turned and raised my eyes, and saw there a flying scroll.
verses.textEnNlt: I looked up again and saw a scroll flying through the air.
verses.textEnNasb: Then I raised my eyes again and looked, and behold, there was a flying scroll.
verses.textEn: I looked again, and there before me was a flying scroll.

verses.textZh: 他问我："你看见甚么？"我回答："我看见一卷飞行的书卷，长十公尺，宽五公尺。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他问我："你看见甚么？"我回答："我看见一卷飞行的书卷，长十公尺，宽五公尺。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他问我说：「你看见什么？」我回答说：「我看见一飞行的书卷，长二十肘，宽十肘。」
verses.textEnNiv: He asked me, "What do you see?" I answered, "I see a flying scroll, twenty cubits long and ten cubits wide. "
verses.textEnEsv: And he said to me, "What do you see?" I answered, "I see a flying scroll. Its length is twenty cubits, and its width ten cubits."
verses.textEnNkjv: And he said to me, "What do you see?" So I answered, "I see a flying scroll. Its length is twenty cubits and its width ten cubits."
verses.textEnNlt: "What do you see?" the angel asked. "I see a flying scroll," I replied. "It appears to be about 30 feet long and 15 feet wide. "
verses.textEnNasb: And he said to me, "What do you see?" And I said, "I see a flying scroll; its length is twenty cubits, and its width ten cubits."
verses.textEn: He asked me, "What do you see?" I answered, "I see a flying scroll, twenty cubits long and ten cubits wide. "

verses.textZh: 他对我说："这是向全地发出的咒诅：凡偷盗的必照着书卷这面所写的被清除；凡起假誓的必照着那面所记的被清除。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他对我说："这是向全地发出的咒诅：凡偷盗的必照着书卷这面所写的被清除；凡起假誓的必照着那面所记的被清除。
verses.textZhCuv: 他对我说：「这是发出行在遍地上的咒诅。凡偷窃的必按卷上这面的话除灭；凡起假誓的必按卷上那面的话除灭。
verses.textEnNiv: And he said to me, "This is the curse that is going out over the whole land; for according to what it says on one side, every thief will be banished, and according to what it says on the other, everyone who swears falsely will be banished.
verses.textEnEsv: Then he said to me, "This is the curse that goes out over the face of the whole land. For everyone who steals shall be cleaned out according to what is on one side, and everyone who swears falsely shall be cleaned out according to what is on the other side.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he said to me, "This is the curse that goes out over the face of the whole earth: ‘Every thief shall be expelled,’ according to this side of thescroll; and, ‘Every perjurer shall be expelled,’ according to that side of it."
verses.textEnNlt: Then he said to me, "This scroll contains the curse that is going out over the entire land. One side of the scroll says that those who steal will be banished from the land; the other side says that those who swear falsely will be banished from the land.
verses.textEnNasb: Then he said to me, "This is the curse that is going forth over the face of the entire land; everyone who steals certainly will be purged away according to the writing on one side, and everyone who swears falsely will be purged away according to the writing on the other side.
verses.textEn: And he said to me, "This is the curse that is going out over the whole land; for according to what it says on one side, every thief will be banished, and according to what it says on the other, everyone who swears falsely will be banished.

verses.textZh: 万军之耶和华说：‘我要使这书卷出去，进入盗贼的家和指着我的名起假誓之人的家，这书卷必留在他的家中，要把他家里的木料和石头都毁灭 。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 万军之耶和华说：‘我要使这书卷出去，进入盗贼的家和指着我的名起假誓之人的家，这书卷必留在他的家中，要把他家里的木料和石头都毁灭 。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 万军之耶和华说：我必使这书卷出去，进入偷窃人的家和指我名起假誓人的家，必常在他家里，连房屋带木石都毁灭了。」
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord Almighty declares, ‘I will send it out, and it will enter the house of the thief and the house of anyone who swears falsely by my name. It will remain in that house and destroy it completely, both its timbers and its stones.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: I will send it out, declares the Lord of hosts, and it shall enter the house of the thief, and the house of him who swears falsely by my name. And it shall remain in his house and consume it, both timber and stones."
verses.textEnNkjv: "I will send out thecurse," says the Lord of hosts; "It shall enter the house of the thief And the house of the one who swears falsely by My name. It shall remain in the midst of his house And consume it, with its timber and stones."
verses.textEnNlt: And this is what the Lord of Heaven’s Armies says: I am sending this curse into the house of every thief and into the house of everyone who swears falsely using my name. And my curse will remain in that house and completely destroy it—even its timbers and stones."
verses.textEnNasb: I will make it go forth," declares the Lord of armies, "and it will enter the house of the thief and the house of the one who swears falsely by My name; and it will spend the night within that house and destroy it with its timber and stones."
verses.textEn: The Lord Almighty declares, ‘I will send it out, and it will enter the house of the thief and the house of anyone who swears falsely by my name. It will remain in that house and destroy it completely, both its timbers and its stones.’ "

verses.textZh: 那与我说话的天使又出来对我说："你要举目观看，看看这出来的是甚么？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 那与我说话的天使又出来对我说："你要举目观看，看看这出来的是甚么？"
verses.textZhCuv: 与我说话的天使出来，对我说：「你要举目观看，见所出来的是什么？」
verses.textEnNiv: Then the angel who was speaking to me came forward and said to me, "Look up and see what is appearing."
verses.textEnEsv: Then the angel who talked with me came forward and said to me, "Lift your eyes and see what this is that is going out."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the angel who talked with me came out and said to me, "Lift your eyes now, and see what this is that goes forth."
verses.textEnNlt: Then the angel who was talking with me came forward and said, "Look up and see what’s coming."
verses.textEnNasb: Then the angel who had been speaking with me went out and said to me, "Now raise your eyes and see what this is that is going forth."
verses.textEn: Then the angel who was speaking to me came forward and said to me, "Look up and see what is appearing."

verses.textZh: 我说："这是甚么？"他回答："这出来的是个量器。"他又说："这是他们在全地上的罪孽 。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我说："这是甚么？"他回答："这出来的是个量器。"他又说："这是他们在全地上的罪孽 。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我说：「这是什么呢？」他说：「这出来的是量器。」他又说：「这是恶人在遍地的形状。」
verses.textEnNiv: I asked, "What is it?" He replied, "It is a basket." And he added, "This is the iniquity of the people throughout the land."
verses.textEnEsv: And I said, "What is it?" He said, "This is the basket that is going out." And he said, "This is their iniquity in all the land."
verses.textEnNkjv: So I asked, "What is it?" And he said, "It is a basket that is going forth." He also said, "This is their resemblance throughout the earth:
verses.textEnNlt: "What is it?" I asked. He replied, "It is a basket for measuring grain, and it’s filled with the sins of everyone throughout the land."
verses.textEnNasb: And I said, "What is it?" Then he said, "This is the ephah going forth." Again he said, "This is their appearance in all the land.
verses.textEn: I asked, "What is it?" He replied, "It is a basket." And he added, "This is the iniquity of the people throughout the land."

verses.textZh: 看哪！量器的圆形铅盖被揭开，有一个妇人坐在量器里面。
verses.textZhCnvs: 看哪！量器的圆形铅盖被揭开，有一个妇人坐在量器里面。
verses.textZhCuv: （我见有一片圆铅被举起来。）这坐在量器中的是个妇人。
verses.textEnNiv: Then the cover of lead was raised, and there in the basket sat a woman!
verses.textEnEsv: And behold, the leaden cover was lifted, and there was a woman sitting in the basket!
verses.textEnNkjv: Here is a lead disc lifted up, and this is a woman sitting inside the basket";
verses.textEnNlt: Then the heavy lead cover was lifted off the basket, and there was a woman sitting inside it.
verses.textEnNasb: And behold, a lead cover was lifted up." He continued, "And this is a woman sitting inside the ephah."
verses.textEn: Then the cover of lead was raised, and there in the basket sat a woman!

verses.textZh: 天使说："这是罪恶。"然后他把那妇人掷回量器中，又把那铅盖丢在量器的口上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 天使说："这是罪恶。"然后他把那妇人掷回量器中，又把那铅盖丢在量器的口上。
verses.textZhCuv: 天使说：「这是罪恶。」他就把妇人扔在量器中，将那片圆铅扔在量器的口上。
verses.textEnNiv: He said, "This is wickedness," and he pushed her back into the basket and pushed its lead cover down on it.
verses.textEnEsv: And he said, "This is Wickedness." And he thrust her back into the basket, and thrust down the leaden weight on its opening.
verses.textEnNkjv: then he said, "This is Wickedness!" And he thrust her down into the basket, and threw the lead cover over its mouth.
verses.textEnNlt: The angel said, "The woman’s name is Wickedness," and he pushed her back into the basket and closed the heavy lid again.
verses.textEnNasb: Then he said, "This is Wickedness!" And he thrust her into the middle of the ephah and threw the lead weight on its opening.
verses.textEn: He said, "This is wickedness," and he pushed her back into the basket and pushed its lead cover down on it.

verses.textZh: 我又举目观看，看见有两个妇人出来。她们有翅膀，好象鹳鸟的翅膀；她们的翅膀之下有风。她们把那量器抬起，抬到天地之间。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我又举目观看，看见有两个妇人出来。她们有翅膀，好象鹳鸟的翅膀；她们的翅膀之下有风。她们把那量器抬起，抬到天地之间。
verses.textZhCuv: 我又举目观看，见有两个妇人出来，在她们翅膀中有风，飞得甚快，翅膀如同鹳鸟的翅膀。她们将量器抬起来，悬在天地中间。
verses.textEnNiv: Then I looked up—and there before me were two women, with the wind in their wings! They had wings like those of a stork, and they lifted up the basket between heaven and earth.
verses.textEnEsv: Then I lifted my eyes and saw, and behold, two women coming forward! The wind was in their wings. They had wings like the wings of a stork, and they lifted up the basket between earth and heaven.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then I raised my eyes and looked, and there were two women, coming with the wind in their wings; for they had wings like the wings of a stork, and they lifted up the basket between earth and heaven.
verses.textEnNlt: Then I looked up and saw two women flying toward us, gliding on the wind. They had wings like a stork, and they picked up the basket and flew into the sky.
verses.textEnNasb: Then I raised my eyes and looked, and there two women were coming out with the wind in their wings; and they had wings like the wings of the stork, and they lifted up the ephah between the earth and the heavens.
verses.textEn: Then I looked up—and there before me were two women, with the wind in their wings! They had wings like those of a stork, and they lifted up the basket between heaven and earth.

verses.textZh: 我问那与我说话的天使："她们要把量器带到哪里去呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我问那与我说话的天使："她们要把量器带到哪里去呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 我问与我说话的天使说：「她们要将量器抬到哪里去呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: "Where are they taking the basket?" I asked the angel who was speaking to me.
verses.textEnEsv: Then I said to the angel who talked with me, "Where are they taking the basket?"
verses.textEnNkjv: So I said to the angel who talked with me, "Where are they carrying the basket?"
verses.textEnNlt: "Where are they taking the basket?" I asked the angel.
verses.textEnNasb: So I said to the angel who was speaking with me, "Where are they taking the ephah?"
verses.textEn: "Where are they taking the basket?" I asked the angel who was speaking to me.

verses.textZh: 他回答我："要在示拿地为那量器建造房子；房子预备好了，就在那里把它安放在它自己的地方。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他回答我："要在示拿地为那量器建造房子；房子预备好了，就在那里把它安放在它自己的地方。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他对我说：「要往示拿地去，为它盖造房屋；等房屋齐备，就把它安置在自己的地方。」
verses.textEnNiv: He replied, "To the country of Babylonia to build a house for it. When the house is ready, the basket will be set there in its place."
verses.textEnEsv: He said to me, "To the land of Shinar, to build a house for it. And when this is prepared, they will set the basket down there on its base."
verses.textEnNkjv: And he said to me, "To build a house for it in the land of Shinar; when it is ready, thebasket will be set there on its base."
verses.textEnNlt: He replied, "To the land of Babylonia, where they will build a temple for the basket. And when the temple is ready, they will set the basket there on its pedestal."
verses.textEnNasb: Then he said to me, "To build a temple for her in the land of Shinar; and when it is prepared, she will be set there on her own pedestal."
verses.textEn: He replied, "To the country of Babylonia to build a house for it. When the house is ready, the basket will be set there in its place."

verses.textZh: 我又举目观看，看见有四辆战车从两座山中间出来，那两座山是铜山。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我又举目观看，看见有四辆战车从两座山中间出来，那两座山是铜山。
verses.textZhCuv: 我又举目观看，见有四辆车从两山中间出来；那山是铜山。
verses.textEnNiv: I looked up again, and there before me were four chariots coming out from between two mountains—mountains of bronze.
verses.textEnEsv: Again I lifted my eyes and saw, and behold, four chariots came out from between two mountains. And the mountains were mountains of bronze.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then I turned and raised my eyes and looked, and behold, four chariots were coming from between two mountains, and the mountains were mountains of bronze.
verses.textEnNlt: Then I looked up again and saw four chariots coming from between two bronze mountains.
verses.textEnNasb: Now I raised my eyes again and looked, and behold, four chariots were going out from between the two mountains; and the mountains were bronze mountains.
verses.textEn: I looked up again, and there before me were four chariots coming out from between two mountains—mountains of bronze.

verses.textZh: 第一辆战车套着红马，第二辆套着黑马，
verses.textZhCnvs: 第一辆战车套着红马，第二辆套着黑马，
verses.textZhCuv: 第一辆车套着红马，第二辆车套着黑马。
verses.textEnNiv: The first chariot had red horses, the second black,
verses.textEnEsv: The first chariot had red horses, the second black horses,
verses.textEnNkjv: With the first chariot were red horses, with the second chariot black horses,
verses.textEnNlt: The first chariot was pulled by red horses, the second by black horses,
verses.textEnNasb: With the first chariot were red horses, with the second chariot black horses,
verses.textEn: The first chariot had red horses, the second black,

verses.textZh: 第三辆套着白马，第四辆套着有斑点的马；这些马都很雄壮。
verses.textZhCnvs: 第三辆套着白马，第四辆套着有斑点的马；这些马都很雄壮。
verses.textZhCuv: 第三辆车套着白马，第四辆车套着有斑点的壮马。
verses.textEnNiv: the third white, and the fourth dappled—all of them powerful.
verses.textEnEsv: the third white horses, and the fourth chariot dappled horses—all of them strong.
verses.textEnNkjv: with the third chariot white horses, and with the fourth chariot dappled horses—strong steeds.
verses.textEnNlt: the third by white horses, and the fourth by powerful dappled-gray horses.
verses.textEnNasb: with the third chariot white horses, and with the fourth chariot strong spotted horses.
verses.textEn: the third white, and the fourth dappled—all of them powerful.

verses.textZh: 于是我问那与我说话的天使："我主啊，这些是甚么意思？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是我问那与我说话的天使："我主啊，这些是甚么意思？"
verses.textZhCuv: 我就问与我说话的天使说：「主啊，这是什么意思？」
verses.textEnNiv: I asked the angel who was speaking to me, "What are these, my lord?"
verses.textEnEsv: Then I answered and said to the angel who talked with me, "What are these, my lord?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Then I answered and said to the angel who talked with me, "What are these, my lord?"
verses.textEnNlt: "And what are these, my lord?" I asked the angel who was talking with me.
verses.textEnNasb: So I responded and said to the angel who was speaking with me, "What are these, my lord?"
verses.textEn: I asked the angel who was speaking to me, "What are these, my lord?"

verses.textZh: 天使回答我："这些是天的四风 ，是从侍立在全地之主面前出来的。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 天使回答我："这些是天的四风 ，是从侍立在全地之主面前出来的。"
verses.textZhCuv: 天使回答我说：「这是天的四风，是从普天下的主面前出来的。」
verses.textEnNiv: The angel answered me, "These are the four spirits of heaven, going out from standing in the presence of the Lord of the whole world.
verses.textEnEsv: And the angel answered and said to me, "These are going out to the four winds of heaven, after presenting themselves before the Lord of all the earth.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the angel answered and said to me, "These are four spirits of heaven, who go out from their station before the Lord of all the earth.
verses.textEnNlt: The angel replied, "These are the four spirits of heaven who stand before the Lord of all the earth. They are going out to do his work.
verses.textEnNasb: The angel replied to me, "These are the four spirits of heaven, going out after taking their stand before the Lord of all the earth,
verses.textEn: The angel answered me, "These are the four spirits of heaven, going out from standing in the presence of the Lord of the whole world.

verses.textZh: 套着黑马的车出来，往北方之地去；套着白马的车出来，跟在牠们后面 ；套着有斑点的马的车出来，往南方之地去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 套着黑马的车出来，往北方之地去；套着白马的车出来，跟在牠们后面 ；套着有斑点的马的车出来，往南方之地去。
verses.textZhCuv: 套着黑马的车往北方去，白马跟随在后；有斑点的马往南方去。
verses.textEnNiv: The one with the black horses is going toward the north country, the one with the white horses toward the west, and the one with the dappled horses toward the south."
verses.textEnEsv: The chariot with the black horses goes toward the north country, the white ones go after them, and the dappled ones go toward the south country."
verses.textEnNkjv: The one with the black horses is going to the north country, the white are going after them, and the dappled are going toward the south country."
verses.textEnNlt: The chariot with black horses is going north, the chariot with white horses is going west, and the chariot with dappled-gray horses is going south."
verses.textEnNasb: with one of which the black horses are going out to the north country; and the white ones are to go out after them, while the spotted ones are to go out to the south country."
verses.textEn: The one with the black horses is going toward the north country, the one with the white horses toward the west, and the one with the dappled horses toward the south."

verses.textZh: 这些雄壮的马出来，切望在全地走遍各处；天使说："你们去吧，只管在全地走遍各处。"牠们就在全地走遍各处。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这些雄壮的马出来，切望在全地走遍各处；天使说："你们去吧，只管在全地走遍各处。"牠们就在全地走遍各处。
verses.textZhCuv: 壮马出来，要在遍地走来走去。天使说：「你们只管在遍地走来走去。」它们就照样行了。
verses.textEnNiv: When the powerful horses went out, they were straining to go throughout the earth. And he said, "Go throughout the earth!" So they went throughout the earth.
verses.textEnEsv: When the strong horses came out, they were impatient to go and patrol the earth. And he said, "Go, patrol the earth." So they patrolled the earth.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the strong steeds went out, eager to go, that they might walk to and fro throughout the earth. And He said, "Go, walk to and fro throughout the earth." So they walked to and fro throughout the earth.
verses.textEnNlt: The powerful horses were eager to set out to patrol the earth. And the Lord said, "Go and patrol the earth!" So they left at once on their patrol.
verses.textEnNasb: When the strong ones went out, they were eager to go to patrol the earth. And He said, "Go, patrol the earth." So they patrolled the earth.
verses.textEn: When the powerful horses went out, they were straining to go throughout the earth. And he said, "Go throughout the earth!" So they went throughout the earth.

verses.textZh: 他又呼唤我，对我说："你看，那些出来往北方之地去的，已经在北方之地使我心灵的忿怒平息下来。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他又呼唤我，对我说："你看，那些出来往北方之地去的，已经在北方之地使我心灵的忿怒平息下来。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他又呼叫我说：「看哪，往北方去的已在北方安慰我的心。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then he called to me, "Look, those going toward the north country have given my Spirit rest in the land of the north."
verses.textEnEsv: Then he cried to me, "Behold, those who go toward the north country have set my Spirit at rest in the north country."
verses.textEnNkjv: And He called to me, and spoke to me, saying, "See, those who go toward the north country have given rest to My Spirit in the north country."
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Lord summoned me and said, "Look, those who went north have vented the anger of my Spirit there in the land of the north."
verses.textEnNasb: Then He called out to me and spoke to me, saying, "See, those who are going to the land of the north have appeased My wrath in the land of the north."
verses.textEn: Then he called to me, "Look, those going toward the north country have given my Spirit rest in the land of the north."

verses.textZh: 耶和华的话临到我，说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华的话临到我，说：
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华的话临到我说：
verses.textEnNiv: The word of the Lord came to me:
verses.textEnEsv: And the word of the Lord came to me:
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the word of the Lord came to me, saying:
verses.textEnNlt: Then I received another message from the Lord :
verses.textEnNasb: The word of the Lord also came to me, saying,
verses.textEn: The word of the Lord came to me:

verses.textZh: "你要从黑玳、多比雅和耶大雅手中收取被掳的人奉献的金银；他们已经从巴比伦回来了。你要即日去，进入西番雅的儿子约西亚的家里。
verses.textZhCnvs: "你要从黑玳、多比雅和耶大雅手中收取被掳的人奉献的金银；他们已经从巴比伦回来了。你要即日去，进入西番雅的儿子约西亚的家里。
verses.textZhCuv: 「你要从被掳之人中取黑玳、多比雅、耶大雅的金银。这三人是从巴比伦来到西番雅的儿子约西亚的家里。当日你要进他的家，
verses.textEnNiv: "Take silver and gold from the exiles Heldai, Tobijah and Jedaiah, who have arrived from Babylon. Go the same day to the house of Josiah son of Zephaniah.
verses.textEnEsv: "Take from the exiles Heldai, Tobijah, and Jedaiah, who have arrived from Babylon, and go the same day to the house of Josiah, the son of Zephaniah.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Receive thegift from the captives—from Heldai, Tobijah, and Jedaiah, who have come from Babylon—and go the same day and enter the house of Josiah the son of Zephaniah.
verses.textEnNlt: "Heldai, Tobijah, and Jedaiah will bring gifts of silver and gold from the Jews exiled in Babylon. As soon as they arrive, meet them at the home of Josiah son of Zephaniah.
verses.textEnNasb: "Take an offering from the exiles, from Heldai, Tobijah, and Jedaiah; and you shall go the same day and enter the house of Josiah the son of Zephaniah, where they have arrived from Babylon.
verses.textEn: "Take silver and gold from the exiles Heldai, Tobijah and Jedaiah, who have arrived from Babylon. Go the same day to the house of Josiah son of Zephaniah.

verses.textZh: 你要拿这金银来做冠冕，戴在约撒答的儿子大祭司约书亚的头上，
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要拿这金银来做冠冕，戴在约撒答的儿子大祭司约书亚的头上，
verses.textZhCuv: 取这金银做冠冕，戴在约撒答的儿子大祭司约书亚的头上，
verses.textEnNiv: Take the silver and gold and make a crown, and set it on the head of the high priest, Joshua son of Jozadak.
verses.textEnEsv: Take from them silver and gold, and make a crown, and set it on the head of Joshua, the son of Jehozadak, the high priest.
verses.textEnNkjv: Take the silver and gold, make an elaborate crown, and set it on the head of Joshua the son of Jehozadak, the high priest.
verses.textEnNlt: Accept their gifts, and make a crown from the silver and gold. Then put the crown on the head of Jeshua son of Jehozadak, the high priest.
verses.textEnNasb: Also take silver and gold, make an ornate crown, and set it on the head of Joshua the son of Jehozadak, the high priest.
verses.textEn: Take the silver and gold and make a crown, and set it on the head of the high priest, Joshua son of Jozadak.

verses.textZh: 告诉他说：‘万军之耶和华这样说：看哪！有一个人名叫大卫的苗裔，他必从自己的地方生长起来，并要建造耶和华的殿。
verses.textZhCnvs: 告诉他说：‘万军之耶和华这样说：看哪！有一个人名叫大卫的苗裔，他必从自己的地方生长起来，并要建造耶和华的殿。
verses.textZhCuv: 对他说，万军之耶和华如此说：看哪，那名称为大卫苗裔的，他要在本处长起来，并要建造耶和华的殿。
verses.textEnNiv: Tell him this is what the Lord Almighty says: ‘Here is the man whose name is the Branch, and he will branch out from his place and build the temple of the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: And say to him, ‘Thus says the Lord of hosts, "Behold, the man whose name is the Branch: for he shall branch out from his place, and he shall build the temple of the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: Then speak to him, saying, ‘Thus says the Lord of hosts, saying: "Behold, the Man whose name is the BRANCH! From His place He shall branch out, And He shall build the temple of the Lord;
verses.textEnNlt: Tell him, ‘This is what the Lord of Heaven’s Armies says: Here is the man called the Branch. He will branch out from where he is and build the Temple of the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: Then say to him, ‘The Lord of armies says this: "Behold, there is a Man whose name is Branch, for He will branch out from where He is; and He will build the temple of the Lord.
verses.textEn: Tell him this is what the Lord Almighty says: ‘Here is the man whose name is the Branch, and he will branch out from his place and build the temple of the Lord .

verses.textZh: 他必建造耶和华的殿，必得尊荣；他必坐在宝座上执掌王权，又必在他的宝座上作祭司，使两者之间和谐共济。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他必建造耶和华的殿，必得尊荣；他必坐在宝座上执掌王权，又必在他的宝座上作祭司，使两者之间和谐共济。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 他要建造耶和华的殿，并担负尊荣，坐在位上掌王权；又必在位上作祭司，使两职之间筹定和平。
verses.textEnNiv: It is he who will build the temple of the Lord , and he will be clothed with majesty and will sit and rule on his throne. And he will be a priest on his throne. And there will be harmony between the two.’
verses.textEnEsv: It is he who shall build the temple of the Lord and shall bear royal honor, and shall sit and rule on his throne. And there shall be a priest on his throne, and the counsel of peace shall be between them both."’
verses.textEnNkjv: Yes, He shall build the temple of the Lord. He shall bear the glory, And shall sit and rule on His throne; So He shall be a priest on His throne, And the counsel of peace shall be between them both." ’
verses.textEnNlt: Yes, he will build the Temple of the Lord . Then he will receive royal honor and will rule as king from his throne. He will also serve as priest from his throne, and there will be perfect harmony between his two roles.’
verses.textEnNasb: Yes, it is He who will build the temple of the Lord, and He who will bear the majesty and sit and rule on His throne. So He will be a priest on His throne, and the counsel of peace will be between the two offices." ’
verses.textEn: It is he who will build the temple of the Lord , and he will be clothed with majesty and will sit and rule on his throne. And he will be a priest on his throne. And there will be harmony between the two.’

verses.textZh: 这冠冕要在耶和华的殿中给希连 、多比雅、耶大雅和西番雅的儿子贤 作记念。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这冠冕要在耶和华的殿中给希连 、多比雅、耶大雅和西番雅的儿子贤 作记念。
verses.textZhCuv: 这冠冕要归希连 、多比雅、耶大雅，和西番雅的儿子贤 ，放在耶和华的殿里为记念。」
verses.textEnNiv: The crown will be given to Heldai, Tobijah, Jedaiah and Hen son of Zephaniah as a memorial in the temple of the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: And the crown shall be in the temple of the Lord as a reminder to Helem, Tobijah, Jedaiah, and Hen the son of Zephaniah.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Now the elaborate crown shall be for a memorial in the temple of the Lord for Helem, Tobijah, Jedaiah, and Hen the son of Zephaniah.
verses.textEnNlt: "The crown will be a memorial in the Temple of the Lord to honor those who gave it—Heldai, Tobijah, Jedaiah, and Josiah son of Zephaniah."
verses.textEnNasb: Now the crown will become a reminder in the temple of the Lord to Helem, Tobijah, Jedaiah, and Hen the son of Zephaniah.
verses.textEn: The crown will be given to Heldai, Tobijah, Jedaiah and Hen son of Zephaniah as a memorial in the temple of the Lord .

verses.textZh: 远方的人也要来建造耶和华的殿，你们就知道万军之耶和华差遣了我到你们这里来。你们若留心听从耶和华你们神的话，这事必定成就。
verses.textZhCnvs: 远方的人也要来建造耶和华的殿，你们就知道万军之耶和华差遣了我到你们这里来。你们若留心听从耶和华你们神的话，这事必定成就。
verses.textZhCuv: 远方的人也要来建造耶和华的殿，你们就知道万军之耶和华差遣我到你们这里来。你们若留意听从耶和华－你们神的话，这事必然成就。
verses.textEnNiv: Those who are far away will come and help to build the temple of the Lord , and you will know that the Lord Almighty has sent me to you. This will happen if you diligently obey the Lord your God."
verses.textEnEsv: "And those who are far off shall come and help to build the temple of the Lord . And you shall know that the Lord of hosts has sent me to you. And this shall come to pass, if you will diligently obey the voice of the Lord your God."
verses.textEnNkjv: Even those from afar shall come and build the temple of the Lord. Then you shall know that the Lord of hosts has sent Me to you. And this shall come to pass if you diligently obey the voice of the Lord your God."
verses.textEnNlt: People will come from distant lands to rebuild the Temple of the Lord . And when this happens, you will know that my messages have been from the Lord of Heaven’s Armies. All this will happen if you carefully obey what the Lord your God says.
verses.textEnNasb: Those who are far away will come and build the temple of the Lord." Then you will know that the Lord of armies has sent me to you. And it will take place if you completely obey the Lord your God.
verses.textEn: Those who are far away will come and help to build the temple of the Lord , and you will know that the Lord Almighty has sent me to you. This will happen if you diligently obey the Lord your God."

verses.textZh: 大利乌王第四年九月，就是基斯流月初四日，耶和华的话临到撒迦利亚。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大利乌王第四年九月，就是基斯流月初四日，耶和华的话临到撒迦利亚。
verses.textZhCuv: 大流士王第四年九月，就是基斯流月初四日，耶和华的话临到撒迦利亚。
verses.textEnNiv: In the fourth year of King Darius, the word of the Lord came to Zechariah on the fourth day of the ninth month, the month of Kislev.
verses.textEnEsv: In the fourth year of King Darius, the word of the Lord came to Zechariah on the fourth day of the ninth month, which is Chislev.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now in the fourth year of King Darius it came to pass that the word of the Lord came to Zechariah, on the fourth day of the ninth month, Chislev,
verses.textEnNlt: On December 7 of the fourth year of King Darius’s reign, another message came to Zechariah from the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: In the fourth year of King Darius, the word of the Lord came to Zechariah on the fourth day of the ninth month, which is Chislev.
verses.textEn: In the fourth year of King Darius, the word of the Lord came to Zechariah on the fourth day of the ninth month, the month of Kislev.

verses.textZh: 那时，伯特利人差派了沙利色、利坚米勒和他的随从，去恳求耶和华施恩。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，伯特利人差派了沙利色、利坚米勒和他的随从，去恳求耶和华施恩。
verses.textZhCuv: 那时伯特利人已经打发沙利色和利坚米勒，并跟从他们的人，去恳求耶和华的恩，
verses.textEnNiv: The people of Bethel had sent Sharezer and Regem-Melek, together with their men, to entreat the Lord
verses.textEnEsv: Now the people of Bethel had sent Sharezer and Regem-melech and their men to entreat the favor of the Lord ,
verses.textEnNkjv: when thepeople sent Sherezer, with Regem-Melech and his men, to the house of God, to pray before the Lord,
verses.textEnNlt: The people of Bethel had sent Sharezer and Regemmelech, along with their attendants, to seek the Lord ’s favor.
verses.textEnNasb: Now the town of Bethel had sent Sharezer and Regemmelech and their men to seek the favor of the Lord,
verses.textEn: The people of Bethel had sent Sharezer and Regem-Melek, together with their men, to entreat the Lord

verses.textZh: 他们询问万军之耶和华殿里的众祭司，以及众先知说："我们还要在五月哭泣和禁食，像我们这许多年来所行的吗？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们询问万军之耶和华殿里的众祭司，以及众先知说："我们还要在五月哭泣和禁食，像我们这许多年来所行的吗？"
verses.textZhCuv: 并问万军之耶和华殿中的祭司和先知说：「我历年以来，在五月间哭泣斋戒，现在还当这样行吗？」
verses.textEnNiv: by asking the priests of the house of the Lord Almighty and the prophets, "Should I mourn and fast in the fifth month, as I have done for so many years?"
verses.textEnEsv: saying to the priests of the house of the Lord of hosts and the prophets, "Should I weep and abstain in the fifth month, as I have done for so many years?"
verses.textEnNkjv: and to ask the priests who were in the house of the Lord of hosts, and the prophets, saying, "Should I weep in the fifth month and fast as I have done for so many years?"
verses.textEnNlt: They were to ask this question of the prophets and the priests at the Temple of the Lord of Heaven’s Armies: "Should we continue to mourn and fast each summer on the anniversary of the Temple’s destruction, as we have done for so many years?"
verses.textEnNasb: speaking to the priests who belong to the house of the Lord of armies, and to the prophets, saying, "Shall I weep in the fifth month and fast, as I have done these many years?"
verses.textEn: by asking the priests of the house of the Lord Almighty and the prophets, "Should I mourn and fast in the fifth month, as I have done for so many years?"

verses.textZh: 万军之耶和华的话临到我，说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 万军之耶和华的话临到我，说：
verses.textZhCuv: 万军之耶和华的话就临到我说：
verses.textEnNiv: Then the word of the Lord Almighty came to me:
verses.textEnEsv: Then the word of the Lord of hosts came to me:
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the word of the Lord of hosts came to me, saying,
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord of Heaven’s Armies sent me this message in reply:
verses.textEnNasb: Then the word of the Lord of armies came to me, saying,
verses.textEn: Then the word of the Lord Almighty came to me:

verses.textZh: "你要告诉这地的人民和祭司说：‘这七十年来，你们在五月和七月禁食哀哭，岂是真的为我禁食呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: "你要告诉这地的人民和祭司说：‘这七十年来，你们在五月和七月禁食哀哭，岂是真的为我禁食呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 「你要宣告国内的众民和祭司，说：『你们这七十年，在五月、七月禁食悲哀，岂是丝毫向我禁食吗？
verses.textEnNiv: "Ask all the people of the land and the priests, ‘When you fasted and mourned in the fifth and seventh months for the past seventy years, was it really for me that you fasted?
verses.textEnEsv: "Say to all the people of the land and the priests, ‘When you fasted and mourned in the fifth month and in the seventh, for these seventy years, was it for me that you fasted?
verses.textEnNkjv: "Say to all the people of the land, and to the priests: ‘When you fasted and mourned in the fifth and seventh months during those seventy years, did you really fast for Me—for Me?
verses.textEnNlt: "Say to all your people and your priests, ‘During these seventy years of exile, when you fasted and mourned in the summer and in early autumn, was it really for me that you were fasting?
verses.textEnNasb: "Say to all the people of the land and to the priests, ‘When you fasted and mourned in the fifth and seventh months these seventy years, was it actually for Me that you fasted?
verses.textEn: "Ask all the people of the land and the priests, ‘When you fasted and mourned in the fifth and seventh months for the past seventy years, was it really for me that you fasted?

verses.textZh: 你们吃，你们喝，岂不是为你们自己吃，为你们自己喝吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们吃，你们喝，岂不是为你们自己吃，为你们自己喝吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 你们吃喝，不是为自己吃，为自己喝吗？
verses.textEnNiv: And when you were eating and drinking, were you not just feasting for yourselves?
verses.textEnEsv: And when you eat and when you drink, do you not eat for yourselves and drink for yourselves?
verses.textEnNkjv: When you eat and when you drink, do you not eat and drink foryourselves?
verses.textEnNlt: And even now in your holy festivals, aren’t you eating and drinking just to please yourselves?
verses.textEnNasb: And when you eat and drink, do you not eat for yourselves and drink for yourselves?
verses.textEn: And when you were eating and drinking, were you not just feasting for yourselves?

verses.textZh: 这些话耶和华不是曾借着从前的先知宣告了吗？那时，耶路撒冷和四围的城镇都有人居住，很是兴旺，南地和高地都有人居住。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 这些话耶和华不是曾借着从前的先知宣告了吗？那时，耶路撒冷和四围的城镇都有人居住，很是兴旺，南地和高地都有人居住。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 当耶路撒冷和四围的城邑有居民，正兴盛，南地高原有人居住的时候，耶和华藉从前的先知所宣告的话，你们不当听吗？』」
verses.textEnNiv: Are these not the words the Lord proclaimed through the earlier prophets when Jerusalem and its surrounding towns were at rest and prosperous, and the Negev and the western foothills were settled?’ "
verses.textEnEsv: Were not these the words that the Lord proclaimed by the former prophets, when Jerusalem was inhabited and prosperous, with her cities around her, and the South and the lowland were inhabited?’"
verses.textEnNkjv: Shouldyou not haveobeyed the words which the Lord proclaimed through the former prophets when Jerusalem and the cities around it were inhabited and prosperous, and the South and the Lowland were inhabited?’ "
verses.textEnNlt: Isn’t this the same message the Lord proclaimed through the prophets in years past when Jerusalem and the towns of Judah were bustling with people, and the Negev and the foothills of Judah were well populated?’"
verses.textEnNasb: Are these not the words which the Lord proclaimed by the former prophets, when Jerusalem was inhabited and carefree along with its cities around it, and the Negev and the foothills were inhabited?’ "
verses.textEn: Are these not the words the Lord proclaimed through the earlier prophets when Jerusalem and its surrounding towns were at rest and prosperous, and the Negev and the western foothills were settled?’ "

verses.textZh: 耶和华的话又临到撒迦利亚说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华的话又临到撒迦利亚说：

verses.textEnNiv: And the word of the Lord came again to Zechariah:
