verses.textEnEsv: And the word of the Lord came to Zechariah, saying,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the word of the Lord came to Zechariah, saying,
verses.textEnNlt: Then this message came to Zechariah from the Lord :
verses.textEnNasb: Then the word of the Lord came to Zechariah, saying,
verses.textEn: And the word of the Lord came again to Zechariah:

verses.textZh: "万军之耶和华曾这样告诉你们的列祖说：‘你们要执法公正，各人要以慈爱和怜悯待自己的兄弟。
verses.textZhCnvs: "万军之耶和华曾这样告诉你们的列祖说：‘你们要执法公正，各人要以慈爱和怜悯待自己的兄弟。
verses.textZhCuv: 「万军之耶和华曾对你们的列祖如此说：『要按至理判断，各人以慈爱怜悯弟兄。
verses.textEnNiv: "This is what the Lord Almighty said: ‘Administer true justice; show mercy and compassion to one another.
verses.textEnEsv: "Thus says the Lord of hosts, Render true judgments, show kindness and mercy to one another,
verses.textEnNkjv: "Thus says the Lord of hosts: ‘Execute true justice, Show mercy and compassion Everyone to his brother.
verses.textEnNlt: "This is what the Lord of Heaven’s Armies says: Judge fairly, and show mercy and kindness to one another.
verses.textEnNasb: "This is what the Lord of armies has said: ‘Dispense true justice and practice kindness and compassion each to his brother;
verses.textEn: "This is what the Lord Almighty said: ‘Administer true justice; show mercy and compassion to one another.

verses.textZh: 寡妇、孤儿、寄居的和贫穷人，你们都不可欺压，也不可各自心里图谋恶事，陷害自己的兄弟。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 寡妇、孤儿、寄居的和贫穷人，你们都不可欺压，也不可各自心里图谋恶事，陷害自己的兄弟。’
verses.textZhCuv: 不可欺压寡妇、孤儿、寄居的，和贫穷人。谁都不可心里谋害弟兄。』」
verses.textEnNiv: Do not oppress the widow or the fatherless, the foreigner or the poor. Do not plot evil against each other.’
verses.textEnEsv: do not oppress the widow, the fatherless, the sojourner, or the poor, and let none of you devise evil against another in your heart."
verses.textEnNkjv: Do not oppress the widow or the fatherless, The alien or the poor. Let none of you plan evil in his heart Against his brother.’
verses.textEnNlt: Do not oppress widows, orphans, foreigners, and the poor. And do not scheme against each other.
verses.textEnNasb: and do not oppress the widow or the orphan, the stranger or the poor; and do not devise evil in your hearts against one another.’
verses.textEn: Do not oppress the widow or the fatherless, the foreigner or the poor. Do not plot evil against each other.’

verses.textZh: 但他们不肯听从，反而硬着颈项，充耳不闻 。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但他们不肯听从，反而硬着颈项，充耳不闻 。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们却不肯听从，扭转肩头，塞耳不听，
verses.textEnNiv: "But they refused to pay attention; stubbornly they turned their backs and covered their ears.
verses.textEnEsv: But they refused to pay attention and turned a stubborn shoulder and stopped their ears that they might not hear.
verses.textEnNkjv: "But they refused to heed, shrugged their shoulders, and stopped their ears so that they could not hear.
verses.textEnNlt: "Your ancestors refused to listen to this message. They stubbornly turned away and put their fingers in their ears to keep from hearing.
verses.textEnNasb: But they refused to pay attention, and turned a stubborn shoulder and plugged their ears from hearing.
verses.textEn: "But they refused to pay attention; stubbornly they turned their backs and covered their ears.

verses.textZh: 他们使自己的心刚硬如金钢石，不肯听从律法和万军之耶和华借着他的灵、透过从前的先知所说的话。因此，万军之耶和华非常忿怒。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们使自己的心刚硬如金钢石，不肯听从律法和万军之耶和华借着他的灵、透过从前的先知所说的话。因此，万军之耶和华非常忿怒。
verses.textZhCuv: 使心硬如金钢石，不听律法和万军之耶和华用灵藉从前的先知所说的话。故此，万军之耶和华大发烈怒。
verses.textEnNiv: They made their hearts as hard as flint and would not listen to the law or to the words that the Lord Almighty had sent by his Spirit through the earlier prophets. So the Lord Almighty was very angry.
verses.textEnEsv: They made their hearts diamond-hard lest they should hear the law and the words that the Lord of hosts had sent by his Spirit through the former prophets. Therefore great anger came from the Lord of hosts.
verses.textEnNkjv: Yes, they made their hearts like flint, refusing to hear the law and the words which the Lord of hosts had sent by His Spirit through the former prophets. Thus great wrath came from the Lord of hosts.
verses.textEnNlt: They made their hearts as hard as stone, so they could not hear the instructions or the messages that the Lord of Heaven’s Armies had sent them by his Spirit through the earlier prophets. That is why the Lord of Heaven’s Armies was so angry with them.
verses.textEnNasb: They also made their hearts as hard as a diamond so that they could not hear the Law and the words which the Lord of armies had sent by His Spirit through the former prophets; therefore great wrath came from the Lord of armies.
verses.textEn: They made their hearts as hard as flint and would not listen to the law or to the words that the Lord Almighty had sent by his Spirit through the earlier prophets. So the Lord Almighty was very angry.

verses.textZh: 我曾呼唤他们，他们不听；照样，将来他们呼求我，我也不听。这是万军之耶和华说的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我曾呼唤他们，他们不听；照样，将来他们呼求我，我也不听。这是万军之耶和华说的。
verses.textZhCuv: 万军之耶和华说：「我曾呼唤他们，他们不听；将来他们呼求我，我也不听！
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘When I called, they did not listen; so when they called, I would not listen,’ says the Lord Almighty.
verses.textEnEsv: "As I called, and they would not hear, so they called, and I would not hear," says the Lord of hosts,
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore it happened, that just as He proclaimed and they would not hear, so they called out and I would not listen," says the Lord of hosts.
verses.textEnNlt: "Since they refused to listen when I called to them, I would not listen when they called to me, says the Lord of Heaven’s Armies.
verses.textEnNasb: And just as He called and they would not listen, so they called and I would not listen," says the Lord of armies;
verses.textEn: " ‘When I called, they did not listen; so when they called, I would not listen,’ says the Lord Almighty.

verses.textZh: 我用旋风把他们吹散到他们不认识的列国去，他们留下的地就荒凉了，以致无人来往经过，因为他们使这美好之地变为荒凉了。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我用旋风把他们吹散到他们不认识的列国去，他们留下的地就荒凉了，以致无人来往经过，因为他们使这美好之地变为荒凉了。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我必以旋风吹散他们到素不认识的万国中。这样，他们的地就荒凉，甚至无人来往经过，因为他们使美好之地荒凉了。」
verses.textEnNiv: ‘I scattered them with a whirlwind among all the nations, where they were strangers. The land they left behind them was so desolate that no one traveled through it. This is how they made the pleasant land desolate.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: "and I scattered them with a whirlwind among all the nations that they had not known. Thus the land they left was desolate, so that no one went to and fro, and the pleasant land was made desolate."
verses.textEnNkjv: "But I scattered them with a whirlwind among all the nations which they had not known. Thus the land became desolate after them, so that no one passed through or returned; for they made the pleasant land desolate."
verses.textEnNlt: As with a whirlwind, I scattered them among the distant nations, where they lived as strangers. Their land became so desolate that no one even traveled through it. They turned their pleasant land into a desert."
verses.textEnNasb: "but I scattered them with a storm wind among all the nations whom they did not know. So the land was desolated behind them so that no one went back and forth, since they made the pleasant land desolate."
verses.textEn: ‘I scattered them with a whirlwind among all the nations, where they were strangers. The land they left behind them was so desolate that no one traveled through it. This is how they made the pleasant land desolate.’ "

verses.textZh: 万军之耶和华的话临到我说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 万军之耶和华的话临到我说：
verses.textZhCuv: 万军之耶和华的话临到我说：
verses.textEnNiv: The word of the Lord Almighty came to me.
verses.textEnEsv: And the word of the Lord of hosts came, saying,
verses.textEnNkjv: Again the word of the Lord of hosts came, saying,
verses.textEnNlt: Then another message came to me from the Lord of Heaven’s Armies:
verses.textEnNasb: Then the word of the Lord of armies came, saying,
verses.textEn: The word of the Lord Almighty came to me.

verses.textZh: "万军之耶和华这样说：‘我十分热爱锡安；我为锡安大发烈怒。’
verses.textZhCnvs: "万军之耶和华这样说：‘我十分热爱锡安；我为锡安大发烈怒。’
verses.textZhCuv: 「万军之耶和华如此说：我为锡安心里极其火热，我为她火热，向她的仇敌发烈怒。
verses.textEnNiv: This is what the Lord Almighty says: "I am very jealous for Zion; I am burning with jealousy for her."
verses.textEnEsv: "Thus says the Lord of hosts: I am jealous for Zion with great jealousy, and I am jealous for her with great wrath.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Thus says the Lord of hosts: ‘I am zealous for Zion with great zeal; With great fervor I am zealous for her.’
verses.textEnNlt: "This is what the Lord of Heaven’s Armies says: My love for Mount Zion is passionate and strong; I am consumed with passion for Jerusalem!
verses.textEnNasb: "The Lord of armies says this: ‘I am exceedingly jealous for Zion, yes, with great wrath I am jealous for her.’
verses.textEn: This is what the Lord Almighty says: "I am very jealous for Zion; I am burning with jealousy for her."

verses.textZh: 耶和华这样说：‘我要返回锡安，住在耶路撒冷里面；耶路撒冷必称为"信实之城"，万军之耶和华的山必称为"圣山"。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华这样说：‘我要返回锡安，住在耶路撒冷里面；耶路撒冷必称为"信实之城"，万军之耶和华的山必称为"圣山"。’
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华如此说：我现在回到锡安，要住在耶路撒冷中。耶路撒冷必称为诚实的城，万军之耶和华的山必称为圣山。
verses.textEnNiv: This is what the Lord says: "I will return to Zion and dwell in Jerusalem. Then Jerusalem will be called the Faithful City, and the mountain of the Lord Almighty will be called the Holy Mountain."
verses.textEnEsv: Thus says the Lord : I have returned to Zion and will dwell in the midst of Jerusalem, and Jerusalem shall be called the faithful city, and the mountain of the Lord of hosts, the holy mountain.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Thus says the Lord: ‘I will return to Zion, And dwell in the midst of Jerusalem. Jerusalem shall be called the City of Truth, The Mountain of the Lord of hosts, The Holy Mountain.’
verses.textEnNlt: "And now the Lord says: I am returning to Mount Zion, and I will live in Jerusalem. Then Jerusalem will be called the Faithful City; the mountain of the Lord of Heaven’s Armies will be called the Holy Mountain.
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord says this: ‘I will return to Zion and dwell in the midst of Jerusalem. Then Jerusalem will be called the City of Truth, and the mountain of the Lord of armies will be called the Holy Mountain.’
verses.textEn: This is what the Lord says: "I will return to Zion and dwell in Jerusalem. Then Jerusalem will be called the Faithful City, and the mountain of the Lord Almighty will be called the Holy Mountain."

verses.textZh: "万军之耶和华这样说：‘年老的男女必再坐在耶路撒冷的街上；他们因为年纪老迈，各人都手拿拐杖。
verses.textZhCnvs: "万军之耶和华这样说：‘年老的男女必再坐在耶路撒冷的街上；他们因为年纪老迈，各人都手拿拐杖。
verses.textZhCuv: 万军之耶和华如此说：将来必有年老的男女坐在耶路撒冷街上，因为年纪老迈就手拿拐杖。
verses.textEnNiv: This is what the Lord Almighty says: "Once again men and women of ripe old age will sit in the streets of Jerusalem, each of them with cane in hand because of their age.
verses.textEnEsv: Thus says the Lord of hosts: Old men and old women shall again sit in the streets of Jerusalem, each with staff in hand because of great age.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Thus says the Lord of hosts: ‘Old men and old women shall again sit In the streets of Jerusalem, Each one with his staff in his hand Because of great age.
verses.textEnNlt: "This is what the Lord of Heaven’s Armies says: Once again old men and women will walk Jerusalem’s streets with their canes and will sit together in the city squares.
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord of armies says this: ‘Old men and old women will again sit in the public squares of Jerusalem, each person with his staff in his hand because of age.
verses.textEn: This is what the Lord Almighty says: "Once again men and women of ripe old age will sit in the streets of Jerusalem, each of them with cane in hand because of their age.

verses.textZh: 城里的街上必满了男孩女孩，在街上嬉戏。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 城里的街上必满了男孩女孩，在街上嬉戏。’
verses.textZhCuv: 城中街上必满有男孩女孩玩耍。
verses.textEnNiv: The city streets will be filled with boys and girls playing there."
verses.textEnEsv: And the streets of the city shall be full of boys and girls playing in its streets.
verses.textEnNkjv: The streets of the city Shall be full of boys and girls Playing in its streets.’
verses.textEnNlt: And the streets of the city will be filled with boys and girls at play.
verses.textEnNasb: And the public squares of the city will be filled with boys and girls playing in its squares.’
verses.textEn: The city streets will be filled with boys and girls playing there."

verses.textZh: "万军之耶和华这样说：‘在那些日子，这事在这余剩的子民眼中被视为不可能的奇迹，在我眼中也视为不可能吗？’这是万军之耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: "万军之耶和华这样说：‘在那些日子，这事在这余剩的子民眼中被视为不可能的奇迹，在我眼中也视为不可能吗？’这是万军之耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 万军之耶和华如此说：到那日，这事在余剩的民眼中看为希奇，在我眼中也看为希奇吗？这是万军之耶和华说的。
verses.textEnNiv: This is what the Lord Almighty says: "It may seem marvelous to the remnant of this people at that time, but will it seem marvelous to me?" declares the Lord Almighty.
verses.textEnEsv: Thus says the Lord of hosts: If it is marvelous in the sight of the remnant of this people in those days, should it also be marvelous in my sight, declares the Lord of hosts?
verses.textEnNkjv: "Thus says the Lord of hosts: ‘If it is marvelous in the eyes of the remnant of this people in these days, Will it also be marvelous in My eyes?’ Says the Lord of hosts.
verses.textEnNlt: "This is what the Lord of Heaven’s Armies says: All this may seem impossible to you now, a small remnant of God’s people. But is it impossible for me? says the Lord of Heaven’s Armies.
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord of armies says this: ‘If it is too difficult in the sight of the remnant of this people in those days, will it also be too difficult in My sight?’ declares the Lord of armies.
verses.textEn: This is what the Lord Almighty says: "It may seem marvelous to the remnant of this people at that time, but will it seem marvelous to me?" declares the Lord Almighty.

verses.textZh: "万军之耶和华这样说：‘看哪！我必从日出之地和日落之地拯救我的子民。
verses.textZhCnvs: "万军之耶和华这样说：‘看哪！我必从日出之地和日落之地拯救我的子民。
verses.textZhCuv: 万军之耶和华如此说：我要从东方从西方救回我的民。
verses.textEnNiv: This is what the Lord Almighty says: "I will save my people from the countries of the east and the west.
verses.textEnEsv: Thus says the Lord of hosts: Behold, I will save my people from the east country and from the west country,
verses.textEnNkjv: "Thus says the Lord of hosts: ‘Behold, I will save My people from the land of the east And from the land of the west;
verses.textEnNlt: "This is what the Lord of Heaven’s Armies says: You can be sure that I will rescue my people from the east and from the west.
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord of armies says this: ‘Behold, I am going to save My people from the land of the east and from the land of the west;
verses.textEn: This is what the Lord Almighty says: "I will save my people from the countries of the east and the west.

verses.textZh: 我要把他们领回来，让他们住在耶路撒冷；他们要作我的子民，我也要凭着信实和公义作他们的神。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 我要把他们领回来，让他们住在耶路撒冷；他们要作我的子民，我也要凭着信实和公义作他们的神。’
verses.textZhCuv: 我要领他们来，使他们住在耶路撒冷中。他们要作我的子民，我要作他们的神，都凭诚实和公义。」
verses.textEnNiv: I will bring them back to live in Jerusalem; they will be my people, and I will be faithful and righteous to them as their God."
verses.textEnEsv: and I will bring them to dwell in the midst of Jerusalem. And they shall be my people, and I will be their God, in faithfulness and in righteousness."
verses.textEnNkjv: I will bring them back, And they shall dwell in the midst of Jerusalem. They shall be My people And I will be their God, In truth and righteousness.’
verses.textEnNlt: I will bring them home again to live safely in Jerusalem. They will be my people, and I will be faithful and just toward them as their God.
verses.textEnNasb: and I will bring them back and they will live in the midst of Jerusalem; and they shall be My people, and I will be their God in truth and righteousness.’
verses.textEn: I will bring them back to live in Jerusalem; they will be my people, and I will be faithful and righteous to them as their God."

verses.textZh: "万军之耶和华这样说：‘在万军之耶和华的殿奠立了根基，预备建造的日子，你们这些在当时听过众先知亲口宣告这些话的人，现在你们的手务要刚强。
verses.textZhCnvs: "万军之耶和华这样说：‘在万军之耶和华的殿奠立了根基，预备建造的日子，你们这些在当时听过众先知亲口宣告这些话的人，现在你们的手务要刚强。
verses.textZhCuv: 万军之耶和华如此说：「当建造万军之耶和华的殿，立根基之日的先知所说的话，现在你们听见，应当手里强壮。
verses.textEnNiv: This is what the Lord Almighty says: "Now hear these words, ‘Let your hands be strong so that the temple may be built.’ This is also what the prophets said who were present when the foundation was laid for the house of the Lord Almighty.
verses.textEnEsv: Thus says the Lord of hosts: "Let your hands be strong, you who in these days have been hearing these words from the mouth of the prophets who were present on the day that the foundation of the house of the Lord of hosts was laid, that the temple might be built.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Thus says the Lord of hosts: ‘Let your hands be strong, You who have been hearing in these days These words by the mouth of the prophets, Who spoke in the day the foundation was laid For the house of the Lord of hosts, That the temple might be built.
verses.textEnNlt: "This is what the Lord of Heaven’s Armies says: Be strong and finish the task! Ever since the laying of the foundation of the Temple of the Lord of Heaven’s Armies, you have heard what the prophets have been saying about completing the building.
verses.textEnNasb: "The Lord of armies says this: ‘Let your hands be strong, you who are listening in these days to these words from the mouth of the prophets, those who spoke in the day that the foundation of the house of the Lord of armies was laid, so that the temple might be built.
verses.textEn: This is what the Lord Almighty says: "Now hear these words, ‘Let your hands be strong so that the temple may be built.’ This is also what the prophets said who were present when the foundation was laid for the house of the Lord Almighty.

verses.textZh: 因为在那些日子以前，人作工是没有工价的，牲畜也是这样，并且因有敌人的缘故，人出入就没有平安，我也使众人互相攻击。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为在那些日子以前，人作工是没有工价的，牲畜也是这样，并且因有敌人的缘故，人出入就没有平安，我也使众人互相攻击。
verses.textZhCuv: 那日以先，人得不着雇价，牲畜也是如此；且因敌人的缘故，出入之人不得平安，乃因我使众人互相攻击。
verses.textEnNiv: Before that time there were no wages for people or hire for animals. No one could go about their business safely because of their enemies, since I had turned everyone against their neighbor.
verses.textEnEsv: For before those days there was no wage for man or any wage for beast, neither was there any safety from the foe for him who went out or came in, for I set every man against his neighbor.
verses.textEnNkjv: For before these days There were no wages for man nor any hire for beast; Therewas no peace from the enemy for whoever went out or came in; For I set all men, everyone, against his neighbor.
verses.textEnNlt: Before the work on the Temple began, there were no jobs and no money to hire people or animals. No traveler was safe from the enemy, for there were enemies on all sides. I had turned everyone against each other.
verses.textEnNasb: For before those days there was no wage for man nor any wage for animal; and for him who went out or came in there was no peace because of his enemies, and I sent all the people against one another.
verses.textEn: Before that time there were no wages for people or hire for animals. No one could go about their business safely because of their enemies, since I had turned everyone against their neighbor.

verses.textZh: 但现在我待这些余剩的子民必不像从前的日子那样 。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但现在我待这些余剩的子民必不像从前的日子那样 。
verses.textZhCuv: 但如今，我待这余剩的民必不像从前。这是万军之耶和华说的。
verses.textEnNiv: But now I will not deal with the remnant of this people as I did in the past," declares the Lord Almighty.
verses.textEnEsv: But now I will not deal with the remnant of this people as in the former days, declares the Lord of hosts.
verses.textEnNkjv: But now I will not treat the remnant of this people as in the former days,’ says the Lord of hosts.
verses.textEnNlt: "But now I will not treat the remnant of my people as I treated them before, says the Lord of Heaven’s Armies.
verses.textEnNasb: But now I will not treat the remnant of this people as in the former days,’ declares the Lord of armies.
verses.textEn: But now I will not deal with the remnant of this people as I did in the past," declares the Lord Almighty.

verses.textZh: 因为五谷必生长繁茂，葡萄树必结果子，地土必出土产，天也必降下甘露，我要使这些余剩的子民承受这一切。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为五谷必生长繁茂，葡萄树必结果子，地土必出土产，天也必降下甘露，我要使这些余剩的子民承受这一切。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为他们必平安撒种，葡萄树必结果子，地土必有出产，天也必降甘露。我要使这余剩的民享受这一切的福。
verses.textEnNiv: "The seed will grow well, the vine will yield its fruit, the ground will produce its crops, and the heavens will drop their dew. I will give all these things as an inheritance to the remnant of this people.
verses.textEnEsv: For there shall be a sowing of peace. The vine shall give its fruit, and the ground shall give its produce, and the heavens shall give their dew. And I will cause the remnant of this people to possess all these things.
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘For the seed shallbe prosperous, The vine shall give its fruit, The ground shall give her increase, And the heavens shall give their dew— I will cause the remnant of this people To possess all these.
verses.textEnNlt: For I am planting seeds of peace and prosperity among you. The grapevines will be heavy with fruit. The earth will produce its crops, and the heavens will release the dew. Once more I will cause the remnant in Judah and Israel to inherit these blessings.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘For there will be the seed of peace: the vine will yield its fruit, the land will yield its produce, and the heavens will provide their dew; and I will give to the remnant of this people all these things as an inheritance.
verses.textEn: "The seed will grow well, the vine will yield its fruit, the ground will produce its crops, and the heavens will drop their dew. I will give all these things as an inheritance to the remnant of this people.

verses.textZh: 犹大家和以色列家啊！你们从前怎样在万国中成为可咒诅的，将来，我也要怎样拯救你们，使你们成为祝福。你们不要惧怕，你们的手务要刚强。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 犹大家和以色列家啊！你们从前怎样在万国中成为可咒诅的，将来，我也要怎样拯救你们，使你们成为祝福。你们不要惧怕，你们的手务要刚强。’
verses.textZhCuv: 犹大家和以色列家啊，你们从前在列国中怎样成为可咒诅的；照样，我要拯救你们，使人称你们为有福的 。你们不要惧怕，手要强壮。」
verses.textEnNiv: Just as you, Judah and Israel, have been a curse among the nations, so I will save you, and you will be a blessing. Do not be afraid, but let your hands be strong."
verses.textEnEsv: And as you have been a byword of cursing among the nations, O house of Judah and house of Israel, so will I save you, and you shall be a blessing. Fear not, but let your hands be strong."
verses.textEnNkjv: And it shall come to pass That just as you were a curse among the nations, O house of Judah and house of Israel, So I will save you, and you shall be a blessing. Do not fear, Let your hands be strong.’
verses.textEnNlt: Among the other nations, Judah and Israel became symbols of a cursed nation. But no longer! Now I will rescue you and make you both a symbol and a source of blessing. So don’t be afraid. Be strong, and get on with rebuilding the Temple!
verses.textEnNasb: And it will come about that just as you were a curse among the nations, house of Judah and house of Israel, so I will save you that you may become a blessing. Do not fear; let your hands be strong.’
verses.textEn: Just as you, Judah and Israel, have been a curse among the nations, so I will save you, and you will be a blessing. Do not be afraid, but let your hands be strong."

verses.textZh: "万军之耶和华这样说：‘你们的列祖惹我发怒的时候，我曾定意降祸在你们身上，并没有改变心意 ；
verses.textZhCnvs: "万军之耶和华这样说：‘你们的列祖惹我发怒的时候，我曾定意降祸在你们身上，并没有改变心意 ；
verses.textZhCuv: 万军之耶和华如此说：「你们列祖惹我发怒的时候，我怎样定意降祸，并不后悔。
verses.textEnNiv: This is what the Lord Almighty says: "Just as I had determined to bring disaster on you and showed no pity when your ancestors angered me," says the Lord Almighty,
verses.textEnEsv: For thus says the Lord of hosts: "As I purposed to bring disaster to you when your fathers provoked me to wrath, and I did not relent, says the Lord of hosts,
verses.textEnNkjv: "For thus says the Lord of hosts: ‘Just as I determined to punish you When your fathers provoked Me to wrath,’ Says the Lord of hosts, ‘And I would not relent,
verses.textEnNlt: "For this is what the Lord of Heaven’s Armies says: I was determined to punish you when your ancestors angered me, and I did not change my mind, says the Lord of Heaven’s Armies.
verses.textEnNasb: "For this is what the Lord of armies says: ‘Just as I determined to do harm to you when your fathers provoked Me to anger,’ says the Lord of armies, ‘and I have not relented,
verses.textEn: This is what the Lord Almighty says: "Just as I had determined to bring disaster on you and showed no pity when your ancestors angered me," says the Lord Almighty,

verses.textZh: 照样，在这些日子里，我定意恩待耶路撒冷和犹大家。你们不要惧怕。
verses.textZhCnvs: 照样，在这些日子里，我定意恩待耶路撒冷和犹大家。你们不要惧怕。
verses.textZhCuv: 现在我照样定意施恩与耶路撒冷和犹大家，你们不要惧怕。
verses.textEnNiv: "so now I have determined to do good again to Jerusalem and Judah. Do not be afraid.
verses.textEnEsv: so again have I purposed in these days to bring good to Jerusalem and to the house of Judah; fear not.
verses.textEnNkjv: So again in these days I am determined to do good To Jerusalem and to the house of Judah. Do not fear.
verses.textEnNlt: But now I am determined to bless Jerusalem and the people of Judah. So don’t be afraid.
verses.textEnNasb: so I have again determined in these days to do good to Jerusalem and to the house of Judah. Do not fear!
verses.textEn: "so now I have determined to do good again to Jerusalem and Judah. Do not be afraid.

verses.textZh: 你们应当行这些事：你们各人要与邻舍说真话，在你们的城门口要凭着诚实施行带来和平的审判。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们应当行这些事：你们各人要与邻舍说真话，在你们的城门口要凭着诚实施行带来和平的审判。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们所当行的是这样：各人与邻舍说话诚实，在城门口按至理判断，使人和睦。
verses.textEnNiv: These are the things you are to do: Speak the truth to each other, and render true and sound judgment in your courts;
verses.textEnEsv: These are the things that you shall do: Speak the truth to one another; render in your gates judgments that are true and make for peace;
verses.textEnNkjv: These are the things you shall do: Speak each man the truth to his neighbor; Give judgment in your gates for truth, justice, and peace;
verses.textEnNlt: But this is what you must do: Tell the truth to each other. Render verdicts in your courts that are just and that lead to peace.
verses.textEnNasb: These are the things which you shall do: speak the truth to one another; judge with truth and judgment for peace at your gates.
verses.textEn: These are the things you are to do: Speak the truth to each other, and render true and sound judgment in your courts;

verses.textZh: 你们各人不要心里图谋恶事，彼此陷害，也不可好起假誓，因为这些都是我所恨恶的。’这是耶和华的宣告。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们各人不要心里图谋恶事，彼此陷害，也不可好起假誓，因为这些都是我所恨恶的。’这是耶和华的宣告。"
verses.textZhCuv: 谁都不可心里谋害邻舍，也不可喜爱起假誓，因为这些事都为我所恨恶。这是耶和华说的。」
verses.textEnNiv: do not plot evil against each other, and do not love to swear falsely. I hate all this," declares the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: do not devise evil in your hearts against one another, and love no false oath, for all these things I hate, declares the Lord ."
verses.textEnNkjv: Let none of you think evil in your heart against your neighbor; And do not love a false oath. For all these arethings that I hate,’ Says the Lord."
verses.textEnNlt: Don’t scheme against each other. Stop your love of telling lies that you swear are the truth. I hate all these things, says the Lord ."
verses.textEnNasb: Also let none of you devise evil in your heart against another, and do not love perjury; for all these things are what I hate,’ declares the Lord."
verses.textEn: do not plot evil against each other, and do not love to swear falsely. I hate all this," declares the Lord .

verses.textZh: 万军之耶和华的话临到我，说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 万军之耶和华的话临到我，说：
verses.textZhCuv: 万军之耶和华的话临到我说：
verses.textEnNiv: The word of the Lord Almighty came to me.
verses.textEnEsv: And the word of the Lord of hosts came to me, saying,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the word of the Lord of hosts came to me, saying,
verses.textEnNlt: Here is another message that came to me from the Lord of Heaven’s Armies.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the word of the Lord of armies came to me, saying,
verses.textEn: The word of the Lord Almighty came to me.

verses.textZh: "万军之耶和华这样说：‘四月的禁食、五月的禁食、七月的禁食和十月的禁食都要变为犹大家欢喜快乐的日子和欢乐的节期。所以，你们要喜爱诚实与和平。’
verses.textZhCnvs: "万军之耶和华这样说：‘四月的禁食、五月的禁食、七月的禁食和十月的禁食都要变为犹大家欢喜快乐的日子和欢乐的节期。所以，你们要喜爱诚实与和平。’
verses.textZhCuv: 「万军之耶和华如此说：四月、五月禁食的日子，七月、十月禁食的日子，必变为犹大家欢喜快乐的日子和欢乐的节期；所以你们要喜爱诚实与和平。」
verses.textEnNiv: This is what the Lord Almighty says: "The fasts of the fourth, fifth, seventh and tenth months will become joyful and glad occasions and happy festivals for Judah. Therefore love truth and peace."
verses.textEnEsv: "Thus says the Lord of hosts: The fast of the fourth month and the fast of the fifth and the fast of the seventh and the fast of the tenth shall be to the house of Judah seasons of joy and gladness and cheerful feasts. Therefore love truth and peace.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Thus says the Lord of hosts: ‘The fast of the fourth month, The fast of the fifth, The fast of the seventh, And the fast of the tenth, Shall be joy and gladness and cheerful feasts For the house of Judah. Therefore love truth and peace.’
verses.textEnNlt: "This is what the Lord of Heaven’s Armies says: The traditional fasts and times of mourning you have kept in early summer, midsummer, autumn, and winter are now ended. They will become festivals of joy and celebration for the people of Judah. So love truth and peace.
verses.textEnNasb: "The Lord of armies says this: ‘The fast of the fourth, the fast of the fifth, the fast of the seventh, and the fast of the tenth months will become joy, jubilation, and cheerful festivals for the house of Judah; so love truth and peace.’
verses.textEn: This is what the Lord Almighty says: "The fasts of the fourth, fifth, seventh and tenth months will become joyful and glad occasions and happy festivals for Judah. Therefore love truth and peace."

verses.textZh: "万军之耶和华这样说：‘将来还有万族的人和多个城市的居民要来。
verses.textZhCnvs: "万军之耶和华这样说：‘将来还有万族的人和多个城市的居民要来。
verses.textZhCuv: 万军之耶和华如此说：「将来必有列国的人和多城的居民来到。
verses.textEnNiv: This is what the Lord Almighty says: "Many peoples and the inhabitants of many cities will yet come,
verses.textEnEsv: "Thus says the Lord of hosts: Peoples shall yet come, even the inhabitants of many cities.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Thus says the Lord of hosts: ‘Peoples shall yet come, Inhabitants of many cities;
verses.textEnNlt: "This is what the Lord of Heaven’s Armies says: People from nations and cities around the world will travel to Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNasb: "The Lord of armies says this: ‘It will yet turn out that peoples will come, that is, the inhabitants of many cities.
verses.textEn: This is what the Lord Almighty says: "Many peoples and the inhabitants of many cities will yet come,

verses.textZh: 一城的居民到另一城去，对他们说：我们快去恳求耶和华施恩，求告万军之耶和华；我自己也去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 一城的居民到另一城去，对他们说：我们快去恳求耶和华施恩，求告万军之耶和华；我自己也去。
verses.textZhCuv: 这城的居民必到那城，说：『我们要快去恳求耶和华的恩，寻求万军之耶和华；我也要去。』
verses.textEnNiv: and the inhabitants of one city will go to another and say, ‘Let us go at once to entreat the Lord and seek the Lord Almighty. I myself am going.’
verses.textEnEsv: The inhabitants of one city shall go to another, saying, ‘Let us go at once to entreat the favor of the Lord and to seek the Lord of hosts; I myself am going.’
verses.textEnNkjv: The inhabitants of one city shall go to another, saying, "Let us continue to go and pray before the Lord, And seek the Lord of hosts. I myself will go also."
verses.textEnNlt: The people of one city will say to the people of another, ‘Come with us to Jerusalem to ask the Lord to bless us. Let’s worship the Lord of Heaven’s Armies. I’m determined to go.’
verses.textEnNasb: The inhabitants of one city will go to another, saying, "Let’s go at once to plead for the favor of the Lord, and to seek the Lord of armies; I also will go."
verses.textEn: and the inhabitants of one city will go to another and say, ‘Let us go at once to entreat the Lord and seek the Lord Almighty. I myself am going.’

verses.textZh: 必有很多的民族和强大的国家前来，在耶路撒冷求告万军之耶和华，恳求他施恩。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 必有很多的民族和强大的国家前来，在耶路撒冷求告万军之耶和华，恳求他施恩。’
verses.textZhCuv: 必有列邦的人和强国的民来到耶路撒冷寻求万军之耶和华，恳求耶和华的恩。
verses.textEnNiv: And many peoples and powerful nations will come to Jerusalem to seek the Lord Almighty and to entreat him."
verses.textEnEsv: Many peoples and strong nations shall come to seek the Lord of hosts in Jerusalem and to entreat the favor of the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: Yes, many peoples and strong nations Shall come to seek the Lord of hosts in Jerusalem, And to pray before the Lord.’
verses.textEnNlt: Many peoples and powerful nations will come to Jerusalem to seek the Lord of Heaven’s Armies and to ask for his blessing.
verses.textEnNasb: So many peoples and mighty nations will come to seek the Lord of armies in Jerusalem, and to plead for the favor of the Lord.’
verses.textEn: And many peoples and powerful nations will come to Jerusalem to seek the Lord Almighty and to entreat him."

verses.textZh: "万军之耶和华这样说：‘在那些日子，必有十个说不同方言，来自列国的人，紧抓住一个犹大人的衣襟，说：让我们与你们同去吧，因为我们听见神与你们同在。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: "万军之耶和华这样说：‘在那些日子，必有十个说不同方言，来自列国的人，紧抓住一个犹大人的衣襟，说：让我们与你们同去吧，因为我们听见神与你们同在。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 万军之耶和华如此说：在那些日子，必有十个人从列国诸族 中出来，拉住一个犹大人的衣襟，说：『我们要与你们同去，因为我们听见神与你们同在了。』」
verses.textEnNiv: This is what the Lord Almighty says: "In those days ten people from all languages and nations will take firm hold of one Jew by the hem of his robe and say, ‘Let us go with you, because we have heard that God is with you.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: Thus says the Lord of hosts: In those days ten men from the nations of every tongue shall take hold of the robe of a Jew, saying, ‘Let us go with you, for we have heard that God is with you.’"
verses.textEnNkjv: "Thus says the Lord of hosts: ‘In those days ten men from every language of the nations shall grasp the sleeve of a Jewish man, saying, "Let us go with you, for we have heard that God is with you." ’ "
verses.textEnNlt: "This is what the Lord of Heaven’s Armies says: In those days ten men from different nations and languages of the world will clutch at the sleeve of one Jew. And they will say, ‘Please let us walk with you, for we have heard that God is with you.’"
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord of armies says this: ‘In those days ten people from all the nations will grasp the garment of a Jew, saying, "Let us go with you, for we have heard that God is with you." ’ "
verses.textEn: This is what the Lord Almighty says: "In those days ten people from all languages and nations will take firm hold of one Jew by the hem of his robe and say, ‘Let us go with you, because we have heard that God is with you.’ "

verses.textZh: 以下是耶和华的默示： 耶和华的话临到哈得拉地，落在大马士革 ，
verses.textZhCnvs: 以下是耶和华的默示： 耶和华的话临到哈得拉地，落在大马士革 ，
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华的默示应验在哈得拉地大马士革 －世人和以色列各支派的眼目都仰望耶和华－
verses.textEnNiv: A prophecy: The word of the Lord is against the land of Hadrak and will come to rest on Damascus— for the eyes of all people and all the tribes of Israel are on the Lord —
verses.textEnEsv: The oracle of the word of the Lord is against the land of Hadrach and Damascus is its resting place. For the Lord has an eye on mankind and on all the tribes of Israel,
verses.textEnNkjv: The burden of the word of the Lord Against the land of Hadrach, And Damascus its resting place (For the eyes of men And all the tribes of Israel Are on the Lord);
verses.textEnNlt: This is the message from the Lord against the land of Aram and the city of Damascus, for the eyes of humanity, including all the tribes of Israel, are on the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: The pronouncement of the word of the Lord is against the land of Hadrach, with Damascus as its resting place (for the eyes of mankind, especially of all the tribes of Israel, are toward the Lord),
verses.textEn: A prophecy: The word of the Lord is against the land of Hadrak and will come to rest on Damascus— for the eyes of all people and all the tribes of Israel are on the Lord —

verses.textZh: 又临到大马士革边界的哈马， 还有推罗、西顿，尽管她们有极大的智慧。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又临到大马士革边界的哈马， 还有推罗、西顿，尽管她们有极大的智慧。
verses.textZhCuv: 和靠近的哈马，并泰尔、西顿； 因为这二城的人大有智慧。
verses.textEnNiv: and on Hamath too, which borders on it, and on Tyre and Sidon, though they are very skillful.
verses.textEnEsv: and on Hamath also, which borders on it, Tyre and Sidon, though they are very wise.
verses.textEnNkjv: Also against Hamath, which borders on it, And against Tyre and Sidon, though they are very wise.
verses.textEnNlt: Doom is certain for Hamath, near Damascus, and for the cities of Tyre and Sidon, though they are so clever.
verses.textEnNasb: And Hamath also, which borders on it; Tyre and Sidon, though they are very wise.
verses.textEn: and on Hamath too, which borders on it, and on Tyre and Sidon, though they are very skillful.

verses.textZh: 推罗为自己建造了堡垒， 堆积银子，多如尘沙， 积聚精金，多如街上的泥土。
verses.textZhCnvs: 推罗为自己建造了堡垒， 堆积银子，多如尘沙， 积聚精金，多如街上的泥土。
verses.textZhCuv: 泰尔为自己修筑保障， 积蓄银子如尘沙， 堆起精金如街上的泥土。
verses.textEnNiv: Tyre has built herself a stronghold; she has heaped up silver like dust, and gold like the dirt of the streets.
verses.textEnEsv: Tyre has built herself a rampart and heaped up silver like dust, and fine gold like the mud of the streets.
verses.textEnNkjv: For Tyre built herself a tower, Heaped up silver like the dust, And gold like the mire of the streets.
verses.textEnNlt: Tyre has built a strong fortress and has made silver and gold as plentiful as dust in the streets!
verses.textEnNasb: For Tyre built herself a fortress, And piled up silver like dust, And gold like the mud of the streets.
verses.textEn: Tyre has built herself a stronghold; she has heaped up silver like dust, and gold like the dirt of the streets.

verses.textZh: 看哪！主必夺去她的一切， 摧毁她海上的势力， 她必被火吞灭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 看哪！主必夺去她的一切， 摧毁她海上的势力， 她必被火吞灭。
verses.textZhCuv: 主必赶出她， 打败她海上的权利； 她必被火烧灭。
verses.textEnNiv: But the Lord will take away her possessions and destroy her power on the sea, and she will be consumed by fire.
verses.textEnEsv: But behold, the Lord will strip her of her possessions and strike down her power on the sea, and she shall be devoured by fire.
verses.textEnNkjv: Behold, the Lord will cast her out; He will destroy her power in the sea, And she will be devoured by fire.
verses.textEnNlt: But now the Lord will strip away Tyre’s possessions and hurl its fortifications into the sea, and it will be burned to the ground.
verses.textEnNasb: Behold, the Lord will dispossess her And throw her wealth into the sea; And she will be consumed with fire.
verses.textEn: But the Lord will take away her possessions and destroy her power on the sea, and she will be consumed by fire.

verses.textZh: 亚实基伦看见了，就必害怕； 迦萨看见了也必非常痛苦； 以革伦因失去盼望而蒙羞。 迦萨的王必灭亡， 亚实基伦必不再有人居住。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚实基伦看见了，就必害怕； 迦萨看见了也必非常痛苦； 以革伦因失去盼望而蒙羞。 迦萨的王必灭亡， 亚实基伦必不再有人居住。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚实基伦看见必惧怕； 迦萨看见甚痛苦； 以革伦因失了盼望蒙羞。 迦萨必不再有君王； 亚实基伦也不再有居民。
verses.textEnNiv: Ashkelon will see it and fear; Gaza will writhe in agony, and Ekron too, for her hope will wither. Gaza will lose her king and Ashkelon will be deserted.
verses.textEnEsv: Ashkelon shall see it, and be afraid; Gaza too, and shall writhe in anguish; Ekron also, because its hopes are confounded. The king shall perish from Gaza; Ashkelon shall be uninhabited;
verses.textEnNkjv: Ashkelon shall see it and fear; Gaza also shall be very sorrowful; And Ekron, for He dried up her expectation. The king shall perish from Gaza, And Ashkelon shall not be inhabited.
verses.textEnNlt: The city of Ashkelon will see Tyre fall and will be filled with fear. Gaza will shake with terror, as will Ekron, for their hopes will be dashed. Gaza’s king will be killed, and Ashkelon will be deserted.
verses.textEnNasb: Ashkelon will see it and be afraid. Gaza too will writhe in great pain; Also Ekron, because her hope has been ruined. Moreover, the king will perish from Gaza, And Ashkelon will not be inhabited.
verses.textEn: Ashkelon will see it and fear; Gaza will writhe in agony, and Ekron too, for her hope will wither. Gaza will lose her king and Ashkelon will be deserted.

verses.textZh: 混杂的种族 必住在亚实突， 我必除掉非利士人的骄傲。
verses.textZhCnvs: 混杂的种族 必住在亚实突， 我必除掉非利士人的骄傲。
verses.textZhCuv: 私生子 必住在亚实突； 我必除灭非利士人的骄傲。
verses.textEnNiv: A mongrel people will occupy Ashdod, and I will put an end to the pride of the Philistines.
verses.textEnEsv: a mixed people shall dwell in Ashdod, and I will cut off the pride of Philistia.
verses.textEnNkjv: "A mixed race shall settle in Ashdod, And I will cut off the pride of the Philistines.
verses.textEnNlt: Foreigners will occupy the city of Ashdod. I will destroy the pride of the Philistines.
verses.textEnNasb: And a people of mixed origins will live in Ashdod, And I will eliminate the pride of the Philistines.
verses.textEn: A mongrel people will occupy Ashdod, and I will put an end to the pride of the Philistines.

verses.textZh: 我必除去他们口中的血， 和他们牙齿间可憎之物。 余剩下来的人要归于我们的神， 像犹大的一族； 以革伦人也必像耶布斯人一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我必除去他们口中的血， 和他们牙齿间可憎之物。 余剩下来的人要归于我们的神， 像犹大的一族； 以革伦人也必像耶布斯人一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 我必除去他口中带血之肉 和牙齿内可憎之物。 他必作为余剩的人归与我们的神， 必在犹大像族长； 以革伦人必如耶布斯人。
verses.textEnNiv: I will take the blood from their mouths, the forbidden food from between their teeth. Those who are left will belong to our God and become a clan in Judah, and Ekron will be like the Jebusites.
verses.textEnEsv: I will take away its blood from its mouth, and its abominations from between its teeth; it too shall be a remnant for our God; it shall be like a clan in Judah, and Ekron shall be like the Jebusites.
verses.textEnNkjv: I will take away the blood from his mouth, And the abominations from between his teeth. But he who remains, even he shallbe for our God, And shall be like a leader in Judah, And Ekron like a Jebusite.
verses.textEnNlt: I will grab the bloody meat from their mouths and snatch the detestable sacrifices from their teeth. Then the surviving Philistines will worship our God and become like a clan in Judah. The Philistines of Ekron will join my people, as the ancient Jebusites once did.
verses.textEnNasb: And I will remove their blood from their mouth And their detestable things from between their teeth. Then they also will be a remnant for our God, And be like a clan in Judah, And Ekron will be like a Jebusite.
verses.textEn: I will take the blood from their mouths, the forbidden food from between their teeth. Those who are left will belong to our God and become a clan in Judah, and Ekron will be like the Jebusites.

verses.textZh: 我必在我的家四围安营， 不容敌军出入往来； 欺压人的不能再侵犯我的子民， 因我现在亲眼看顾他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我必在我的家四围安营， 不容敌军出入往来； 欺压人的不能再侵犯我的子民， 因我现在亲眼看顾他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 我必在我家的四围安营， 使敌军不得任意往来， 暴虐的人也不再经过， 因为我亲眼看顾我的家。
verses.textEnNiv: But I will encamp at my temple to guard it against marauding forces. Never again will an oppressor overrun my people, for now I am keeping watch.
verses.textEnEsv: Then I will encamp at my house as a guard, so that none shall march to and fro; no oppressor shall again march over them, for now I see with my own eyes.
verses.textEnNkjv: I will camp around My house Because of the army, Because of him who passes by and him who returns. No more shall an oppressor pass through them, For now I have seen with My eyes.
verses.textEnNlt: I will guard my Temple and protect it from invading armies. I am watching closely to ensure that no more foreign oppressors overrun my people’s land.
verses.textEnNasb: But I will camp around My house because of an army, Because of him who passes by and returns; And no oppressor will pass over them anymore, For now I have seen with My eyes.
verses.textEn: But I will encamp at my temple to guard it against marauding forces. Never again will an oppressor overrun my people, for now I am keeping watch.

verses.textZh: 锡安的居民哪！要大大喜乐。 耶路撒冷的居民 哪！应当欢呼。 看哪！你的王来到你这里了， 他是公义的，是得胜的。 他又是温柔的，他骑着驴， 骑的是小驴。
verses.textZhCnvs: 锡安的居民哪！要大大喜乐。 耶路撒冷的居民 哪！应当欢呼。 看哪！你的王来到你这里了， 他是公义的，是得胜的。 他又是温柔的，他骑着驴， 骑的是小驴。
verses.textZhCuv: 锡安的民哪，应当大大喜乐； 耶路撒冷的民哪，应当欢呼。 看哪，你的王来到你这里！ 他是公义的，并且施行拯救， 谦谦和和地骑着驴， 就是骑着驴的驹子。
verses.textEnNiv: Rejoice greatly, Daughter Zion! Shout, Daughter Jerusalem! See, your king comes to you, righteous and victorious, lowly and riding on a donkey, on a colt, the foal of a donkey.
verses.textEnEsv: Rejoice greatly, O daughter of Zion! Shout aloud, O daughter of Jerusalem! Behold, your king is coming to you; righteous and having salvation is he, humble and mounted on a donkey, on a colt, the foal of a donkey.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Rejoice greatly, O daughter of Zion! Shout, O daughter of Jerusalem! Behold, your King is coming to you; He is just and having salvation, Lowly and riding on a donkey, A colt, the foal of a donkey.
verses.textEnNlt: Rejoice, O people of Zion! Shout in triumph, O people of Jerusalem! Look, your king is coming to you. He is righteous and victorious, yet he is humble, riding on a donkey— riding on a donkey’s colt.
verses.textEnNasb: Rejoice greatly, daughter of Zion! Shout in triumph, daughter of Jerusalem! Behold, your king is coming to you; He is righteous and endowed with salvation, Humble, and mounted on a donkey, Even on a colt, the foal of a donkey.
verses.textEn: Rejoice greatly, Daughter Zion! Shout, Daughter Jerusalem! See, your king comes to you, righteous and victorious, lowly and riding on a donkey, on a colt, the foal of a donkey.

verses.textZh: 我必从以法莲除掉战车， 从耶路撒冷除掉战马。 争战的弓必被除掉， 他要向列国宣讲和平。 他的统治权必从这海延伸到那海， 从幼发拉底河直到地极。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我必从以法莲除掉战车， 从耶路撒冷除掉战马。 争战的弓必被除掉， 他要向列国宣讲和平。 他的统治权必从这海延伸到那海， 从幼发拉底河直到地极。
verses.textZhCuv: 我必除灭以法莲的战车 和耶路撒冷的战马； 争战的弓也必除灭。 他必向列国讲和平； 他的权柄必从这海管到那海， 从大河管到地极。
verses.textEnNiv: I will take away the chariots from Ephraim and the warhorses from Jerusalem, and the battle bow will be broken. He will proclaim peace to the nations. His rule will extend from sea to sea and from the River to the ends of the earth.
verses.textEnEsv: I will cut off the chariot from Ephraim and the war horse from Jerusalem; and the battle bow shall be cut off, and he shall speak peace to the nations; his rule shall be from sea to sea, and from the River to the ends of the earth.
verses.textEnNkjv: I will cut off the chariot from Ephraim And the horse from Jerusalem; The battle bow shall be cut off. He shall speak peace to the nations; His dominion shallbe ‘from sea to sea, And from the River to the ends of the earth.’
verses.textEnNlt: I will remove the battle chariots from Israel and the warhorses from Jerusalem. I will destroy all the weapons used in battle, and your king will bring peace to the nations. His realm will stretch from sea to sea and from the Euphrates River to the ends of the earth.
verses.textEnNasb: And I will eliminate the chariot from Ephraim And the horse from Jerusalem; And the bow of war will be eliminated. And He will speak peace to the nations; And His dominion will be from sea to sea, And from the Euphrates River to the ends of the earth.
verses.textEn: I will take away the chariots from Ephraim and the warhorses from Jerusalem, and the battle bow will be broken. He will proclaim peace to the nations. His rule will extend from sea to sea and from the River to the ends of the earth.

verses.textZh: 锡安哪！至于你，因着我与你立约的血，我把你中间被囚禁的人从无水的坑里释放出来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 锡安哪！至于你，因着我与你立约的血，我把你中间被囚禁的人从无水的坑里释放出来。
verses.textZhCuv: 锡安哪，我因与你立约的血， 将你中间被掳而囚的人从无水的坑中释放出来。
verses.textEnNiv: As for you, because of the blood of my covenant with you, I will free your prisoners from the waterless pit.
verses.textEnEsv: As for you also, because of the blood of my covenant with you, I will set your prisoners free from the waterless pit.
verses.textEnNkjv: "As for you also, Because of the blood of your covenant, I will set your prisoners free from the waterless pit.
verses.textEnNlt: Because of the covenant I made with you, sealed with blood, I will free your prisoners from death in a waterless dungeon.
verses.textEnNasb: As for you also, because of the blood of My covenant with you, I have set your prisoners free from the waterless pit.
verses.textEn: As for you, because of the blood of my covenant with you, I will free your prisoners from the waterless pit.

verses.textZh: 你们被囚仍有盼望的人哪！要归回保障。 今天我要宣告：我必加倍补偿给你。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们被囚仍有盼望的人哪！要归回保障。 今天我要宣告：我必加倍补偿给你。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们被囚而有指望的人都要转回保障。 我今日说明，我必加倍赐福给你们。
verses.textEnNiv: Return to your fortress, you prisoners of hope; even now I announce that I will restore twice as much to you.
verses.textEnEsv: Return to your stronghold, O prisoners of hope; today I declare that I will restore to you double.
verses.textEnNkjv: Return to the stronghold, You prisoners of hope. Even today I declare That I will restore double to you.
verses.textEnNlt: Come back to the place of safety, all you prisoners who still have hope! I promise this very day that I will repay two blessings for each of your troubles.
verses.textEnNasb: Return to the stronghold, you prisoners who have the hope; This very day I am declaring that I will restore double to you.
verses.textEn: Return to your fortress, you prisoners of hope; even now I announce that I will restore twice as much to you.

verses.textZh: 我把犹大作我手上拉开的弓， 把以法莲作我弓上的箭。 锡安哪！我必激动你的众子，去攻击希腊的众子； 我必使你像勇士的刀剑。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我把犹大作我手上拉开的弓， 把以法莲作我弓上的箭。 锡安哪！我必激动你的众子，去攻击希腊的众子； 我必使你像勇士的刀剑。
verses.textZhCuv: 我拿犹大作上弦的弓； 我拿以法莲为张弓的箭。 锡安哪，我要激发你的众子， 攻击希腊 的众子，使你如勇士的刀。
verses.textEnNiv: I will bend Judah as I bend my bow and fill it with Ephraim. I will rouse your sons, Zion, against your sons, Greece, and make you like a warrior’s sword.
verses.textEnEsv: For I have bent Judah as my bow; I have made Ephraim its arrow. I will stir up your sons, O Zion, against your sons, O Greece, and wield you like a warrior’s sword.
verses.textEnNkjv: For I have bent Judah, My bow, Fitted the bow with Ephraim, And raised up your sons, O Zion, Against your sons, O Greece, And made you like the sword of a mighty man."
verses.textEnNlt: Judah is my bow, and Israel is my arrow. Jerusalem is my sword, and like a warrior, I will brandish it against the Greeks.
verses.textEnNasb: For I will bend Judah as My bow, I will fill the bow with Ephraim. And I will stir up your sons, Zion, against your sons, Greece; And I will make you like a warrior’s sword.
verses.textEn: I will bend Judah as I bend my bow and fill it with Ephraim. I will rouse your sons, Zion, against your sons, Greece, and make you like a warrior’s sword.

verses.textZh: 耶和华必在他子民头上显现， 他的箭必像闪电一般射出； 主耶和华必吹起号角， 乘着南方的暴风而行。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华必在他子民头上显现， 他的箭必像闪电一般射出； 主耶和华必吹起号角， 乘着南方的暴风而行。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华必显现在他们以上； 他的箭必射出像闪电。 主耶和华必吹角， 乘南方的旋风而行。
verses.textEnNiv: Then the Lord will appear over them; his arrow will flash like lightning. The Sovereign Lord will sound the trumpet; he will march in the storms of the south,
verses.textEnEsv: Then the Lord will appear over them, and his arrow will go forth like lightning; the Lord God will sound the trumpet and will march forth in the whirlwinds of the south.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Lord will be seen over them, And His arrow will go forth like lightning. The Lord God will blow the trumpet, And go with whirlwinds from the south.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord will appear above his people; his arrows will fly like lightning! The Sovereign Lord will sound the ram’s horn and attack like a whirlwind from the southern desert.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Lord will appear over them, And His arrow will go forth like lightning; And the Lord God will blow the trumpet, And march in the storm winds of the south.
verses.textEn: Then the Lord will appear over them; his arrow will flash like lightning. The Sovereign Lord will sound the trumpet; he will march in the storms of the south,

verses.textZh: 万军之耶和华必护卫他们， 他们要用投石器投石吞灭和制伏敌人； 他们必喝血，并且喧嚷，像喝醉了酒一样； 他们必像献祭用的碗盛满了血， 又像祭坛的角，沾满了血。
verses.textZhCnvs: 万军之耶和华必护卫他们， 他们要用投石器投石吞灭和制伏敌人； 他们必喝血，并且喧嚷，像喝醉了酒一样； 他们必像献祭用的碗盛满了血， 又像祭坛的角，沾满了血。
verses.textZhCuv: 万军之耶和华必保护他们； 他们必吞灭仇敌，践踏弹石。 他们必喝血呐喊，犹如饮酒； 他们必像盛满血的碗， 又像坛的四角满了血。
verses.textEnNiv: and the Lord Almighty will shield them. They will destroy and overcome with slingstones. They will drink and roar as with wine; they will be full like a bowl used for sprinkling the corners of the altar.
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord of hosts will protect them, and they shall devour, and tread down the sling stones, and they shall drink and roar as if drunk with wine, and be full like a bowl, drenched like the corners of the altar.
verses.textEnNkjv: The Lord of hosts will defend them; They shall devour and subdue with slingstones. They shall drink and roar as if with wine; They shall be filled withblood like basins, Like the corners of the altar.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord of Heaven’s Armies will protect his people, and they will defeat their enemies by hurling great stones. They will shout in battle as though drunk with wine. They will be filled with blood like a bowl, drenched with blood like the corners of the altar.
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord of armies will protect them. And they will devour and trample on the slingstones; And they will drink and be boisterous as with wine; And they will be filled like a sacrificial basin, Drenched like the corners of the altar.
verses.textEn: and the Lord Almighty will shield them. They will destroy and overcome with slingstones. They will drink and roar as with wine; they will be full like a bowl used for sprinkling the corners of the altar.

verses.textZh: 到那日，耶和华他们的神必拯救他们， 待他的子民好象羊群一样， 因为他们必像冠冕上的宝石， 闪耀在他的地上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 到那日，耶和华他们的神必拯救他们， 待他的子民好象羊群一样， 因为他们必像冠冕上的宝石， 闪耀在他的地上。
verses.textZhCuv: 当那日，耶和华－他们的神 必看他的民如群羊，拯救他们； 因为他们必像冠冕上的宝石， 高举在他的地以上 。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord their God will save his people on that day as a shepherd saves his flock. They will sparkle in his land like jewels in a crown.
verses.textEnEsv: On that day the Lord their God will save them, as the flock of his people; for like the jewels of a crown they shall shine on his land.
verses.textEnNkjv: The Lord their God will save them in that day, As the flock of His people. For they shallbelike the jewels of a crown, Lifted like a banner over His land—
verses.textEnNlt: On that day the Lord their God will rescue his people, just as a shepherd rescues his sheep. They will sparkle in his land like jewels in a crown.
verses.textEnNasb: And the Lord their God will save them on that day As the flock of His people; For they are like the precious stones of a crown, Sparkling on His land.
verses.textEn: The Lord their God will save his people on that day as a shepherd saves his flock. They will sparkle in his land like jewels in a crown.

verses.textZh: 他们将是多么的善，多么的美； 五谷和新酒使少男少女生气蓬勃。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们将是多么的善，多么的美； 五谷和新酒使少男少女生气蓬勃。
verses.textZhCuv: 他的恩慈何等大！ 他的荣美何其盛！ 五谷健壮少男； 新酒培养处女。
verses.textEnNiv: How attractive and beautiful they will be! Grain will make the young men thrive, and new wine the young women.
verses.textEnEsv: For how great is his goodness, and how great his beauty! Grain shall make the young men flourish, and new wine the young women.
verses.textEnNkjv: For how great is its goodness And how great its beauty! Grain shall make the young men thrive, And new wine the young women.
verses.textEnNlt: How wonderful and beautiful they will be! The young men will thrive on abundant grain, and the young women will flourish on new wine.
verses.textEnNasb: For how great will their loveliness and beauty be! Grain will make the young men flourish, and new wine, the virgins.
verses.textEn: How attractive and beautiful they will be! Grain will make the young men thrive, and new wine the young women.

verses.textZh: 在春雨的季节，你们要向耶和华求雨。 耶和华闪发雷电， 给人降雨，使各人的田地生长蔬菜。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在春雨的季节，你们要向耶和华求雨。 耶和华闪发雷电， 给人降雨，使各人的田地生长蔬菜。
verses.textZhCuv: 当春雨的时候， 你们要向发闪电的耶和华求雨。 他必为众人降下甘霖， 使田园生长菜蔬。
verses.textEnNiv: Ask the Lord for rain in the springtime; it is the Lord who sends the thunderstorms. He gives showers of rain to all people, and plants of the field to everyone.
verses.textEnEsv: Ask rain from the Lord in the season of the spring rain, from the Lord who makes the storm clouds, and he will give them showers of rain, to everyone the vegetation in the field.
verses.textEnNkjv: Ask the Lord for rain In the time of the latter rain. The Lord will make flashing clouds; He will give them showers of rain, Grass in the field for everyone.
verses.textEnNlt: Ask the Lord for rain in the spring, for he makes the storm clouds. And he will send showers of rain so every field becomes a lush pasture.
verses.textEnNasb: Ask for rain from the Lord at the time of the spring rain— The Lord who makes the storm winds; And He will give them showers of rain, vegetation in the field to each person.
verses.textEn: Ask the Lord for rain in the springtime; it is the Lord who sends the thunderstorms. He gives showers of rain to all people, and plants of the field to everyone.

verses.textZh: 因为偶像所说的是空言， 占卜者所见的是虚谎， 他们所说的是假梦， 只给人空洞的安慰。 因此，众人都如羊没有牧人，流离困苦。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为偶像所说的是空言， 占卜者所见的是虚谎， 他们所说的是假梦， 只给人空洞的安慰。 因此，众人都如羊没有牧人，流离困苦。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为，家神所言的是虚空； 卜士所见的是虚假； 做梦者所说的是假梦。 他们白白地安慰人， 所以众人如羊流离， 因无牧人就受苦。
verses.textEnNiv: The idols speak deceitfully, diviners see visions that lie; they tell dreams that are false, they give comfort in vain. Therefore the people wander like sheep oppressed for lack of a shepherd.
verses.textEnEsv: For the household gods utter nonsense, and the diviners see lies; they tell false dreams and give empty consolation. Therefore the people wander like sheep; they are afflicted for lack of a shepherd.
verses.textEnNkjv: For the idols speak delusion; The diviners envision lies, And tell false dreams; They comfort in vain. Therefore thepeople wend their way like sheep; They are in trouble because thereis no shepherd.
verses.textEnNlt: Household gods give worthless advice, fortune-tellers predict only lies, and interpreters of dreams pronounce falsehoods that give no comfort. So my people are wandering like lost sheep; they are attacked because they have no shepherd.
verses.textEnNasb: For the household idols speak deception, And the diviners see an illusion And tell deceitful dreams; They comfort in vain. Therefore the people wander like sheep, They are wretched because there is no shepherd.
verses.textEn: The idols speak deceitfully, diviners see visions that lie; they tell dreams that are false, they give comfort in vain. Therefore the people wander like sheep oppressed for lack of a shepherd.

verses.textZh: "我的怒气要向这些牧人发作， 我要惩罚那些公山羊。
verses.textZhCnvs: "我的怒气要向这些牧人发作， 我要惩罚那些公山羊。
verses.textZhCuv: 我的怒气向牧人发作； 我必惩罚公山羊； 因我－万军之耶和华 眷顾自己的羊群，就是犹大家， 必使他们如骏马在阵上。
verses.textEnNiv: "My anger burns against the shepherds, and I will punish the leaders; for the Lord Almighty will care for his flock, the people of Judah, and make them like a proud horse in battle.
verses.textEnEsv: "My anger is hot against the shepherds, and I will punish the leaders; for the Lord of hosts cares for his flock, the house of Judah, and will make them like his majestic steed in battle.
verses.textEnNkjv: "My anger is kindled against the shepherds, And I will punish the goatherds. For the Lord of hosts will visit His flock, The house of Judah, And will make them as His royal horse in the battle.
verses.textEnNlt: "My anger burns against your shepherds, and I will punish these leaders. For the Lord of Heaven’s Armies has arrived to look after Judah, his flock. He will make them strong and glorious, like a proud warhorse in battle.
verses.textEnNasb: "My anger is kindled against the shepherds, And I will punish the male goats; For the Lord of armies has visited His flock, the house of Judah, And will make them like His majestic horse in battle.
verses.textEn: "My anger burns against the shepherds, and I will punish the leaders; for the Lord Almighty will care for his flock, the people of Judah, and make them like a proud horse in battle.

verses.textZh: 房角石、 帐棚桩、 作战的弓 和所有的统治者，都从犹大而出。
verses.textZhCnvs: 房角石、 帐棚桩、 作战的弓 和所有的统治者，都从犹大而出。
verses.textZhCuv: 房角石、钉子、争战的弓， 和一切掌权的都从他而出。
verses.textEnNiv: From Judah will come the cornerstone, from him the tent peg, from him the battle bow, from him every ruler.
verses.textEnEsv: From him shall come the cornerstone, from him the tent peg, from him the battle bow, from him every ruler— all of them together.
verses.textEnNkjv: From him comes the cornerstone, From him the tent peg, From him the battle bow, From him every ruler together.
verses.textEnNlt: From Judah will come the cornerstone, the tent peg, the bow for battle, and all the rulers.
verses.textEnNasb: "From them will come the cornerstone, From them the tent peg, From them the bow of battle, From them every tyrant, all of them together.
verses.textEn: From Judah will come the cornerstone, from him the tent peg, from him the battle bow, from him every ruler.

verses.textZh: 他们必像勇士， 在战场上把仇敌践踏在街上的泥土中， 他们必争战，因为耶和华与他们同在， 他们必使敌方的骑士羞愧。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们必像勇士， 在战场上把仇敌践踏在街上的泥土中， 他们必争战，因为耶和华与他们同在， 他们必使敌方的骑士羞愧。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们必如勇士在阵上 将仇敌践踏在街上的泥土中。 他们必争战，因为耶和华与他们同在； 骑马的也必羞愧。
verses.textEnNiv: Together they will be like warriors in battle trampling their enemy into the mud of the streets. They will fight because the Lord is with them, and they will put the enemy horsemen to shame.
verses.textEnEsv: They shall be like mighty men in battle, trampling the foe in the mud of the streets; they shall fight because the Lord is with them, and they shall put to shame the riders on horses.
verses.textEnNkjv: They shall be like mighty men, Who tread down theirenemies In the mire of the streets in the battle. They shall fight because the Lord is with them, And the riders on horses shall be put to shame.
verses.textEnNlt: They will be like mighty warriors in battle, trampling their enemies in the mud under their feet. Since the Lord is with them as they fight, they will overthrow even the enemy’s horsemen.
verses.textEnNasb: "And they will be like warriors, Trampling down the enemy in the mud of the streets in battle; And they will fight, because the Lordwill be with them; And the riders on horses will be put to shame.
verses.textEn: Together they will be like warriors in battle trampling their enemy into the mud of the streets. They will fight because the Lord is with them, and they will put the enemy horsemen to shame.

verses.textZh: 我要使犹大家强盛起来， 我必拯救约瑟家。 我要使他们归回， 因为我怜悯他们； 他们好象未遭我弃绝一样， 因为我是耶和华他们的神，我必应允他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我要使犹大家强盛起来， 我必拯救约瑟家。 我要使他们归回， 因为我怜悯他们； 他们好象未遭我弃绝一样， 因为我是耶和华他们的神，我必应允他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 我要坚固犹大家，拯救约瑟家， 要领他们归回。 我要怜恤他们； 他们必像未曾弃绝的一样， 都因我是耶和华－他们的神， 我必应允他们的祷告。
verses.textEnNiv: "I will strengthen Judah and save the tribes of Joseph. I will restore them because I have compassion on them. They will be as though I had not rejected them, for I am the Lord their God and I will answer them.
verses.textEnEsv: "I will strengthen the house of Judah, and I will save the house of Joseph. I will bring them back because I have compassion on them, and they shall be as though I had not rejected them, for I am the Lord their God and I will answer them.
verses.textEnNkjv: "I will strengthen the house of Judah, And I will save the house of Joseph. I will bring them back, Because I have mercy on them. They shall be as though I had not cast them aside; For I am the Lord their God, And I will hear them.
verses.textEnNlt: "I will strengthen Judah and save Israel ; I will restore them because of my compassion. It will be as though I had never rejected them, for I am the Lord their God, who will hear their cries.
verses.textEnNasb: "And I will strengthen the house of Judah, And I will save the house of Joseph, And I will bring them back, Because I have had compassion on them; And they will be as though I had not rejected them, For I am the Lord their God and I will answer them.
verses.textEn: "I will strengthen Judah and save the tribes of Joseph. I will restore them because I have compassion on them. They will be as though I had not rejected them, for I am the Lord their God and I will answer them.

verses.textZh: 以法莲人必像勇士， 他们心中快乐，好象饮了酒一样； 他们的子孙看见了，也必快乐； 他们的心必因耶和华欢乐。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以法莲人必像勇士， 他们心中快乐，好象饮了酒一样； 他们的子孙看见了，也必快乐； 他们的心必因耶和华欢乐。
verses.textZhCuv: 以法莲人必如勇士； 他们心中畅快如同喝酒； 他们的儿女必看见而快活； 他们的心必因耶和华喜乐。
verses.textEnNiv: The Ephraimites will become like warriors, and their hearts will be glad as with wine. Their children will see it and be joyful; their hearts will rejoice in the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: Then Ephraim shall become like a mighty warrior, and their hearts shall be glad as with wine. Their children shall see it and be glad; their hearts shall rejoice in the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: Thoseof Ephraim shall be like a mighty man, And their heart shall rejoice as if with wine. Yes, their children shall see it and be glad; Their heart shall rejoice in the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: The people of Israel will become like mighty warriors, and their hearts will be made happy as if by wine. Their children, too, will see it and be glad; their hearts will rejoice in the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: "Ephraim will be like a warrior, And their heart will be joyful as if from wine; Indeed, their children will see it and be joyful, Their heart will rejoice in the Lord.
verses.textEn: The Ephraimites will become like warriors, and their hearts will be glad as with wine. Their children will see it and be joyful; their hearts will rejoice in the Lord .

verses.textZh: 我要向他们吹哨子，招聚他们， 因为我救赎了他们。 他们的人数要增多，像从前一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我要向他们吹哨子，招聚他们， 因为我救赎了他们。 他们的人数要增多，像从前一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 我要发嘶声，聚集他们， 因我已经救赎他们。 他们的人数必加增， 如从前加增一样。
verses.textEnNiv: I will signal for them and gather them in. Surely I will redeem them; they will be as numerous as before.
verses.textEnEsv: "I will whistle for them and gather them in, for I have redeemed them, and they shall be as many as they were before.
verses.textEnNkjv: I will whistle for them and gather them, For I will redeem them; And they shall increase as they once increased.
verses.textEnNlt: When I whistle to them, they will come running, for I have redeemed them. From the few who are left, they will grow as numerous as they were before.
verses.textEnNasb: "I will whistle for them and gather them together, For I have redeemed them; And they will be as numerous as they were before.
verses.textEn: I will signal for them and gather them in. Surely I will redeem them; they will be as numerous as before.

verses.textZh: 虽然我把他们散播在万民中， 他们仍要在远方记念我； 他们与他们的子孙都要存活，并且归回。
verses.textZhCnvs: 虽然我把他们散播在万民中， 他们仍要在远方记念我； 他们与他们的子孙都要存活，并且归回。
verses.textZhCuv: 我虽然 播散他们在列国中， 他们必在远方记念我。 他们与儿女都必存活，且得归回。
verses.textEnNiv: Though I scatter them among the peoples, yet in distant lands they will remember me. They and their children will survive, and they will return.
verses.textEnEsv: Though I scattered them among the nations, yet in far countries they shall remember me, and with their children they shall live and return.
verses.textEnNkjv: "I will sow them among the peoples, And they shall remember Me in far countries; They shall live, together with their children, And they shall return.
verses.textEnNlt: Though I have scattered them like seeds among the nations, they will still remember me in distant lands. They and their children will survive and return again to Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: "When I scatter them among the peoples, They will remember Me in distant countries, And they with their children will live and come back.
verses.textEn: Though I scatter them among the peoples, yet in distant lands they will remember me. They and their children will survive, and they will return.

verses.textZh: 我要使他们从埃及地归回， 从亚述地招聚他们， 带他们到基列地和黎巴嫩山， 却仍不够容纳他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我要使他们从埃及地归回， 从亚述地招聚他们， 带他们到基列地和黎巴嫩山， 却仍不够容纳他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 我必再领他们出埃及地， 招聚他们出亚述， 领他们到基列和黎巴嫩； 这地尚且不够他们居住。
verses.textEnNiv: I will bring them back from Egypt and gather them from Assyria. I will bring them to Gilead and Lebanon, and there will not be room enough for them.
verses.textEnEsv: I will bring them home from the land of Egypt, and gather them from Assyria, and I will bring them to the land of Gilead and to Lebanon, till there is no room for them.
verses.textEnNkjv: I will also bring them back from the land of Egypt, And gather them from Assyria. I will bring them into the land of Gilead and Lebanon, Until no moreroom is found for them.
verses.textEnNlt: I will bring them back from Egypt and gather them from Assyria. I will resettle them in Gilead and Lebanon until there is no more room for them all.
verses.textEnNasb: "I will bring them back from the land of Egypt And gather them from Assyria; And I will bring them into the land of Gilead and Lebanon Until no room can be found for them.
verses.textEn: I will bring them back from Egypt and gather them from Assyria. I will bring them to Gilead and Lebanon, and there will not be room enough for them.

verses.textZh: 他必经过苦难的海， 击打海中的波浪， 尼罗河的深处也都要干涸； 亚述的骄傲必降为卑； 埃及的权势要过去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他必经过苦难的海， 击打海中的波浪， 尼罗河的深处也都要干涸； 亚述的骄傲必降为卑； 埃及的权势要过去。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华必经过苦海，击打海浪， 使尼罗河的深处都枯干。 亚述的骄傲必致卑微； 埃及的权柄必然灭没。
verses.textEnNiv: They will pass through the sea of trouble; the surging sea will be subdued and all the depths of the Nile will dry up. Assyria’s pride will be brought down and Egypt’s scepter will pass away.
verses.textEnEsv: He shall pass through the sea of troubles and strike down the waves of the sea, and all the depths of the Nile shall be dried up. The pride of Assyria shall be laid low, and the scepter of Egypt shall depart.
verses.textEnNkjv: He shall pass through the sea with affliction, And strike the waves of the sea: All the depths of the River shall dry up. Then the pride of Assyria shall be brought down, And the scepter of Egypt shall depart.
verses.textEnNlt: They will pass safely through the sea of distress, for the waves of the sea will be held back, and the waters of the Nile will dry up. The pride of Assyria will be crushed, and the rule of Egypt will end.
verses.textEnNasb: "And they will pass through the sea of distress And He will strike the waves in the sea, So that all the depths of the Nile will dry up; And the pride of Assyria will be brought down, And the scepter of Egypt will depart.
verses.textEn: They will pass through the sea of trouble; the surging sea will be subdued and all the depths of the Nile will dry up. Assyria’s pride will be brought down and Egypt’s scepter will pass away.

verses.textZh: 我必使我的子民因耶和华而强盛， 他们要奉耶和华的名行事为人。" 这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我必使我的子民因耶和华而强盛， 他们要奉耶和华的名行事为人。" 这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 我必使他们倚靠我，得以坚固； 一举一动必奉我的名。 这是耶和华说的。
verses.textEnNiv: I will strengthen them in the Lord and in his name they will live securely," declares the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: I will make them strong in the Lord , and they shall walk in his name," declares the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: "So I will strengthen them in the Lord, And they shall walk up and down in His name," Says the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: By my power I will make my people strong, and by my authority they will go wherever they wish. I, the Lord , have spoken!"
verses.textEnNasb: "And I will strengthen them in the Lord, And in His name they will walk," declares the Lord.
verses.textEn: I will strengthen them in the Lord and in his name they will live securely," declares the Lord .

verses.textZh: 黎巴嫩哪！敞开你的门户， 好让火吞灭你的香柏树。
verses.textZhCnvs: 黎巴嫩哪！敞开你的门户， 好让火吞灭你的香柏树。
verses.textZhCuv: 黎巴嫩哪，开开你的门， 任火烧灭你的香柏树。
verses.textEnNiv: Open your doors, Lebanon, so that fire may devour your cedars!
verses.textEnEsv: Open your doors, O Lebanon, that the fire may devour your cedars!
verses.textEnNkjv: Open your doors, O Lebanon, That fire may devour your cedars.
verses.textEnNlt: Open your doors, Lebanon, so that fire may devour your cedar forests.
verses.textEnNasb: Open your doors, Lebanon, So that a fire may feed on your cedars.
verses.textEn: Open your doors, Lebanon, so that fire may devour your cedars!

verses.textZh: 松树啊！哀号吧，因为香柏树已经倒下， 雄壮的树木都毁坏了； 巴珊的橡树啊！哀号吧， 因为茂密的树林被砍下来了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 松树啊！哀号吧，因为香柏树已经倒下， 雄壮的树木都毁坏了； 巴珊的橡树啊！哀号吧， 因为茂密的树林被砍下来了。
verses.textZhCuv: 松树啊，应当哀号； 因为香柏树倾倒，佳美的树毁坏。 巴珊的橡树啊，应当哀号， 因为茂盛的树林已经倒了。
verses.textEnNiv: Wail, you juniper, for the cedar has fallen; the stately trees are ruined! Wail, oaks of Bashan; the dense forest has been cut down!
verses.textEnEsv: Wail, O cypress, for the cedar has fallen, for the glorious trees are ruined! Wail, oaks of Bashan, for the thick forest has been felled!
verses.textEnNkjv: Wail, O cypress, for the cedar has fallen, Because the mighty trees are ruined. Wail, O oaks of Bashan, For the thick forest has come down.
verses.textEnNlt: Weep, you cypress trees, for all the ruined cedars; the most majestic ones have fallen. Weep, you oaks of Bashan, for the thick forests have been cut down.
verses.textEnNasb: Wail, juniper, because the cedar has fallen, For the magnificent trees have been destroyed; Wail, oaks of Bashan, Because the impenetrable forest has come down.
verses.textEn: Wail, you juniper, for the cedar has fallen; the stately trees are ruined! Wail, oaks of Bashan; the dense forest has been cut down!

verses.textZh: 听牧人们哀号的声音， 因为他们荣美的草场毁坏了； 听少壮狮子吼叫的声音， 因为约旦河边的丛林毁坏了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 听牧人们哀号的声音， 因为他们荣美的草场毁坏了； 听少壮狮子吼叫的声音， 因为约旦河边的丛林毁坏了。
verses.textZhCuv: 听啊，有牧人哀号的声音， 因他们荣华的草场毁坏了。 有少壮狮子咆哮的声音， 因约旦河旁的丛林荒废了。
verses.textEnNiv: Listen to the wail of the shepherds; their rich pastures are destroyed! Listen to the roar of the lions; the lush thicket of the Jordan is ruined!
verses.textEnEsv: The sound of the wail of the shepherds, for their glory is ruined! The sound of the roar of the lions, for the thicket of the Jordan is ruined!
verses.textEnNkjv: Thereis the sound of wailing shepherds! For their glory is in ruins. Thereis the sound of roaring lions! For the pride of the Jordan is in ruins.
verses.textEnNlt: Listen to the wailing of the shepherds, for their rich pastures are destroyed. Hear the young lions roaring, for their thickets in the Jordan Valley are ruined.
verses.textEnNasb: There is a sound of the shepherds’ wail, For their splendor is ruined; There is a sound of the young lions’ roar, For the pride of the Jordan is ruined.
verses.textEn: Listen to the wail of the shepherds; their rich pastures are destroyed! Listen to the roar of the lions; the lush thicket of the Jordan is ruined!

verses.textZh: 耶和华我的神这样说："你要牧养这将被宰杀的羊群。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华我的神这样说："你要牧养这将被宰杀的羊群。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华－我的神如此说：「你－撒迦利亚要牧养这将宰的群羊。
verses.textEnNiv: This is what the Lord my God says: "Shepherd the flock marked for slaughter.
verses.textEnEsv: Thus said the Lord my God: "Become shepherd of the flock doomed to slaughter.
verses.textEnNkjv: Thus says the Lord my God, "Feed the flock for slaughter,
verses.textEnNlt: This is what the Lord my God says: "Go and care for the flock that is intended for slaughter.
verses.textEnNasb: This is what the Lord my God says: "Pasture the flock doomed to slaughter.
verses.textEn: This is what the Lord my God says: "Shepherd the flock marked for slaughter.

verses.textZh: 那些买了牠们的宰杀牠们，也不算为有罪；那些卖牠们的说：‘耶和华是应当称颂的，因我成了富足的人。’牠们的牧人并不怜恤牠们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那些买了牠们的宰杀牠们，也不算为有罪；那些卖牠们的说：‘耶和华是应当称颂的，因我成了富足的人。’牠们的牧人并不怜恤牠们。
verses.textZhCuv: 买他们的宰了他们，以自己为无罪；卖他们的说：『耶和华是应当称颂的，因我成为富足。』牧养他们的并不怜恤他们。
verses.textEnNiv: Their buyers slaughter them and go unpunished. Those who sell them say, ‘Praise the Lord , I am rich!’ Their own shepherds do not spare them.
verses.textEnEsv: Those who buy them slaughter them and go unpunished, and those who sell them say, ‘Blessed be the Lord , I have become rich,’ and their own shepherds have no pity on them.
verses.textEnNkjv: whose owners slaughter them and feel no guilt; those who sell them say, ‘Blessed be the Lord, for I am rich’; and their shepherds do not pity them.
verses.textEnNlt: The buyers slaughter their sheep without remorse. The sellers say, ‘Praise the Lord ! Now I’m rich!’ Even the shepherds have no compassion for them.
verses.textEnNasb: Those who buy them slaughter them and go unpunished, and each of those who sell them says, ‘Blessed be the Lord, for I have become rich!’ And their own shepherds have no compassion for them.
verses.textEn: Their buyers slaughter them and go unpunished. Those who sell them say, ‘Praise the Lord , I am rich!’ Their own shepherds do not spare them.

verses.textZh: 因此我必不再怜恤这地的居民 。看哪！我把他们各人交在他的邻舍和君王的手中。他们必摧毁这地，我必不救这地的居民脱离他们的手。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此我必不再怜恤这地的居民 。看哪！我把他们各人交在他的邻舍和君王的手中。他们必摧毁这地，我必不救这地的居民脱离他们的手。"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华说：『我不再怜恤这地的居民，必将这民交给各人的邻舍和他们王的手中。他们必毁灭这地，我也不救这民脱离他们的手。』」
verses.textEnNiv: For I will no longer have pity on the people of the land," declares the Lord . "I will give everyone into the hands of their neighbors and their king. They will devastate the land, and I will not rescue anyone from their hands."
verses.textEnEsv: For I will no longer have pity on the inhabitants of this land, declares the Lord . Behold, I will cause each of them to fall into the hand of his neighbor, and each into the hand of his king, and they shall crush the land, and I will deliver none from their hand."
verses.textEnNkjv: For I will no longer pity the inhabitants of the land," says the Lord. "But indeed I will give everyone into his neighbor’s hand and into the hand of his king. They shall attack the land, and I will not deliver them from their hand."
verses.textEnNlt: Likewise, I will no longer have pity on the people of the land," says the Lord . "I will let them fall into each other’s hands and into the hands of their king. They will turn the land into a wilderness, and I will not rescue them."
verses.textEnNasb: For I will no longer have compassion for the inhabitants of the land," declares the Lord; "but behold, I will let the people fall, each into another’s power and into the power of his king; and they will crush the land, and I will not rescue them from their power."
verses.textEn: For I will no longer have pity on the people of the land," declares the Lord . "I will give everyone into the hands of their neighbors and their king. They will devastate the land, and I will not rescue anyone from their hands."

verses.textZh: 于是，我牧养这将被宰杀的羊群，就是羊群中最困苦的；我取了两根杖，一根我称为"恩宠"，另一根称为"联合"。这样我就牧养了羊群。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是，我牧养这将被宰杀的羊群，就是羊群中最困苦的；我取了两根杖，一根我称为"恩宠"，另一根称为"联合"。这样我就牧养了羊群。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是，我牧养这将宰的群羊，就是群中最困苦的羊。我拿着两根杖，一根我称为「荣美」，一根我称为「联索」。这样，我牧养了群羊。
verses.textEnNiv: So I shepherded the flock marked for slaughter, particularly the oppressed of the flock. Then I took two staffs and called one Favor and the other Union, and I shepherded the flock.
verses.textEnEsv: So I became the shepherd of the flock doomed to be slaughtered by the sheep traders. And I took two staffs, one I named Favor, the other I named Union. And I tended the sheep.
verses.textEnNkjv: So I fed the flock for slaughter, in particular the poor of the flock. I took for myself two staffs: the one I called Beauty, and the other I called Bonds; and I fed the flock.
verses.textEnNlt: So I cared for the flock intended for slaughter—the flock that was oppressed. Then I took two shepherd’s staffs and named one Favor and the other Union.
verses.textEnNasb: So I pastured the flock doomed to slaughter, therefore also the afflicted of the flock. And I took for myself two staffs: the one I called Favor, and the other I called Union; so I pastured the flock.
verses.textEn: So I shepherded the flock marked for slaughter, particularly the oppressed of the flock. Then I took two staffs and called one Favor and the other Union, and I shepherded the flock.

verses.textZh: 在一个月之内我除灭了三个牧人。我的心厌烦他们，他们的心也讨厌我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在一个月之内我除灭了三个牧人。我的心厌烦他们，他们的心也讨厌我。
verses.textZhCuv: 一月之内，我除灭三个牧人，因为我的心厌烦他们；他们的心也憎嫌我。
verses.textEnNiv: In one month I got rid of the three shepherds. The flock detested me, and I grew weary of them
verses.textEnEsv: In one month I destroyed the three shepherds. But I became impatient with them, and they also detested me.
verses.textEnNkjv: I dismissed the three shepherds in one month. My soul loathed them, and their soul also abhorred me.
verses.textEnNlt: I got rid of their three evil shepherds in a single month. But I became impatient with these sheep, and they hated me, too.
verses.textEnNasb: Then I did away with the three shepherds in one month, for my soul was impatient with them, and their soul also was tired of me.
verses.textEn: In one month I got rid of the three shepherds. The flock detested me, and I grew weary of them

verses.textZh: 我就说："我不再牧养你们了；那将要死的，让他死吧！那将要被除灭的，让他被除灭吧；那些余剩的，让他们彼此吞食对方的肉吧！"
