verses.textZhCnvs: 我就说："我不再牧养你们了；那将要死的，让他死吧！那将要被除灭的，让他被除灭吧；那些余剩的，让他们彼此吞食对方的肉吧！"
verses.textZhCuv: 我就说：「我不牧养你们。要死的，由他死；要丧亡的，由他丧亡；余剩的，由他们彼此相食。」
verses.textEnNiv: and said, "I will not be your shepherd. Let the dying die, and the perishing perish. Let those who are left eat one another’s flesh."
verses.textEnEsv: So I said, "I will not be your shepherd. What is to die, let it die. What is to be destroyed, let it be destroyed. And let those who are left devour the flesh of one another."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then I said, "I will not feed you. Let what is dying die, and what is perishing perish. Let those that are left eat each other’s flesh."
verses.textEnNlt: So I told them, "I won’t be your shepherd any longer. If you die, you die. If you are killed, you are killed. And let those who remain devour each other!"
verses.textEnNasb: Then I said, "I will not pasture you. What is to die, let it die, and what is to perish, let it perish; and let those who are left eat one another’s flesh."
verses.textEn: and said, "I will not be your shepherd. Let the dying die, and the perishing perish. Let those who are left eat one another’s flesh."

verses.textZh: 然后，我拿起我那根称为"恩宠"的杖，把它折断，表示要废除我与万民所立的约；
verses.textZhCnvs: 然后，我拿起我那根称为"恩宠"的杖，把它折断，表示要废除我与万民所立的约；
verses.textZhCuv: 我折断那称为「荣美」的杖，表明我废弃与万民所立的约。
verses.textEnNiv: Then I took my staff called Favor and broke it, revoking the covenant I had made with all the nations.
verses.textEnEsv: And I took my staff Favor, and I broke it, annulling the covenant that I had made with all the peoples.
verses.textEnNkjv: And I took my staff, Beauty, and cut it in two, that I might break the covenant which I had made with all the peoples.
verses.textEnNlt: Then I took my staff called Favor and cut it in two, showing that I had revoked the covenant I had made with all the nations.
verses.textEnNasb: And I took my staff Favor and cut it in pieces, to break my covenant which I had made with all the peoples.
verses.textEn: Then I took my staff called Favor and broke it, revoking the covenant I had made with all the nations.

verses.textZh: 那约就在当日废除了。这样，那些仰望我的困苦羊群，就知道这是耶和华的话。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那约就在当日废除了。这样，那些仰望我的困苦羊群，就知道这是耶和华的话。
verses.textZhCuv: 当日就废弃了。这样，那些仰望我的困苦羊就知道所说的是耶和华的话。
verses.textEnNiv: It was revoked on that day, and so the oppressed of the flock who were watching me knew it was the word of the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: So it was annulled on that day, and the sheep traders, who were watching me, knew that it was the word of the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: So it was broken on that day. Thus the poor of the flock, who were watching me, knew that it was the word of the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: That was the end of my covenant with them. The suffering flock was watching me, and they knew that the Lord was speaking through my actions.
verses.textEnNasb: So it was broken on that day, and so the afflicted of the flock who were watching me realized that it was the word of the Lord.
verses.textEn: It was revoked on that day, and so the oppressed of the flock who were watching me knew it was the word of the Lord .

verses.textZh: 我对他们说："你们若看为美，就给我工资；不然，就算了。"于是，他们称了三十块银子作我的工资。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我对他们说："你们若看为美，就给我工资；不然，就算了。"于是，他们称了三十块银子作我的工资。
verses.textZhCuv: 我对他们说：「你们若以为美，就给我工价。不然，就罢了！」于是他们给了三十块钱作为我的工价。
verses.textEnNiv: I told them, "If you think it best, give me my pay; but if not, keep it." So they paid me thirty pieces of silver.
verses.textEnEsv: Then I said to them, "If it seems good to you, give me my wages; but if not, keep them." And they weighed out as my wages thirty pieces of silver.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then I said to them, "If it is agreeable to you, give me my wages; and if not, refrain." So they weighed out for my wages thirty pieces of silver.
verses.textEnNlt: And I said to them, "If you like, give me my wages, whatever I am worth; but only if you want to." So they counted out for my wages thirty pieces of silver.
verses.textEnNasb: And I said to them, "If it is good in your sight, give me my wages; but if not, never mind!" So they weighed out thirty shekels of silver as my wages.
verses.textEn: I told them, "If you think it best, give me my pay; but if not, keep it." So they paid me thirty pieces of silver.

verses.textZh: 那时，耶和华对我说："你要把银子丢给陶匠。"那银子就是他们认为我应得的高价。我就拿了那三十块银子，在耶和华的殿里丢给陶匠了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，耶和华对我说："你要把银子丢给陶匠。"那银子就是他们认为我应得的高价。我就拿了那三十块银子，在耶和华的殿里丢给陶匠了。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华吩咐我说：「要把众人所估定美好的价值丢给窑户。」我便将这三十块钱，在耶和华的殿中丢给窑户了。
verses.textEnNiv: And the Lord said to me, "Throw it to the potter"—the handsome price at which they valued me! So I took the thirty pieces of silver and threw them to the potter at the house of the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: Then the Lord said to me, "Throw it to the potter"— the lordly price at which I was priced by them. So I took the thirty pieces of silver and threw them into the house of the Lord , to the potter.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the Lord said to me, "Throw it to the potter"—that princely price they set on me. So I took the thirty pieces of silver and threw them into the house of the Lord for the potter.
verses.textEnNlt: And the Lord said to me, "Throw it to the potter "—this magnificent sum at which they valued me! So I took the thirty coins and threw them to the potter in the Temple of the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Lord said to me, "Throw it to the potter, that magnificent price at which I was valued by them." So I took the thirty shekels of silver and threw them to the potter in the house of the Lord.
verses.textEn: And the Lord said to me, "Throw it to the potter"—the handsome price at which they valued me! So I took the thirty pieces of silver and threw them to the potter at the house of the Lord .

verses.textZh: 我又折断那称为"联合"的另一根杖，表示要废除犹大和以色列之间的手足之情。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我又折断那称为"联合"的另一根杖，表示要废除犹大和以色列之间的手足之情。
verses.textZhCuv: 我又折断称为「联索」的那根杖，表明我废弃犹大与以色列弟兄的情谊。
verses.textEnNiv: Then I broke my second staff called Union, breaking the family bond between Judah and Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: Then I broke my second staff Union, annulling the brotherhood between Judah and Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then I cut in two my other staff, Bonds, that I might break the brotherhood between Judah and Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: Then I took my other staff, Union, and cut it in two, showing that the bond of unity between Judah and Israel was broken.
verses.textEnNasb: Then I cut in pieces my second staff Union, to break the brotherhood between Judah and Israel.
verses.textEn: Then I broke my second staff called Union, breaking the family bond between Judah and Israel.

verses.textZh: 耶和华又对我说："你去取愚昧牧人的装备来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华又对我说："你去取愚昧牧人的装备来。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华又吩咐我说：「你再取愚昧牧人所用的器具，
verses.textEnNiv: Then the Lord said to me, "Take again the equipment of a foolish shepherd.
verses.textEnEsv: Then the Lord said to me, "Take once more the equipment of a foolish shepherd.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the Lord said to me, "Next, take for yourself the implements of a foolish shepherd.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Lord said to me, "Go again and play the part of a worthless shepherd.
verses.textEnNasb: And the Lord said to me, "Take again for yourself the equipment of a foolish shepherd.
verses.textEn: Then the Lord said to me, "Take again the equipment of a foolish shepherd.

verses.textZh: 因为我要在这地兴起一个牧人；那些快要丧亡的他不看顾，失散的他不寻找，受伤的他不医治，强壮的他不喂养，他却要吃肥羊的肉，撕掉牠们的蹄子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为我要在这地兴起一个牧人；那些快要丧亡的他不看顾，失散的他不寻找，受伤的他不医治，强壮的他不喂养，他却要吃肥羊的肉，撕掉牠们的蹄子。
verses.textZhCuv: 因我要在这地兴起一个牧人。他不看顾丧亡的，不寻找分散的，不医治受伤的，也不牧养强壮的；却要吃肥羊的肉，撕裂它的蹄子。
verses.textEnNiv: For I am going to raise up a shepherd over the land who will not care for the lost, or seek the young, or heal the injured, or feed the healthy, but will eat the meat of the choice sheep, tearing off their hooves.
verses.textEnEsv: For behold, I am raising up in the land a shepherd who does not care for those being destroyed, or seek the young or heal the maimed or nourish the healthy, but devours the flesh of the fat ones, tearing off even their hoofs.
verses.textEnNkjv: For indeed I will raise up a shepherd in the land who will not care for those who are cut off, nor seek the young, nor heal those that are broken, nor feed those that still stand. But he will eat the flesh of the fat and tear their hooves in pieces.
verses.textEnNlt: This illustrates how I will give this nation a shepherd who will not care for those who are dying, nor look after the young, nor heal the injured, nor feed the healthy. Instead, this shepherd will eat the meat of the fattest sheep and tear off their hooves.
verses.textEnNasb: For behold, I am going to raise up a shepherd in the land who will not care for the perishing, seek the scattered, heal the broken, or provide for the one who is exhausted, but will devour the flesh of the fat sheep and tear off their hoofs.
verses.textEn: For I am going to raise up a shepherd over the land who will not care for the lost, or seek the young, or heal the injured, or feed the healthy, but will eat the meat of the choice sheep, tearing off their hooves.

verses.textZh: "那丢弃羊群的无用牧人有祸了！ 愿刀剑落在他的膀臂和他的右眼上； 愿他的膀臂全然枯槁， 愿他的右眼完全失明！"
verses.textZhCnvs: "那丢弃羊群的无用牧人有祸了！ 愿刀剑落在他的膀臂和他的右眼上； 愿他的膀臂全然枯槁， 愿他的右眼完全失明！"
verses.textZhCuv: 无用的牧人丢弃羊群有祸了！ 刀必临到他的膀臂和右眼上。 他的膀臂必全然枯干； 他的右眼也必昏暗失明。」
verses.textEnNiv: "Woe to the worthless shepherd, who deserts the flock! May the sword strike his arm and his right eye! May his arm be completely withered, his right eye totally blinded!"
verses.textEnEsv: "Woe to my worthless shepherd, who deserts the flock! May the sword strike his arm and his right eye! Let his arm be wholly withered, his right eye utterly blinded!"
verses.textEnNkjv: "Woe to the worthless shepherd, Who leaves the flock! A sword shallbe against his arm And against his right eye; His arm shall completely wither, And his right eye shall be totally blinded."
verses.textEnNlt: "What sorrow awaits this worthless shepherd who abandons the flock! The sword will cut his arm and pierce his right eye. His arm will become useless, and his right eye completely blind."
verses.textEnNasb: "Woe to the worthless shepherd Who abandons the flock! A sword will be on his arm And on his right eye! His arm will be totally withered, And his right eye will be blind."
verses.textEn: "Woe to the worthless shepherd, who deserts the flock! May the sword strike his arm and his right eye! May his arm be completely withered, his right eye totally blinded!"

verses.textEnNlt: This message concerning the fate of Israel came from the Lord : "This message is from the Lord , who stretched out the heavens, laid the foundations of the earth, and formed the human spirit.

verses.textZh: "看哪！我要使耶路撒冷成为令周围万族喝醉的杯；耶路撒冷被围困的时候，犹大也必受到攻击。
verses.textZhCnvs: "看哪！我要使耶路撒冷成为令周围万族喝醉的杯；耶路撒冷被围困的时候，犹大也必受到攻击。
verses.textZhCuv: 「我必使耶路撒冷被围困的时候，向四围列国的民成为令人昏醉的杯；这默示也论到犹大 。
verses.textEnNiv: "I am going to make Jerusalem a cup that sends all the surrounding peoples reeling. Judah will be besieged as well as Jerusalem.
verses.textEnEsv: "Behold, I am about to make Jerusalem a cup of staggering to all the surrounding peoples. The siege of Jerusalem will also be against Judah.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Behold, I will make Jerusalem a cup of drunkenness to all the surrounding peoples, when they lay siege against Judah and Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNlt: I will make Jerusalem like an intoxicating drink that makes the nearby nations stagger when they send their armies to besiege Jerusalem and Judah.
verses.textEnNasb: "Behold, I am going to make Jerusalem a cup that causes staggering to all the peoples around; and when the siege is against Jerusalem, it will also be against Judah.
verses.textEn: "I am going to make Jerusalem a cup that sends all the surrounding peoples reeling. Judah will be besieged as well as Jerusalem.

verses.textZh: 到那日，我要使耶路撒冷对万族来说像一块沉重的石头，举起它的必受重伤；地上的列国必聚集起来攻击耶路撒冷。
verses.textZhCnvs: 到那日，我要使耶路撒冷对万族来说像一块沉重的石头，举起它的必受重伤；地上的列国必聚集起来攻击耶路撒冷。
verses.textZhCuv: 那日，我必使耶路撒冷向聚集攻击他的万民当作一块重石头；凡举起的必受重伤。
verses.textEnNiv: On that day, when all the nations of the earth are gathered against her, I will make Jerusalem an immovable rock for all the nations. All who try to move it will injure themselves.
verses.textEnEsv: On that day I will make Jerusalem a heavy stone for all the peoples. All who lift it will surely hurt themselves. And all the nations of the earth will gather against it.
verses.textEnNkjv: And it shall happen in that day that I will make Jerusalem a very heavy stone for all peoples; all who would heave it away will surely be cut in pieces, though all nations of the earth are gathered against it.
verses.textEnNlt: On that day I will make Jerusalem an immovable rock. All the nations will gather against it to try to move it, but they will only hurt themselves.
verses.textEnNasb: It will come about on that day that I will make Jerusalem a heavy stone for all the peoples; all who lift it will injure themselves severely. And all the nations of the earth will be gathered against it.
verses.textEn: On that day, when all the nations of the earth are gathered against her, I will make Jerusalem an immovable rock for all the nations. All who try to move it will injure themselves.

verses.textZh: 到那日 ，我要击打所有的马匹，使牠们惊恐，击打骑马的人，使他们疯狂；我必开眼看顾犹大家，我要击打万族所有的马匹，使牠们瞎眼。
verses.textZhCnvs: 到那日 ，我要击打所有的马匹，使牠们惊恐，击打骑马的人，使他们疯狂；我必开眼看顾犹大家，我要击打万族所有的马匹，使牠们瞎眼。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华说：到那日，我必使一切马匹惊惶，使骑马的颠狂。我必看顾犹大家，使列国的一切马匹瞎眼。
verses.textEnNiv: On that day I will strike every horse with panic and its rider with madness," declares the Lord . "I will keep a watchful eye over Judah, but I will blind all the horses of the nations.
verses.textEnEsv: On that day, declares the Lord , I will strike every horse with panic, and its rider with madness. But for the sake of the house of Judah I will keep my eyes open, when I strike every horse of the peoples with blindness.
verses.textEnNkjv: In that day," says the Lord, "I will strike every horse with confusion, and its rider with madness; I will open My eyes on the house of Judah, and will strike every horse of the peoples with blindness.
verses.textEnNlt: "On that day," says the Lord , "I will cause every horse to panic and every rider to lose his nerve. I will watch over the people of Judah, but I will blind all the horses of their enemies.
verses.textEnNasb: On that day," declares the Lord, "I will strike every horse with confusion and its rider with insanity. But I will watch over the house of Judah, while I strike every horse of the peoples with blindness.
verses.textEn: On that day I will strike every horse with panic and its rider with madness," declares the Lord . "I will keep a watchful eye over Judah, but I will blind all the horses of the nations.

verses.textZh: 那时，犹大的族长必心里说：‘耶路撒冷的居民，靠万军之耶和华他们的神得着力量。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，犹大的族长必心里说：‘耶路撒冷的居民，靠万军之耶和华他们的神得着力量。’
verses.textZhCuv: 犹大的族长必心里说：『耶路撒冷的居民倚靠万军之耶和华－他们的神，就作我们的能力。』
verses.textEnNiv: Then the clans of Judah will say in their hearts, ‘The people of Jerusalem are strong, because the Lord Almighty is their God.’
verses.textEnEsv: Then the clans of Judah shall say to themselves, ‘The inhabitants of Jerusalem have strength through the Lord of hosts, their God.’
verses.textEnNkjv: And the governors of Judah shall say in their heart, ‘The inhabitants of Jerusalem are my strength in the Lord of hosts, their God.’
verses.textEnNlt: And the clans of Judah will say to themselves, ‘The people of Jerusalem have found strength in the Lord of Heaven’s Armies, their God.’
verses.textEnNasb: Then the clans of Judah will say in their hearts, ‘The inhabitants of Jerusalem are a strong support for us through the Lord of armies, their God.’
verses.textEn: Then the clans of Judah will say in their hearts, ‘The people of Jerusalem are strong, because the Lord Almighty is their God.’

verses.textZh: "到那日，我必使犹大的族长好象木柴中的火盆，又好象禾捆中的火把；他们必向左右吞灭周围的万族，但耶路撒冷的人必仍在城中原处安居。
verses.textZhCnvs: "到那日，我必使犹大的族长好象木柴中的火盆，又好象禾捆中的火把；他们必向左右吞灭周围的万族，但耶路撒冷的人必仍在城中原处安居。
verses.textZhCuv: 「那日，我必使犹大的族长如火盆在木柴中，又如火把在禾捆里；他们必左右烧灭四围列国的民。耶路撒冷人必仍住本处，就是耶路撒冷。
verses.textEnNiv: "On that day I will make the clans of Judah like a firepot in a woodpile, like a flaming torch among sheaves. They will consume all the surrounding peoples right and left, but Jerusalem will remain intact in her place.
verses.textEnEsv: "On that day I will make the clans of Judah like a blazing pot in the midst of wood, like a flaming torch among sheaves. And they shall devour to the right and to the left all the surrounding peoples, while Jerusalem shall again be inhabited in its place, in Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNkjv: In that day I will make the governors of Judah like a firepan in the woodpile, and like a fiery torch in the sheaves; they shall devour all the surrounding peoples on the right hand and on the left, but Jerusalem shall be inhabited again in her own place—Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNlt: "On that day I will make the clans of Judah like a flame that sets a woodpile ablaze or like a burning torch among sheaves of grain. They will burn up all the neighboring nations right and left, while the people living in Jerusalem remain secure.
verses.textEnNasb: "On that day I will make the clans of Judah like a firepot among pieces of wood and a flaming torch among sheaves, so they will consume on the right and on the left all the surrounding peoples, while the inhabitants of Jerusalem again live on their own sites in Jerusalem.
verses.textEn: "On that day I will make the clans of Judah like a firepot in a woodpile, like a flaming torch among sheaves. They will consume all the surrounding peoples right and left, but Jerusalem will remain intact in her place.

verses.textZh: "耶和华必先拯救犹大的帐棚，免得大卫家的荣耀和耶路撒冷居民的荣耀胜过犹大。
verses.textZhCnvs: "耶和华必先拯救犹大的帐棚，免得大卫家的荣耀和耶路撒冷居民的荣耀胜过犹大。
verses.textZhCuv: 「耶和华必先拯救犹大的帐棚，免得大卫家的荣耀和耶路撒冷居民的荣耀胜过犹大。
verses.textEnNiv: "The Lord will save the dwellings of Judah first, so that the honor of the house of David and of Jerusalem’s inhabitants may not be greater than that of Judah.
verses.textEnEsv: "And the Lord will give salvation to the tents of Judah first, that the glory of the house of David and the glory of the inhabitants of Jerusalem may not surpass that of Judah.
verses.textEnNkjv: "The Lord will save the tents of Judah first, so that the glory of the house of David and the glory of the inhabitants of Jerusalem shall not become greater than that of Judah.
verses.textEnNlt: "The Lord will give victory to the rest of Judah first, before Jerusalem, so that the people of Jerusalem and the royal line of David will not have greater honor than the rest of Judah.
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord also will save the tents of Judah first, so that the glory of the house of David and the glory of the inhabitants of Jerusalem will not be greater than Judah.
verses.textEn: "The Lord will save the dwellings of Judah first, so that the honor of the house of David and of Jerusalem’s inhabitants may not be greater than that of Judah.

verses.textZh: 到那日，耶和华必保护耶路撒冷的居民；他们中间最软弱的，到那日必好象大卫，大卫家必好象神，好象行在他们前面的耶和华使者。
verses.textZhCnvs: 到那日，耶和华必保护耶路撒冷的居民；他们中间最软弱的，到那日必好象大卫，大卫家必好象神，好象行在他们前面的耶和华使者。
verses.textZhCuv: 那日，耶和华必保护耶路撒冷的居民。他们中间软弱的必如大卫；大卫的家必如神，如行在他们前面之耶和华的使者。
verses.textEnNiv: On that day the Lord will shield those who live in Jerusalem, so that the feeblest among them will be like David, and the house of David will be like God, like the angel of the Lord going before them.
verses.textEnEsv: On that day the Lord will protect the inhabitants of Jerusalem, so that the feeblest among them on that day shall be like David, and the house of David shall be like God, like the angel of the Lord , going before them.
verses.textEnNkjv: In that day the Lord will defend the inhabitants of Jerusalem; the one who is feeble among them in that day shall be like David, and the house of David shallbe like God, like the Angel of the Lord before them.
verses.textEnNlt: On that day the Lord will defend the people of Jerusalem; the weakest among them will be as mighty as King David! And the royal descendants will be like God, like the angel of the Lord who goes before them!
verses.textEnNasb: On that day the Lord will protect the inhabitants of Jerusalem, and the one who is feeble among them on that day will be like David, and the house of David will be like God, like the angel of the Lord before them.
verses.textEn: On that day the Lord will shield those who live in Jerusalem, so that the feeblest among them will be like David, and the house of David will be like God, like the angel of the Lord going before them.

verses.textZh: 到那日，我必歼灭所有前来攻打耶路撒冷的列国。
verses.textZhCnvs: 到那日，我必歼灭所有前来攻打耶路撒冷的列国。
verses.textZhCuv: 那日，我必定意灭绝来攻击耶路撒冷各国的民。
verses.textEnNiv: On that day I will set out to destroy all the nations that attack Jerusalem.
verses.textEnEsv: And on that day I will seek to destroy all the nations that come against Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNkjv: It shall be in that day that I will seek to destroy all the nations that come against Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNlt: For on that day I will begin to destroy all the nations that come against Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNasb: And on that day I will seek to destroy all the nations that come against Jerusalem.
verses.textEn: On that day I will set out to destroy all the nations that attack Jerusalem.

verses.textZh: "我必把那恩慈与恳求的灵倾注在大卫家和耶路撒冷居民的身上。他们必仰望我，就是他们所刺的；他们要为他哀哭，好象丧独生子；他们必为他悲痛，好象丧长子。
verses.textZhCnvs: "我必把那恩慈与恳求的灵倾注在大卫家和耶路撒冷居民的身上。他们必仰望我，就是他们所刺的；他们要为他哀哭，好象丧独生子；他们必为他悲痛，好象丧长子。
verses.textZhCuv: 「我必将那施恩叫人恳求的灵，浇灌大卫家和耶路撒冷的居民。他们必仰望我 ，就是他们所扎的；必为我悲哀，如丧独生子，又为我愁苦，如丧长子。
verses.textEnNiv: "And I will pour out on the house of David and the inhabitants of Jerusalem a spirit of grace and supplication. They will look on me, the one they have pierced, and they will mourn for him as one mourns for an only child, and grieve bitterly for him as one grieves for a firstborn son.
verses.textEnEsv: "And I will pour out on the house of David and the inhabitants of Jerusalem a spirit of grace and pleas for mercy, so that, when they look on me, on him whom they have pierced, they shall mourn for him, as one mourns for an only child, and weep bitterly over him, as one weeps over a firstborn.
verses.textEnNkjv: "And I will pour on the house of David and on the inhabitants of Jerusalem the Spirit of grace and supplication; then they will look on Me whom they pierced. Yes, they will mourn for Him as one mourns for his only son, and grieve for Him as one grieves for a firstborn.
verses.textEnNlt: "Then I will pour out a spirit of grace and prayer on the family of David and on the people of Jerusalem. They will look on me whom they have pierced and mourn for him as for an only son. They will grieve bitterly for him as for a firstborn son who has died.
verses.textEnNasb: "And I will pour out on the house of David and on the inhabitants of Jerusalem the Spirit of grace and of pleading, so that they will look at Me whom they pierced; and they will mourn for Him, like one mourning for an only son, and they will weep bitterly over Him like the bitter weeping over a firstborn.
verses.textEn: "And I will pour out on the house of David and the inhabitants of Jerusalem a spirit of grace and supplication. They will look on me, the one they have pierced, and they will mourn for him as one mourns for an only child, and grieve bitterly for him as one grieves for a firstborn son.

verses.textZh: 到那日，耶路撒冷必有极大的哀哭，像在米吉多平原的哈达临门的哀哭一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 到那日，耶路撒冷必有极大的哀哭，像在米吉多平原的哈达临门的哀哭一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 那日，耶路撒冷必有大大的悲哀，如米吉多平原之哈达临门的悲哀。
verses.textEnNiv: On that day the weeping in Jerusalem will be as great as the weeping of Hadad Rimmon in the plain of Megiddo.
verses.textEnEsv: On that day the mourning in Jerusalem will be as great as the mourning for Hadad-rimmon in the plain of Megiddo.
verses.textEnNkjv: In that day there shall be a great mourning in Jerusalem, like the mourning at Hadad Rimmon in the plain of Megiddo.
verses.textEnNlt: The sorrow and mourning in Jerusalem on that day will be like the great mourning for Hadad-rimmon in the valley of Megiddo.
verses.textEnNasb: On that day the mourning in Jerusalem will be great, like the mourning of Hadadrimmon in the plain of Megiddo.
verses.textEn: On that day the weeping in Jerusalem will be as great as the weeping of Hadad Rimmon in the plain of Megiddo.

verses.textZh: 全地都要哀哭，一家一家独在一处哀哭。大卫家独在一处，他们的妇女也独在一处；拿单家独在一处，他们的妇女也独在一处；
verses.textZhCnvs: 全地都要哀哭，一家一家独在一处哀哭。大卫家独在一处，他们的妇女也独在一处；拿单家独在一处，他们的妇女也独在一处；
verses.textZhCuv: 境内一家一家地都必悲哀。大卫家，男的独在一处，女的独在一处。拿单家，男的独在一处，女的独在一处。
verses.textEnNiv: The land will mourn, each clan by itself, with their wives by themselves: the clan of the house of David and their wives, the clan of the house of Nathan and their wives,
verses.textEnEsv: The land shall mourn, each family by itself: the family of the house of David by itself, and their wives by themselves; the family of the house of Nathan by itself, and their wives by themselves;
verses.textEnNkjv: And the land shall mourn, every family by itself: the family of the house of David by itself, and their wives by themselves; the family of the house of Nathan by itself, and their wives by themselves;
verses.textEnNlt: "All Israel will mourn, each clan by itself, and with the husbands separate from their wives. The clan of David will mourn alone, as will the clan of Nathan,
verses.textEnNasb: The land will mourn, every family by itself; the family of the house of David by itself and their wives by themselves; the family of the house of Nathan by itself and their wives by themselves;
verses.textEn: The land will mourn, each clan by itself, with their wives by themselves: the clan of the house of David and their wives, the clan of the house of Nathan and their wives,

verses.textZh: 利未家独在一处，他们的妇女也独在一处；示每家独在一处，他们的妇女也独在一处；
verses.textZhCnvs: 利未家独在一处，他们的妇女也独在一处；示每家独在一处，他们的妇女也独在一处；
verses.textZhCuv: 利未家，男的独在一处，女的独在一处。示每家，男的独在一处，女的独在一处。
verses.textEnNiv: the clan of the house of Levi and their wives, the clan of Shimei and their wives,
verses.textEnEsv: the family of the house of Levi by itself, and their wives by themselves; the family of the Shimeites by itself, and their wives by themselves;
verses.textEnNkjv: the family of the house of Levi by itself, and their wives by themselves; the family of Shimei by itself, and their wives by themselves;
verses.textEnNlt: the clan of Levi, and the clan of Shimei.
verses.textEnNasb: the family of the house of Levi by itself and their wives by themselves; the family of the Shimeites by itself and their wives by themselves;
verses.textEn: the clan of the house of Levi and their wives, the clan of Shimei and their wives,

verses.textZh: 其余的各家都是一家一家独在一处，他们的妇女也独在一处。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 其余的各家都是一家一家独在一处，他们的妇女也独在一处。"
verses.textZhCuv: 其余的各家，男的独在一处，女的独在一处。
verses.textEnNiv: and all the rest of the clans and their wives.
verses.textEnEsv: and all the families that are left, each by itself, and their wives by themselves.
verses.textEnNkjv: all the families that remain, every family by itself, and their wives by themselves.
verses.textEnNlt: Each of the surviving clans from Judah will mourn separately, and with the husbands separate from their wives.
verses.textEnNasb: all the families that are left, every family by itself, and their wives by themselves.
verses.textEn: and all the rest of the clans and their wives.

verses.textZh: "到那日，必有一个泉源，为大卫家和耶路撒冷的居民开放，洗除他们的罪恶和不洁。
verses.textZhCnvs: "到那日，必有一个泉源，为大卫家和耶路撒冷的居民开放，洗除他们的罪恶和不洁。
verses.textZhCuv: 「那日，必给大卫家和耶路撒冷的居民开一个泉源，洗除罪恶与污秽。」
verses.textEnNiv: "On that day a fountain will be opened to the house of David and the inhabitants of Jerusalem, to cleanse them from sin and impurity.
verses.textEnEsv: "On that day there shall be a fountain opened for the house of David and the inhabitants of Jerusalem, to cleanse them from sin and uncleanness.
verses.textEnNkjv: "In that day a fountain shall be opened for the house of David and for the inhabitants of Jerusalem, for sin and for uncleanness.
verses.textEnNlt: "On that day a fountain will be opened for the dynasty of David and for the people of Jerusalem, a fountain to cleanse them from all their sins and impurity.
verses.textEnNasb: "On that day a fountain will be opened for the house of David and for the inhabitants of Jerusalem, for sin and for defilement.
verses.textEn: "On that day a fountain will be opened to the house of David and the inhabitants of Jerusalem, to cleanse them from sin and impurity.

verses.textZh: "到那日 ，我必从这地除掉偶像的名号，它们不再被人记念；我也必从这地除去假先知和污秽的灵。
verses.textZhCnvs: "到那日 ，我必从这地除掉偶像的名号，它们不再被人记念；我也必从这地除去假先知和污秽的灵。
verses.textZhCuv: 万军之耶和华说：「那日，我必从地上除灭偶像的名，不再被人记念；也必使这地不再有假先知与污秽的灵。
verses.textEnNiv: "On that day, I will banish the names of the idols from the land, and they will be remembered no more," declares the Lord Almighty. "I will remove both the prophets and the spirit of impurity from the land.
verses.textEnEsv: "And on that day, declares the Lord of hosts, I will cut off the names of the idols from the land, so that they shall be remembered no more. And also I will remove from the land the prophets and the spirit of uncleanness.
verses.textEnNkjv: "It shall be in that day," says the Lord of hosts, "that I will cut off the names of the idols from the land, and they shall no longer be remembered. I will also cause the prophets and the unclean spirit to depart from the land.
verses.textEnNlt: "And on that day," says the Lord of Heaven’s Armies, "I will erase idol worship throughout the land, so that even the names of the idols will be forgotten. I will remove from the land both the false prophets and the spirit of impurity that came with them.
verses.textEnNasb: "And it will come about on that day," declares the Lord of armies, "that I will eliminate the names of the idols from the land, and they will no longer be remembered; and I will also remove the prophets and the unclean spirit from the land.
verses.textEn: "On that day, I will banish the names of the idols from the land, and they will be remembered no more," declares the Lord Almighty. "I will remove both the prophets and the spirit of impurity from the land.

verses.textZh: 如果有人再说预言，他的亲生父母必对他说：‘你不该活着，因为你奉耶和华的名说谎。’他说预言的时候，他的亲生父母必把他刺死。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果有人再说预言，他的亲生父母必对他说：‘你不该活着，因为你奉耶和华的名说谎。’他说预言的时候，他的亲生父母必把他刺死。
verses.textZhCuv: 若再有人说预言，生他的父母必对他说：『你不得存活，因为你托耶和华的名说假预言。』生他的父母在他说预言的时候，要将他刺透。
verses.textEnNiv: And if anyone still prophesies, their father and mother, to whom they were born, will say to them, ‘You must die, because you have told lies in the Lord ’s name.’ Then their own parents will stab the one who prophesies.
verses.textEnEsv: And if anyone again prophesies, his father and mother who bore him will say to him, ‘You shall not live, for you speak lies in the name of the Lord .’ And his father and mother who bore him shall pierce him through when he prophesies.
verses.textEnNkjv: It shall come to pass that if anyone still prophesies, then his father and mother who begot him will say to him, ‘You shall not live, because you have spoken lies in the name of the Lord.’ And his father and mother who begot him shall thrust him through when he prophesies.
verses.textEnNlt: If anyone continues to prophesy, his own father and mother will tell him, ‘You must die, for you have prophesied lies in the name of the Lord .’ And as he prophesies, his own father and mother will stab him.
verses.textEnNasb: And if anyone still prophesies, then his father and mother who gave birth to him will say to him, ‘You shall not live, because you have spoken falsely in the name of the Lord’; and his father and mother who gave birth to him shall pierce him through when he prophesies.
verses.textEn: And if anyone still prophesies, their father and mother, to whom they were born, will say to them, ‘You must die, because you have told lies in the Lord ’s name.’ Then their own parents will stab the one who prophesies.

verses.textZh: "到那日，假先知说预言的时候，每一个都必因自己所论的异象而羞愧；他们必不再穿兽毛衣服欺骗人。
verses.textZhCnvs: "到那日，假先知说预言的时候，每一个都必因自己所论的异象而羞愧；他们必不再穿兽毛衣服欺骗人。
verses.textZhCuv: 那日，凡作先知说预言的必因他所论的异象羞愧，不再穿毛衣哄骗人。
verses.textEnNiv: "On that day every prophet will be ashamed of their prophetic vision. They will not put on a prophet’s garment of hair in order to deceive.
verses.textEnEsv: "On that day every prophet will be ashamed of his vision when he prophesies. He will not put on a hairy cloak in order to deceive,
verses.textEnNkjv: "And it shall be in that day that every prophet will be ashamed of his vision when he prophesies; they will not wear a robe of coarse hair to deceive.
verses.textEnNlt: "On that day people will be ashamed to claim the prophetic gift. No one will pretend to be a prophet by wearing prophet’s clothes.
verses.textEnNasb: Also it will come about on that day that the prophets will each be ashamed of his vision when he prophesies, and they will not put on a hairy robe in order to deceive;
verses.textEn: "On that day every prophet will be ashamed of their prophetic vision. They will not put on a prophet’s garment of hair in order to deceive.

verses.textZh: 那时他必说：‘我不是先知，只是耕地的人；因为我自幼以来，就被卖为奴。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时他必说：‘我不是先知，只是耕地的人；因为我自幼以来，就被卖为奴。’
verses.textZhCuv: 他必说：『我不是先知，我是耕地的；我从幼年作人的奴仆。』
verses.textEnNiv: Each will say, ‘I am not a prophet. I am a farmer; the land has been my livelihood since my youth. ’
verses.textEnEsv: but he will say, ‘I am no prophet, I am a worker of the soil, for a man sold me in my youth.’
verses.textEnNkjv: But he will say, ‘I am no prophet, I am a farmer; for a man taught me to keep cattle from my youth.’
verses.textEnNlt: He will say, ‘I’m no prophet; I’m a farmer. I began working for a farmer as a boy.’
verses.textEnNasb: but he will say, ‘I am not a prophet; I am a cultivator of the ground, because a man sold me as a slave in my youth.’
verses.textEn: Each will say, ‘I am not a prophet. I am a farmer; the land has been my livelihood since my youth. ’

verses.textZh: 如果有人问他：‘怎么在你胸口上 有这些伤痕呢？’他就必回答：‘这些是在爱我的人家里所受的伤。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果有人问他：‘怎么在你胸口上 有这些伤痕呢？’他就必回答：‘这些是在爱我的人家里所受的伤。’
verses.textZhCuv: 必有人问他说：『你两臂中间是什么伤呢？』他必回答说：『这是我在亲友家中所受的伤。』」
verses.textEnNiv: If someone asks, ‘What are these wounds on your body ?’ they will answer, ‘The wounds I was given at the house of my friends.’
verses.textEnEsv: And if one asks him, ‘What are these wounds on your back?’ he will say, ‘The wounds I received in the house of my friends.’
verses.textEnNkjv: And one will say to him, ‘What are these wounds between your arms?’ Then he will answer, ‘Those with which I was wounded in the house of my friends.’
verses.textEnNlt: And if someone asks, ‘Then what about those wounds on your chest? ’ he will say, ‘I was wounded at my friends’ house!’
verses.textEnNasb: And someone will say to him, ‘What are these wounds between your arms?’ Then he will say, ‘Those with which I was wounded at the house of my friends.’
verses.textEn: If someone asks, ‘What are these wounds on your body ?’ they will answer, ‘The wounds I was given at the house of my friends.’

verses.textZh: "刀剑哪，醒来吧！攻击我的牧人，我的同伴， 要击打牧人，羊群就分散； 我也要转过手来，攻击小羊。
verses.textZhCnvs: "刀剑哪，醒来吧！攻击我的牧人，我的同伴， 要击打牧人，羊群就分散； 我也要转过手来，攻击小羊。
verses.textZhCuv: 万军之耶和华说： 刀剑哪，应当兴起， 攻击我的牧人和我的同伴。 击打牧人，羊就分散； 我必反手加在微小者的身上。
verses.textEnNiv: "Awake, sword, against my shepherd, against the man who is close to me!" declares the Lord Almighty. "Strike the shepherd, and the sheep will be scattered, and I will turn my hand against the little ones.
verses.textEnEsv: "Awake, O sword, against my shepherd, against the man who stands next to me," declares the Lord of hosts. "Strike the shepherd, and the sheep will be scattered; I will turn my hand against the little ones.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Awake, O sword, against My Shepherd, Against the Man who is My Companion," Says the Lord of hosts. "Strike the Shepherd, And the sheep will be scattered; Then I will turn My hand against the little ones.
verses.textEnNlt: "Awake, O sword, against my shepherd, the man who is my partner," says the Lord of Heaven’s Armies. "Strike down the shepherd, and the sheep will be scattered, and I will turn against the lambs.
verses.textEnNasb: "Awake, sword, against My Shepherd, And against the Man, My Associate," Declares the Lord of armies. "Strike the Shepherd and the sheep will be scattered; And I will turn My hand against the little ones.
verses.textEn: "Awake, sword, against my shepherd, against the man who is close to me!" declares the Lord Almighty. "Strike the shepherd, and the sheep will be scattered, and I will turn my hand against the little ones.

verses.textZh: 全地的人必有三分之二被除灭， 只有三分之一存留下来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 全地的人必有三分之二被除灭， 只有三分之一存留下来。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华说：这全地的人， 三分之二必剪除而死， 三分之一仍必存留。
verses.textEnNiv: In the whole land," declares the Lord , "two-thirds will be struck down and perish; yet one-third will be left in it.
verses.textEnEsv: In the whole land, declares the Lord , two thirds shall be cut off and perish, and one third shall be left alive.
verses.textEnNkjv: And it shall come to pass in all the land," Says the Lord, "That two-thirds in it shall be cut off and die, But one–third shall be left in it:
verses.textEnNlt: Two-thirds of the people in the land will be cut off and die," says the Lord . "But one-third will be left in the land.
verses.textEnNasb: "And it will come about in all the land," Declares the Lord, "That two parts in it will be cut off and perish; But the third will be left in it.
verses.textEn: In the whole land," declares the Lord , "two-thirds will be struck down and perish; yet one-third will be left in it.

verses.textZh: 我必使这三分之一经火试炼。 我要炼净他们，像炼净银子一样； 我要试炼他们，像试炼金子一样。 他们必呼求我的名，我必应允他们。 我要说：‘他们是我的子民。’ 他们也要说：‘耶和华是我们的神。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我必使这三分之一经火试炼。 我要炼净他们，像炼净银子一样； 我要试炼他们，像试炼金子一样。 他们必呼求我的名，我必应允他们。 我要说：‘他们是我的子民。’ 他们也要说：‘耶和华是我们的神。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 我要使这三分之一经火， 熬炼他们，如熬炼银子； 试炼他们，如试炼金子。 他们必求告我的名， 我必应允他们。 我要说：这是我的子民。 他们也要说：耶和华是我们的神。
verses.textEnNiv: This third I will put into the fire; I will refine them like silver and test them like gold. They will call on my name and I will answer them; I will say, ‘They are my people,’ and they will say, ‘The Lord is our God.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: And I will put this third into the fire, and refine them as one refines silver, and test them as gold is tested. They will call upon my name, and I will answer them. I will say, ‘They are my people’; and they will say, ‘The Lord is my God.’"
verses.textEnNkjv: I will bring the one–third through the fire, Will refine them as silver is refined, And test them as gold is tested. They will call on My name, And I will answer them. I will say, ‘This is My people’; And each one will say, ‘The Lordis my God.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: I will bring that group through the fire and make them pure. I will refine them like silver and purify them like gold. They will call on my name, and I will answer them. I will say, ‘These are my people,’ and they will say, ‘The Lord is our God.’"
verses.textEnNasb: "And I will bring the third part through the fire, Refine them as silver is refined, And test them as gold is tested. They will call on My name, And I will answer them; I will say, ‘They are My people,’ And they will say, ‘The Lord is my God.’ "
verses.textEn: This third I will put into the fire; I will refine them like silver and test them like gold. They will call on my name and I will answer them; I will say, ‘They are my people,’ and they will say, ‘The Lord is our God.’ "

verses.textZh: 看哪！耶和华的日子快到，人要在你中间分取你的掠物。
verses.textZhCnvs: 看哪！耶和华的日子快到，人要在你中间分取你的掠物。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华的日子临近，你的财物必被抢掠，在你中间分散。
verses.textEnNiv: A day of the Lord is coming, Jerusalem, when your possessions will be plundered and divided up within your very walls.
verses.textEnEsv: Behold, a day is coming for the Lord , when the spoil taken from you will be divided in your midst.
verses.textEnNkjv: Behold, the day of the Lord is coming, And your spoil will be divided in your midst.
verses.textEnNlt: Watch, for the day of the Lord is coming when your possessions will be plundered right in front of you!
verses.textEnNasb: Behold, a day is coming for the Lord when the spoils taken from you will be divided among you.
verses.textEn: A day of the Lord is coming, Jerusalem, when your possessions will be plundered and divided up within your very walls.

verses.textZh: 因为我必招聚列国与耶路撒冷作战，城必被占领，房屋被抢掠，妇女被强奸。城中的居民必有半数被掳去，剩下的人民必不会从这城里被剪除。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为我必招聚列国与耶路撒冷作战，城必被占领，房屋被抢掠，妇女被强奸。城中的居民必有半数被掳去，剩下的人民必不会从这城里被剪除。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为我必聚集万国与耶路撒冷争战，城必被攻取，房屋被抢夺，妇女被玷污，城中的民一半被掳去；剩下的民仍在城中，不致剪除。
verses.textEnNiv: I will gather all the nations to Jerusalem to fight against it; the city will be captured, the houses ransacked, and the women raped. Half of the city will go into exile, but the rest of the people will not be taken from the city.
verses.textEnEsv: For I will gather all the nations against Jerusalem to battle, and the city shall be taken and the houses plundered and the women raped. Half of the city shall go out into exile, but the rest of the people shall not be cut off from the city.
verses.textEnNkjv: For I will gather all the nations to battle against Jerusalem; The city shall be taken, The houses rifled, And the women ravished. Half of the city shall go into captivity, But the remnant of the people shall not be cut off from the city.
verses.textEnNlt: I will gather all the nations to fight against Jerusalem. The city will be taken, the houses looted, and the women raped. Half the population will be taken into captivity, and the rest will be left among the ruins of the city.
verses.textEnNasb: For I will gather all the nations against Jerusalem to battle, and the city will be taken, the houses plundered, the women raped, and half of the city exiled, but the rest of the people will not be eliminated from the city.
verses.textEn: I will gather all the nations to Jerusalem to fight against it; the city will be captured, the houses ransacked, and the women raped. Half of the city will go into exile, but the rest of the people will not be taken from the city.

verses.textZh: 那时，耶和华要出去，与那些国家作战，像他以前在战争的日子作战一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，耶和华要出去，与那些国家作战，像他以前在战争的日子作战一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 那时，耶和华必出去与那些国争战，好像从前争战一样。
verses.textEnNiv: Then the Lord will go out and fight against those nations, as he fights on a day of battle.
verses.textEnEsv: Then the Lord will go out and fight against those nations as when he fights on a day of battle.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Lord will go forth And fight against those nations, As He fights in the day of battle.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Lord will go out to fight against those nations, as he has fought in times past.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Lord will go forth and fight against those nations, as when He fights on a day of battle.
verses.textEn: Then the Lord will go out and fight against those nations, as he fights on a day of battle.

verses.textZh: 到那日，他的脚必站在对着耶路撒冷，在东面的橄榄山上；这橄榄山必从中间裂开，由东至西成为极大的山谷。山的一半向北挪移，一半向南挪移。
verses.textZhCnvs: 到那日，他的脚必站在对着耶路撒冷，在东面的橄榄山上；这橄榄山必从中间裂开，由东至西成为极大的山谷。山的一半向北挪移，一半向南挪移。
verses.textZhCuv: 那日，他的脚必站在耶路撒冷前面朝东的橄榄山上。这山必从中间分裂，自东至西成为极大的谷。山的一半向北挪移，一半向南挪移。
verses.textEnNiv: On that day his feet will stand on the Mount of Olives, east of Jerusalem, and the Mount of Olives will be split in two from east to west, forming a great valley, with half of the mountain moving north and half moving south.
verses.textEnEsv: On that day his feet shall stand on the Mount of Olives that lies before Jerusalem on the east, and the Mount of Olives shall be split in two from east to west by a very wide valley, so that one half of the Mount shall move northward, and the other half southward.
verses.textEnNkjv: And in that day His feet will stand on the Mount of Olives, Which faces Jerusalem on the east. And the Mount of Olives shall be split in two, From east to west, Making a very large valley; Half of the mountain shall move toward the north And half of it toward the south.
verses.textEnNlt: On that day his feet will stand on the Mount of Olives, east of Jerusalem. And the Mount of Olives will split apart, making a wide valley running from east to west. Half the mountain will move toward the north and half toward the south.
verses.textEnNasb: On that day His feet will stand on the Mount of Olives, which is in front of Jerusalem on the east; and the Mount of Olives will be split in its middle from east to west forming a very large valley. Half of the mountain will move toward the north, and the other half toward the south.
verses.textEn: On that day his feet will stand on the Mount of Olives, east of Jerusalem, and the Mount of Olives will be split in two from east to west, forming a great valley, with half of the mountain moving north and half moving south.

verses.textZh: 你们要经由我的山谷逃跑，因为山谷必伸展到亚萨；你们要逃跑，好象在犹大王乌西雅年间逃避大地震一样。耶和华我的神必来临，所有的圣者都与他 同来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要经由我的山谷逃跑，因为山谷必伸展到亚萨；你们要逃跑，好象在犹大王乌西雅年间逃避大地震一样。耶和华我的神必来临，所有的圣者都与他 同来。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们要从我山的谷中逃跑，因为山谷必延到亚萨。你们逃跑，必如犹大王乌西雅年间的人逃避大地震一样。耶和华－我的神必降临，有一切圣者同来。
verses.textEnNiv: You will flee by my mountain valley, for it will extend to Azel. You will flee as you fled from the earthquake in the days of Uzziah king of Judah. Then the Lord my God will come, and all the holy ones with him.
verses.textEnEsv: And you shall flee to the valley of my mountains, for the valley of the mountains shall reach to Azal. And you shall flee as you fled from the earthquake in the days of Uzziah king of Judah. Then the Lord my God will come, and all the holy ones with him.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then you shall flee through My mountain valley, For the mountain valley shall reach to Azal. Yes, you shall flee As you fled from the earthquake In the days of Uzziah king of Judah. Thus the Lord my God will come, And all the saints with You.
verses.textEnNlt: You will flee through this valley, for it will reach across to Azal. Yes, you will flee as you did from the earthquake in the days of King Uzziah of Judah. Then the Lord my God will come, and all his holy ones with him.
verses.textEnNasb: And you will flee by the valley of My mountains, for the valley of the mountains will reach to Azel; yes, you will flee just as you fled from the earthquake in the days of Uzziah king of Judah. Then the Lord, my God, will come, and all the holy ones with Him!
verses.textEn: You will flee by my mountain valley, for it will extend to Azel. You will flee as you fled from the earthquake in the days of Uzziah king of Judah. Then the Lord my God will come, and all the holy ones with him.

verses.textZh: 到那日，必没有光、寒冷和严霜。
verses.textZhCnvs: 到那日，必没有光、寒冷和严霜。
verses.textZhCuv: 那日，必没有光，三光必退缩。
verses.textEnNiv: On that day there will be neither sunlight nor cold, frosty darkness.
verses.textEnEsv: On that day there shall be no light, cold, or frost.
verses.textEnNkjv: It shall come to pass in that day That there will be no light; The lights will diminish.
verses.textEnNlt: On that day the sources of light will no longer shine,
verses.textEnNasb: On that day there will be no light; the luminaries will die out.
verses.textEn: On that day there will be neither sunlight nor cold, frosty darkness.

verses.textZh: 那将是独特的一天，只有耶和华知道；那天不再分白昼和黑夜，因为在晚上仍有光明。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那将是独特的一天，只有耶和华知道；那天不再分白昼和黑夜，因为在晚上仍有光明。
verses.textZhCuv: 那日，必是耶和华所知道的，不是白昼，也不是黑夜，到了晚上才有光明。
verses.textEnNiv: It will be a unique day—a day known only to the Lord —with no distinction between day and night. When evening comes, there will be light.
verses.textEnEsv: And there shall be a unique day, which is known to the Lord , neither day nor night, but at evening time there shall be light.
verses.textEnNkjv: It shall be one day Which is known to the Lord— Neither day nor night. But at evening time it shall happen That it will be light.
verses.textEnNlt: yet there will be continuous day! Only the Lord knows how this could happen. There will be no normal day and night, for at evening time it will still be light.
verses.textEnNasb: For it will be a unique day which is known to the Lord, neither day nor night, but it will come about that at the time of evening there will be light.
verses.textEn: It will be a unique day—a day known only to the Lord —with no distinction between day and night. When evening comes, there will be light.

verses.textZh: 到那日，必有活水从耶路撒冷流出来；一半流往东海，另一半流往西海；冬天夏天都是这样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 到那日，必有活水从耶路撒冷流出来；一半流往东海，另一半流往西海；冬天夏天都是这样。
verses.textZhCuv: 那日，必有活水从耶路撒冷出来，一半往东海流，一半往西海流；冬夏都是如此。
verses.textEnNiv: On that day living water will flow out from Jerusalem, half of it east to the Dead Sea and half of it west to the Mediterranean Sea, in summer and in winter.
verses.textEnEsv: On that day living waters shall flow out from Jerusalem, half of them to the eastern sea and half of them to the western sea. It shall continue in summer as in winter.
verses.textEnNkjv: And in that day it shall be That living waters shall flow from Jerusalem, Half of them toward the eastern sea And half of them toward the western sea; In both summer and winter it shall occur.
verses.textEnNlt: On that day life-giving waters will flow out from Jerusalem, half toward the Dead Sea and half toward the Mediterranean, flowing continuously in both summer and winter.
verses.textEnNasb: And on that day living waters will flow out of Jerusalem, half of them toward the eastern sea and the other half toward the western sea; it will be in summer as well as in winter.
verses.textEn: On that day living water will flow out from Jerusalem, half of it east to the Dead Sea and half of it west to the Mediterranean Sea, in summer and in winter.

verses.textZh: 耶和华必作全地的王；到那日，人人都承认耶和华是独一无二的，他的名也是独一无二的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华必作全地的王；到那日，人人都承认耶和华是独一无二的，他的名也是独一无二的。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华必作全地的王。那日耶和华必为独一无二的，他的名也是独一无二的。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord will be king over the whole earth. On that day there will be one Lord , and his name the only name.
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord will be king over all the earth. On that day the Lord will be one and his name one.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the Lord shall be King over all the earth. In that day it shall be— "The Lordis one," And His name one.
verses.textEnNlt: And the Lord will be king over all the earth. On that day there will be one Lord —his name alone will be worshiped.
verses.textEnNasb: And the Lord will be King over all the earth; on that day the Lord will be the only one, and His name the only one.
verses.textEn: The Lord will be king over the whole earth. On that day there will be one Lord , and his name the only name.

verses.textZh: 全地，从迦巴直到耶路撒冷南方的临门，都要变成平原；但耶路撒冷仍必屹然耸立，从便雅悯门到第一门的地方，到角门，又从哈楠业楼到王的榨酒池，都在原处。
verses.textZhCnvs: 全地，从迦巴直到耶路撒冷南方的临门，都要变成平原；但耶路撒冷仍必屹然耸立，从便雅悯门到第一门的地方，到角门，又从哈楠业楼到王的榨酒池，都在原处。
verses.textZhCuv: 全地，从迦巴直到耶路撒冷南方的临门，要变为亚拉巴。耶路撒冷必仍居高位，就是从便雅悯门到第一门之处，又到角门，并从哈楠业楼，直到王的酒榨。
verses.textEnNiv: The whole land, from Geba to Rimmon, south of Jerusalem, will become like the Arabah. But Jerusalem will be raised up high from the Benjamin Gate to the site of the First Gate, to the Corner Gate, and from the Tower of Hananel to the royal winepresses, and will remain in its place.
verses.textEnEsv: The whole land shall be turned into a plain from Geba to Rimmon south of Jerusalem. But Jerusalem shall remain aloft on its site from the Gate of Benjamin to the place of the former gate, to the Corner Gate, and from the Tower of Hananel to the king’s winepresses.
verses.textEnNkjv: All the land shall be turned into a plain from Geba to Rimmon south of Jerusalem. Jerusalem shall be raised up and inhabited in her place from Benjamin’s Gate to the place of the First Gate and the Corner Gate, and from the Tower of Hananel to the king’s winepresses.
verses.textEnNlt: All the land from Geba, north of Judah, to Rimmon, south of Jerusalem, will become one vast plain. But Jerusalem will be raised up in its original place and will be inhabited all the way from the Benjamin Gate over to the site of the old gate, then to the Corner Gate, and from the Tower of Hananel to the king’s winepresses.
verses.textEnNasb: All the land will change into a plain from Geba to Rimmon south of Jerusalem; but Jerusalem will rise and remain on its site from Benjamin’s Gate as far as the place of the First Gate to the Corner Gate, and from the Tower of Hananel to the king’s wine presses.
verses.textEn: The whole land, from Geba to Rimmon, south of Jerusalem, will become like the Arabah. But Jerusalem will be raised up high from the Benjamin Gate to the site of the First Gate, to the Corner Gate, and from the Tower of Hananel to the royal winepresses, and will remain in its place.

verses.textZh: 城中必有人居住，必不再有毁灭的咒诅，耶路撒冷的人必安然居住。
verses.textZhCnvs: 城中必有人居住，必不再有毁灭的咒诅，耶路撒冷的人必安然居住。
verses.textZhCuv: 人必住在其中，不再有咒诅。耶路撒冷人必安然居住。
verses.textEnNiv: It will be inhabited; never again will it be destroyed. Jerusalem will be secure.
verses.textEnEsv: And it shall be inhabited, for there shall never again be a decree of utter destruction. Jerusalem shall dwell in security.
verses.textEnNkjv: The people shall dwell in it; And no longer shall there be utter destruction, But Jerusalem shall be safely inhabited.
verses.textEnNlt: And Jerusalem will be filled, safe at last, never again to be cursed and destroyed.
verses.textEnNasb: People will live in it, and there will no longer be a curse, for Jerusalem will live in security.
verses.textEn: It will be inhabited; never again will it be destroyed. Jerusalem will be secure.

verses.textZh: 这是耶和华用来击打那些与耶路撒冷争战的万族的灾疫：他们双脚仍然站地的时候，他们的肌肉必腐烂，他们的眼球必在眼眶里腐烂，他们的舌头必在口腔中腐烂。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这是耶和华用来击打那些与耶路撒冷争战的万族的灾疫：他们双脚仍然站地的时候，他们的肌肉必腐烂，他们的眼球必在眼眶里腐烂，他们的舌头必在口腔中腐烂。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华用灾殃攻击那与耶路撒冷争战的列国人，必是这样：他们两脚站立的时候，肉必消没，眼在眶中干瘪，舌在口中溃烂。
verses.textEnNiv: This is the plague with which the Lord will strike all the nations that fought against Jerusalem: Their flesh will rot while they are still standing on their feet, their eyes will rot in their sockets, and their tongues will rot in their mouths.
verses.textEnEsv: And this shall be the plague with which the Lord will strike all the peoples that wage war against Jerusalem: their flesh will rot while they are still standing on their feet, their eyes will rot in their sockets, and their tongues will rot in their mouths.
verses.textEnNkjv: And this shall be the plague with which the Lord will strike all the people who fought against Jerusalem: Their flesh shall dissolve while they stand on their feet, Their eyes shall dissolve in their sockets, And their tongues shall dissolve in their mouths.
verses.textEnNlt: And the Lord will send a plague on all the nations that fought against Jerusalem. Their people will become like walking corpses, their flesh rotting away. Their eyes will rot in their sockets, and their tongues will rot in their mouths.
verses.textEnNasb: Now this will be the plague with which the Lord will strike all the peoples who have gone to war against Jerusalem; their flesh will rot while they stand on their feet, and their eyes will rot in their sockets, and their tongue will rot in their mouth.
verses.textEn: This is the plague with which the Lord will strike all the nations that fought against Jerusalem: Their flesh will rot while they are still standing on their feet, their eyes will rot in their sockets, and their tongues will rot in their mouths.

verses.textZh: 到那日，耶和华必使他们大大慌乱，他们各人互相抓住对方的手，并举起手来互相攻击。
verses.textZhCnvs: 到那日，耶和华必使他们大大慌乱，他们各人互相抓住对方的手，并举起手来互相攻击。
verses.textZhCuv: 那日，耶和华必使他们大大扰乱。他们各人彼此揪住，举手攻击。
verses.textEnNiv: On that day people will be stricken by the Lord with great panic. They will seize each other by the hand and attack one another.
verses.textEnEsv: And on that day a great panic from the Lord shall fall on them, so that each will seize the hand of another, and the hand of the one will be raised against the hand of the other.
verses.textEnNkjv: It shall come to pass in that day That a great panic from the Lord will be among them. Everyone will seize the hand of his neighbor, And raise his hand against his neighbor’s hand;
verses.textEnNlt: On that day they will be terrified, stricken by the Lord with great panic. They will fight their neighbors hand to hand.
verses.textEnNasb: And it will come about on that day that a great panic from the Lord will fall on them; and they will seize one another’s hand, and the hand of one will be raised against the hand of another.
verses.textEn: On that day people will be stricken by the Lord with great panic. They will seize each other by the hand and attack one another.

verses.textZh: 犹大也必在耶路撒冷争战；四围列国的财物都必被收聚起来，有极多的金子、银子和衣服。
verses.textZhCnvs: 犹大也必在耶路撒冷争战；四围列国的财物都必被收聚起来，有极多的金子、银子和衣服。
verses.textZhCuv: 犹大也必在耶路撒冷争战。那时四围各国的财物，就是许多金银衣服，必被收聚。
verses.textEnNiv: Judah too will fight at Jerusalem. The wealth of all the surrounding nations will be collected—great quantities of gold and silver and clothing.
verses.textEnEsv: Even Judah will fight at Jerusalem. And the wealth of all the surrounding nations shall be collected, gold, silver, and garments in great abundance.
verses.textEnNkjv: Judah also will fight at Jerusalem. And the wealth of all the surrounding nations Shall be gathered together: Gold, silver, and apparel in great abundance.
verses.textEnNlt: Judah, too, will be fighting at Jerusalem. The wealth of all the neighboring nations will be captured—great quantities of gold and silver and fine clothing.
verses.textEnNasb: Judah also will fight at Jerusalem; and the wealth of all the surrounding nations will be gathered, gold, silver, and garments in great abundance.
verses.textEn: Judah too will fight at Jerusalem. The wealth of all the surrounding nations will be collected—great quantities of gold and silver and clothing.

verses.textZh: 照样，像这类的灾疫也必临到马匹、骡子、骆驼、驴和在营中的一切牲畜身上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 照样，像这类的灾疫也必临到马匹、骡子、骆驼、驴和在营中的一切牲畜身上。
verses.textZhCuv: 那临到马匹、骡子、骆驼、驴，和营中一切牲畜的灾殃是与那灾殃一般。
verses.textEnNiv: A similar plague will strike the horses and mules, the camels and donkeys, and all the animals in those camps.
verses.textEnEsv: And a plague like this plague shall fall on the horses, the mules, the camels, the donkeys, and whatever beasts may be in those camps.
verses.textEnNkjv: Such also shall be the plague On the horse and the mule, On the camel and the donkey, And on all the cattle that will be in those camps. So shall this plague be.
verses.textEnNlt: This same plague will strike the horses, mules, camels, donkeys, and all the other animals in the enemy camps.
verses.textEnNasb: And just like this plague, there will be a plague on the horse, the mule, the camel, the donkey, and all the cattle that will be in those camps.
verses.textEn: A similar plague will strike the horses and mules, the camels and donkeys, and all the animals in those camps.

verses.textZh: 所有前来攻击耶路撒冷的列国中剩下的人，必年年上来敬拜大君王万军之耶和华，并且守住棚节。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所有前来攻击耶路撒冷的列国中剩下的人，必年年上来敬拜大君王万军之耶和华，并且守住棚节。
verses.textZhCuv: 所有来攻击耶路撒冷列国中剩下的人，必年年上来敬拜大君王－万军之耶和华，并守住棚节。
verses.textEnNiv: Then the survivors from all the nations that have attacked Jerusalem will go up year after year to worship the King, the Lord Almighty, and to celebrate the Festival of Tabernacles.
verses.textEnEsv: Then everyone who survives of all the nations that have come against Jerusalem shall go up year after year to worship the King, the Lord of hosts, and to keep the Feast of Booths.
verses.textEnNkjv: And it shall come to pass that everyone who is left of all the nations which came against Jerusalem shall go up from year to year to worship the King, the Lord of hosts, and to keep the Feast of Tabernacles.
verses.textEnNlt: In the end, the enemies of Jerusalem who survive the plague will go up to Jerusalem each year to worship the King, the Lord of Heaven’s Armies, and to celebrate the Festival of Shelters.
verses.textEnNasb: Then it will come about that any who are left of all the nations that came against Jerusalem will go up from year to year to worship the King, the Lord of armies, and to celebrate the Feast of Booths.
verses.textEn: Then the survivors from all the nations that have attacked Jerusalem will go up year after year to worship the King, the Lord Almighty, and to celebrate the Festival of Tabernacles.

verses.textZh: 地上的万族中，凡是不上耶路撒冷敬拜大君王万军之耶和华的，就必没有雨降给他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 地上的万族中，凡是不上耶路撒冷敬拜大君王万军之耶和华的，就必没有雨降给他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 地上万族中，凡不上耶路撒冷敬拜大君王－万军之耶和华的，必无雨降在他们的地上。
verses.textEnNiv: If any of the peoples of the earth do not go up to Jerusalem to worship the King, the Lord Almighty, they will have no rain.
verses.textEnEsv: And if any of the families of the earth do not go up to Jerusalem to worship the King, the Lord of hosts, there will be no rain on them.
verses.textEnNkjv: And it shall be that whichever of the families of the earth do not come up to Jerusalem to worship the King, the Lord of hosts, on them there will be no rain.
verses.textEnNlt: Any nation in the world that refuses to come to Jerusalem to worship the King, the Lord of Heaven’s Armies, will have no rain.
verses.textEnNasb: And it will be that whichever of the families of the earth does not go up to Jerusalem to worship the King, the Lord of armies, there will be no rain on them.
verses.textEn: If any of the peoples of the earth do not go up to Jerusalem to worship the King, the Lord Almighty, they will have no rain.

verses.textZh: 埃及族若不上来参加，就必没有雨降给他们，这就是耶和华用来击打那些不上来守住棚节的列国的灾祸。
verses.textZhCnvs: 埃及族若不上来参加，就必没有雨降给他们，这就是耶和华用来击打那些不上来守住棚节的列国的灾祸。
verses.textZhCuv: 埃及族若不上来，雨也不降在他们的地上；凡不上来守住棚节的列国人，耶和华也必用这灾攻击他们。
verses.textEnNiv: If the Egyptian people do not go up and take part, they will have no rain. The Lord will bring on them the plague he inflicts on the nations that do not go up to celebrate the Festival of Tabernacles.
verses.textEnEsv: And if the family of Egypt does not go up and present themselves, then on them there shall be no rain; there shall be the plague with which the Lord afflicts the nations that do not go up to keep the Feast of Booths.
verses.textEnNkjv: If the family of Egypt will not come up and enter in, they shallhave no rain; they shall receive the plague with which the Lord strikes the nations who do not come up to keep the Feast of Tabernacles.
verses.textEnNlt: If the people of Egypt refuse to attend the festival, the Lord will punish them with the same plague that he sends on the other nations who refuse to go.
verses.textEnNasb: And if the family of Egypt does not go up or enter, then no rain will fall on them; it will be the plague with which the Lord strikes the nations that do not go up to celebrate the Feast of Booths.
verses.textEn: If the Egyptian people do not go up and take part, they will have no rain. The Lord will bring on them the plague he inflicts on the nations that do not go up to celebrate the Festival of Tabernacles.

verses.textZh: 这就是埃及的刑罚，也是所有不上来守住棚节的列国的惩罚。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这就是埃及的刑罚，也是所有不上来守住棚节的列国的惩罚。
verses.textZhCuv: 这就是埃及的刑罚和那不上来守住棚节之列国的刑罚。
verses.textEnNiv: This will be the punishment of Egypt and the punishment of all the nations that do not go up to celebrate the Festival of Tabernacles.
verses.textEnEsv: This shall be the punishment to Egypt and the punishment to all the nations that do not go up to keep the Feast of Booths.
verses.textEnNkjv: This shall be the punishment of Egypt and the punishment of all the nations that do not come up to keep the Feast of Tabernacles.
verses.textEnNlt: Egypt and the other nations will all be punished if they don’t go to celebrate the Festival of Shelters.
verses.textEnNasb: This will be the punishment of Egypt, and the punishment of all the nations that do not go up to celebrate the Feast of Booths.
verses.textEn: This will be the punishment of Egypt and the punishment of all the nations that do not go up to celebrate the Festival of Tabernacles.

verses.textZh: 到那日，马的铃铛上必有"归耶和华为圣"这句话；耶和华殿里的锅必好象祭坛前献祭用的碗一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 到那日，马的铃铛上必有"归耶和华为圣"这句话；耶和华殿里的锅必好象祭坛前献祭用的碗一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 当那日，马的铃铛上必有「归耶和华为圣」的这句话。耶和华殿内的锅必如祭坛前的碗一样。
verses.textEnNiv: On that day Holy to the Lord will be inscribed on the bells of the horses, and the cooking pots in the Lord ’s house will be like the sacred bowls in front of the altar.
verses.textEnEsv: And on that day there shall be inscribed on the bells of the horses, "Holy to the Lord ." And the pots in the house of the Lord shall be as the bowls before the altar.
verses.textEnNkjv: In that day "HOLINESS TO THE LORD" shall be engraved on the bells of the horses. The pots in the Lord’s house shall be like the bowls before the altar.
verses.textEnNlt: On that day even the harness bells of the horses will be inscribed with these words: Holy to the Lord . And the cooking pots in the Temple of the Lord will be as sacred as the basins used beside the altar.
verses.textEnNasb: On that day there will be inscribed on the bells of the horses, "Holy to the Lord." And the cooking pots in the Lord’s house will be like the bowls before the altar.
verses.textEn: On that day Holy to the Lord will be inscribed on the bells of the horses, and the cooking pots in the Lord ’s house will be like the sacred bowls in front of the altar.

verses.textZh: 耶路撒冷和犹大所有的锅都必归万军之耶和华为圣；献祭的，都必来取这些锅，用来煮祭肉。到那日，在万军之耶和华的殿中，必不再有商人 。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶路撒冷和犹大所有的锅都必归万军之耶和华为圣；献祭的，都必来取这些锅，用来煮祭肉。到那日，在万军之耶和华的殿中，必不再有商人 。
verses.textZhCuv: 凡耶路撒冷和犹大的锅都必归万军之耶和华为圣。凡献祭的都必来取这锅，煮肉在其中。当那日，在万军之耶和华的殿中必不再有迦南人。
verses.textEnNiv: Every pot in Jerusalem and Judah will be holy to the Lord Almighty, and all who come to sacrifice will take some of the pots and cook in them. And on that day there will no longer be a Canaanite in the house of the Lord Almighty.
verses.textEnEsv: And every pot in Jerusalem and Judah shall be holy to the Lord of hosts, so that all who sacrifice may come and take of them and boil the meat of the sacrifice in them. And there shall no longer be a trader in the house of the Lord of hosts on that day.
verses.textEnNkjv: Yes, every pot in Jerusalem and Judah shall be holiness to the Lord of hosts. Everyone who sacrifices shall come and take them and cook in them. In that day there shall no longer be a Canaanite in the house of the Lord of hosts.
verses.textEnNlt: In fact, every cooking pot in Jerusalem and Judah will be holy to the Lord of Heaven’s Armies. All who come to worship will be free to use any of these pots to boil their sacrifices. And on that day there will no longer be traders in the Temple of the Lord of Heaven’s Armies.
verses.textEnNasb: Every cooking pot in Jerusalem and in Judah will be holy to the Lord of armies; and all who sacrifice will come and take of them and boil in them. And there will no longer be a Canaanite in the house of the Lord of armies on that day.
verses.textEn: Every pot in Jerusalem and Judah will be holy to the Lord Almighty, and all who come to sacrifice will take some of the pots and cook in them. And on that day there will no longer be a Canaanite in the house of the Lord Almighty.
